You are auditing the test suite for the deeplearning4j VLM (Vision Language Model) decode pipeline to identify coverage gaps, redundancies, and opportunities to better validate token quality after a major DSP refactoring.

## Context

We recently completed a DSP (DynamicShapePlan) refactoring and fixed GPU memory leaks. Now we need to restore and validate token quality. The previous assessment identified these test weaknesses:
- Current validation uses synthetic images and only 10 tokens — not enough to catch long-horizon drift
- No strong end-to-end oracle on the actual `pathfinder-mythic.pdf` page 10 workload
- 83 Triton fusion tests are single-execution only — no multi-step decode with KV cache
- Test-oracle compares against current SLOT_BY_SLOT, not a known-good historical reference
- Heuristic checks (tag presence, diversity) catch gross failures but not subtle semantic drift

## Test Files to Audit

Read ALL of these test files. For each one, document:
1. What it tests (scope/purpose)
2. What configurations it covers (SLOT_BY_SLOT, OPTIMAL, TRITON, etc.)
3. What assertions it makes (numeric tolerance, token match rate, text content, etc.)
4. How many decode steps it runs
5. Whether it uses real model data or synthetic/mocked data
6. Whether it tests the full pipeline or isolated components

commit 47a24d3ce434e02a93cbf21f0c11b7aeb1cf70ba
Author: agibsonccc <adam@konduit.ai>
Date:   Sun Apr 12 05:24:16 2026 +0900

    fix: GPU memory leak — tl_castCache unbounded growth (250 MB/step)
    
    Root cause: MmulHelper.cu's tl_castCacheA/B.push_back() grew unboundedly
    during non-capture matmul execution. Each FP32→HALF cast created a
    persistent NDArray copy pushed to the thread-local cache every step.
    resetCastCacheIndices() only reset the INDEX (to 0) not the cache,
    so the cache grew by ~1.2 MB per matmul × 211 matmuls = ~250 MB/step.
    nvidia-smi confirmed: 250 MB/step before fix, 0 MB/step after.
    
    Leaks fixed:
    - tl_castCacheA/B.push_back in mmulMxM (FP32×FP32→HALF TF32 path)
    - tl_castCacheA.push_back in mmulMxM (FLOAT32×HALF mixed-type path)
    - tl_castCacheB.push_back in mmulMxM (HALF×FLOAT32 mixed-type path)
    - tl_castCacheA/B.push_back in mmulMxV (FP32→HALF vector path)
    
    Other changes:
    - CudaGraphHandle: enable AutoFreeOnLaunch by default
    - CudaExecutioner: delegate selectTargetDevice to DeviceMemoryManager
    - InferenceSession: close cast placeholder copies after DSP execution,
      add DSP_DIAG-based memory diagnostics in writeOutputSlot
    - StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop: per-phase GPU memory tracking
    - BenchmarkConfigApplier: trim pools after resetModelState
    - TestDspValidation: memory leak isolation tests
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit 634fabf1b77075f1f70e5797ba2f3e27046eabe5
Author: agibsonccc <adam@konduit.ai>
Date:   Sat Apr 11 13:30:26 2026 +0900

    fix: Triton accuracy — remove stale tl_graphExecutionActive, fix trait resolution, add 83 fusion tests
    
    Root cause: tl_graphExecutionActive was set during ALL backend segment execution
    (NativeDynamicShapePlan_segments.cpp:677), not just CUDA graph capture. This caused
    DataBuffer::syncToSpecial() to create stale pinned host copies during normal Triton
    execution, producing wrong output on replay.
    
    Secondary fix: resolveSlotTraits in TritonIRBuilder_sections.cpp returned 0 from
    op descriptor without falling back to the trait table, causing stack ops to be
    misclassified as GATHER (wrong section emitter → maxDiff=8.87).
    
    Changes:
    - Remove tl_graphExecutionActive=true/false from executeSegmentWithSpecificBackend
    - Fix resolveSlotTraits to fall back to getOpTraitsByName when descriptor returns 0
    - Add compilationDone_ flag — compilation happens once during warmup, then skipped
    - Register greaterthan_scalar and 5 other scalar comparison ops in OpCategoryTable.h
    - Fix GELU formula mismatch (sigmoid approximation to match native ops)
    - Fix stack unsqueeze in Triton IR builder (insert dim=1 at axis before concat)
    - Fix test references: sd.output() → slot-by-slot native execution (sd.output returns
      zeros for certain multi-op graph patterns)
    - Fix changing-inputs tests: assign() into existing buffers to preserve GPU addresses
    - Add 83 new TritonFusionReplayAccuracyTest methods covering: scalar constants,
      broadcast patterns, residuals, softmax, GELU, attention, SiLU, GLU, layer norm,
      RoPE, cross-attention, clamp, reductions, matmul fusion, and more
    - Fix benchmark config filtering (SLOT_BY_SLOT now works in run-benchmark.sh)
    - Increase LargeGraph tolerance for FP32 precision across 64-layer residual networks
    
    Test results: 83/83 fusion tests pass, 6/6 originally-failing graph backend tests pass,
    121/121 individual kernel tests pass.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

   187	        String logitsOutputName = DecoderUtils.findLogitsOutputName(decoder);

   190	
   191	        List<String> fullOutputNameList = new ArrayList<>();
   192	        fullOutputNameList.add(logitsOutputName);
   193	        fullOutputNameList.addAll(kvNames.keyNames);
   194	        fullOutputNameList.addAll(kvNames.valueNames);
   195	        String[] fullOutputNames = fullOutputNameList.toArray(new String[0]);
   196	
   197	        if (compileDsp) {
   198	            decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   199	            decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   200	            decoder.compileNativeDynamicShapePlan(DspCompilationMode.MAX_AUTOTUNE, fullOutputNames);
   201	            log.info("Initial DSP compile done");
   202	        }

   204	        List<Integer> generatedTokens = new ArrayList<>();
   205	        INDArray currentEmbeddings = inputsEmbeds;
   206	        long currentSeqLen = inputsEmbeds.size(1);
   207	        long pastSeqLen = 0;

   209	        INDArray embeddingMatrix = null;
   210	        for (var v : embedTokens.variables()) {
   211	            if (v.getArr() != null && v.getArr().rank() == 2) {

    40	/**

   185	    @Test
   186	    @Order(2)
   187	    @DisplayName("Multiple unfrozen calls: check if model inherently produces NaN for random inputs")
   188	    public void testUnfrozenMultipleCallsNaN() {

   228	    private void freezeDspShapes(SameDiff sd) {
   229	        try {
   230	            var sessionsField = SameDiff.class.getDeclaredField("sessions");
   231	            sessionsField.setAccessible(true);
   232	            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
   233	            Map<Long, InferenceSession> sessions = (Map<Long, InferenceSession>) sessionsField.get(sd);
   234	            InferenceSession session = sessions.get(Thread.currentThread().getId());
   235	            if (session != null) {
   236	                DynamicShapePlanExecutor dsp = session.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor();
   237	                if (dsp != null) {
   238	                    dsp.setShapesFrozen(true);
   239	                    log.info("Froze DSP shapes");
   240	                }
   241	            }
   242	        } catch (Exception e) {
   243	            log.warn("Could not freeze DSP shapes: {}", e.getMessage());
   244	        }
   245	    }
   246

   432	    @Test
   433	    @DisplayName("6. Token→embed→decode→token cycle consistency")
   434	    public void testEmbeddingRoundTrip() {
   435	        INDArray embeddingTable = extractEmbeddingTable(embedTokens);
   436	        assertNotNull(embeddingTable);
   437	
   438	        String inputName = embedTokens.inputs().get(0);
   439	        String[] outputNames = embedTokens.outputs().toArray(new String[0]);
   440	
   441	        // For each special token, verify:
   442	        // 1. Direct lookup produces same result as SameDiff
   443	        // 2. The embedding is not a duplicate of another token
   444	        int[] specialTokens = {49229, 49204, 49205, 49219, 49220, 49218};
   445	
   446	        Map<Integer, INDArray> embeddings = new HashMap<>();
   447	        for (int tokenId : specialTokens) {
   448	            // Direct lookup
   449	            INDArray direct = embeddingTable.getRow(tokenId).dup();
   450	
   451	            // SameDiff lookup
   452	            INDArray tokenTensor = Nd4j.createFromArray(new int[]{tokenId}).reshape(1, 1).castTo(DataType.LONG);
   453	            Map<String, INDArray> sdResult = embedTokens.output(Map.of(inputName, tokenTensor), outputNames);
   454	            INDArray sdEmb = sdResult.values().iterator().next().reshape(-1);
   455	
   456	            double diff = direct.sub(sdEmb).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   457	            assertTrue(diff < 1e-5, "Token " + tokenId + " direct/SD mismatch: " + diff);
   458	
   459	            embeddings.put(tokenId, direct);
   460	        }
   461	
   462	        // Verify distinctness: each pair should differ
   463	        for (int i = 0; i < specialTokens.length; i++) {
   464	            for (int j = i + 1; j < specialTokens.length; j++) {
   465	                INDArray a = embeddings.get(specialTokens[i]);
   466	                INDArray b = embeddings.get(specialTokens[j]);
   467	                double dist = a.sub(b).norm2Number().doubleValue();
   468	                log.info("Dist({}, {}): {}", specialTokens[i], specialTokens[j], dist);
   469	                assertTrue(dist > 0.01,
   470	                        "Tokens " + specialTokens[i] + " and " + specialTokens[j] +
   471	                                " should be distinct, dist=" + dist);
   472	            }
   473	        }
   474	    }

   532	    private INDArray extractEmbeddingTable(SameDiff model) {

   534	        for (SDVariable var : model.variables()) {
   535	            if (var.getVariableType() == VariableType.CONSTANT || var.getVariableType() == VariableType.VARIABLE) {
   536	                INDArray arr = var.getArr();
   537	                if (arr != null && arr.rank() == 2) {
   538	                    if (embeddingTable == null || arr.length() > embeddingTable.length()) {
   539	                        embeddingTable = arr;
   540	                    }
   541	                }
   542	            }
   543	        }
   544	        return embeddingTable;
   545	    }

    85	        embeddingTable = null;
    86	        long bestRows = 0;
    87	        for (SDVariable var : embedTokens.variables()) {
    88	            INDArray arr = embedTokens.getArrForVarName(var.name());
    89	            if (arr != null && arr.rank() == 2 && arr.size(0) > bestRows) {
    90	                bestRows = arr.size(0);
    91	                embeddingTable = arr;
    92	            }
    93	        }
    94	        assertNotNull(embeddingTable, "Could not find embedding table");
    95	
    96	        // Find output names
    97	        kvOutputNames = new ArrayList<>();
    98	        for (String name : decoder.outputs()) {
    99	            if (name.contains("logit")) {
   100	                logitsName = name;
   101	            } else if (name.startsWith("present")) {
   102	                kvOutputNames.add(name);
   103	            }
   104	        }
   105	        if (logitsName == null) logitsName = decoder.outputs().get(0);
   106	
   107	        allOutputNames = new ArrayList<>();
   108	        allOutputNames.add(logitsName);
   109	        allOutputNames.addAll(kvOutputNames);
   110	
   111	        keyNames = new ArrayList<>();
   112	        valueNames = new ArrayList<>();
   113	        for (String kvName : kvOutputNames) {
   114	            if (kvName.contains(".key")) keyNames.add(kvName);
   115	            else if (kvName.contains(".value")) valueNames.add(kvName);
   116	        }
   117	
   118	        log.info("Loaded: inputs={} outputs={} kvPairs={}",
   119	                decoder.inputs().size(), decoder.outputs().size(), keyNames.size());
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    @AfterAll
   123	    public void cleanup() {
   124	        if (decoder != null) decoder.close();
   125	        if (embedTokens != null) embedTokens.close();
   126	    }
   127	
   128	    private INDArray buildPrefillEmbeddings(int[] tokens) {
   129	        long hiddenSize = embeddingTable.size(1);
   130	        INDArray result = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, 1, tokens.length, hiddenSize);
   131	        for (int i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
   132	            result.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(i), NDArrayIndex.all())
   133	                    .assign(embeddingTable.getRow(tokens[i]));
   134	        }
   135	        return result;
   136	    }
   137	
   138	    /**
   139	     * Run the full decode loop (prefill + N decode steps) with DSP + CUDA graph replay.
   140	     * Returns the list of generated token IDs, or throws TimeoutException if hung.
   141	     */
   142	    private List<Integer> runDecodeLoop(int maxSteps) throws Exception {
   143	        long hiddenSize = embeddingTable.size(1);
   144	        int[] promptTokens = {0, 44, 2692, 46};  // <bos> This is a
   145	        INDArray prefillEmbeds = buildPrefillEmbeddings(promptTokens);
   146	        long seqLen = prefillEmbeds.shape()[1];
   147	
   148	        decoder.resetSession();
   149	        decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   150	        decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   151	        ArrayCacheMemoryMgr.setGrowthFactor(1.0);
   152	
   153	        // Step 0: Prefill
   154	        Map<String, INDArray> inputs = DecoderUtils.buildDecoderInputMap(
   155	                decoder.inputs(), decoder,
   156	                prefillEmbeds, null,
   157	                0, seqLen, null, 0, 0,
   158	                false, hiddenSize);
   159	
   160	        Map<String, INDArray> result = decoder.output(inputs, allOutputNames.toArray(new String[0]));
   161	        int firstToken = result.get(logitsName).get(NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   162	                NDArrayIndex.point(seqLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all()).argMax().getInt(0);
   163	
   164	        List<Integer> generated = new ArrayList<>();
   165	        generated.add(firstToken);
   166	        log.info("Step 0 (prefill): token={}", firstToken);
   167	
   168	        long maxKvLen = seqLen + maxSteps;
   169	        Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers = DecoderUtils.padKvCacheToStaticSize(
   170	                result, keyNames, valueNames, maxKvLen);
   171	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   172	        long cachePos = seqLen;
   173	        long pastSeqLen = seqLen;
   174	
   175	        // Clear prefill DSP plan
   176	        {
   177	            InferenceSession sess = decoder.getOrCreateSession();
   178	            DynamicShapePlanExecutor exec = sess.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor();
   179	            if (exec != null && exec.getCurrentPlan() != null) {
   180	                decoder.clearDynamicShapePlanCache();
   181	                sess.clearAllCaches();
   182	            }
   183	        }
   184	
   185	        // Decode loop: step 1 = capture, step 2+ = replay
   186	        for (int step = 1; step < maxSteps; step++) {
   187	            int prevToken = generated.get(generated.size() - 1);
   188	            INDArray tokenEmbed = embeddingTable.getRow(prevToken).reshape(1, 1, hiddenSize);
   189	            INDArray inputIds = Nd4j.createFromArray(new int[]{prevToken}).reshape(1, 1).castTo(DataType.LONG);
   190	
   191	            Map<String, INDArray> decInputs = DecoderUtils.buildDecoderInputMap(
   192	                    decoder.inputs(), decoder,
   193	                    tokenEmbed, inputIds,
   194	                    pastSeqLen, 1,
   195	                    staticKvBuffers, maxKvLen, cachePos,
   196	                    true, hiddenSize, null, false);
   197	
   198	            long t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();
   199	
   200	            // outputDirect from step 2 (like StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop)
   201	            boolean useDirect = step >= 2;
   202	            if (useDirect) {
   203	                result = decoder.outputDirect(decInputs, allOutputNames.toArray(new String[0]));
   204	            } else {
   205	                result = decoder.output(decInputs, allOutputNames.toArray(new String[0]));
   206	            }
   207	
   208	            long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0;
   209	
   210	            int nextToken = result.get(logitsName).get(NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   211	                    NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.all()).argMax().getInt(0);
   212	            generated.add(nextToken);
   213	
   214	            // Check frozen state
   215	            boolean nativePlanFrozen = false;
   216	            {
   217	                InferenceSession sess = decoder.getOrCreateSession();
   218	                DynamicShapePlanExecutor exec = sess.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor();
   219	                nativePlanFrozen = exec != null && exec.isShapesFrozen();
   220	            }
   221	
   222	            String phaseLabel = step == 1 ? "capture" : (nativePlanFrozen ? "replay(frozen)" : "replay");
   223	            log.info("Step {} ({}): token={} elapsed={}ms", step, phaseLabel, nextToken, elapsed);
   224	
   225	            // Scatter KV entries
   226	            DecoderUtils.scatterNewKvEntries(staticKvBuffers, result, keyNames, valueNames, maxKvLen, cachePos);
   227	            cachePos++;
   228	
   229	            // Close present KV outputs when not frozen (like StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop)
   230	            if (!nativePlanFrozen) {
   231	                for (String pn : keyNames) {
   232	                    INDArray pv = result.get(pn);
   233	                    if (pv != null && !pv.wasClosed() && pv.data() != null) {
   234	                        pv.setCloseable(true);
   235	                        pv.close();
   236	                    }
   237	                }
   238	                for (String pn : valueNames) {
   239	                    INDArray pv = result.get(pn);
   240	                    if (pv != null && !pv.wasClosed() && pv.data() != null) {
   241	                        pv.setCloseable(true);
   242	                        pv.close();
   243	                    }
   244	                }
   245	            }
   246	
   247	            pastSeqLen++;
   248	        }
   249	
   250	        return generated;
   251	    }

    49	/**
    50	 * Reproduce the CUDA graph replay hang at step 2 (first decode replay).
    51	 *
    52	 * <p>Problem: VLM decoder hangs on step 2 (the first CUDA graph replay of the decode plan).
    53	 * Steps 0 (prefill/capture) and 1 (first decode/capture) succeed. Step 2 attempts to replay
    54	 * the captured graph and hangs indefinitely on seg[1320-1323] (attention matmuls + Triton softmax).</p>
    55	 *
    56	 * <p>Root cause: cuBLAS workspace is being zeroed (cudaMemsetAsync) before segment captures.
    57	 * When segment N captures, cuBLAS caches plan/descriptor data in the workspace. Later segments
    58	 * (like seg[1320-1323]) inherit those cached plans — their captured graphs omit H2D re-upload nodes.
    59	 * On replay, the pre-segments workspace zeroing destroys the cached plans, so GEMM kernels read
    60	 * zeros and hang.</p>
    61	 *
    62	 * <p>This test exercises the exact pattern that triggers the hang:</p>
    63	 * <ul>
    64	 *   <li>Load SmolDocling-256M-preview model via VisionLanguageModel</li>
    65	 *   <li>Process a single page from pathfinder-mythic.pdf</li>
    66	 *   <li>Run the StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop with maxNewTokens=50</li>
    67	 *   <li>Verify step 2+ (first CUDA graph replay) completes without hanging</li>
    68	 * </ul>
    69	 *
    70	 * <p>Run:
    71	 * <pre>
    72	 *   cd platform-tests && mvn test \
    73	 *     -Dtest=TestCudaGraphReplayHang \
    74	 *     -Dbackend.artifactId=nd4j-cuda-12.9
    75	 * </pre>
    76	 */

   129	    private static void logGpuMemory(String label) {
   130	        try {
   131	            int numDevices = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getNumberOfDevices();
   132	            for (int d = 0; d < numDevices; d++) {
   133	                long freeMem = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemory(d);
   134	                long totalMem = nativeOps.getDeviceTotalMemory(d);
   135	                long usedMem = totalMem - freeMem;
   136	                log.info("[{}] Device {}: used={} MB, free={} MB, total={} MB",
   137	                        label, d, usedMem / (1024 * 1024), freeMem / (1024 * 1024), totalMem / (1024 * 1024));
   138	            }
   139	        } catch (Exception e) {
   140	            log.warn("Could not query GPU memory: {}", e.getMessage());
   141	        }
   142	    }

   322	    /**
   323	     * Test 4: Direct decode loop test — bypass VLM wrapper.
   324	     *
   325	     * <p>Directly exercises StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop to isolate the CUDA graph replay bug
   326	     * from any VLM wrapper logic.</p>

   328	    @Test
   329	    @Order(4)
   330	    @DisplayName("Direct StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop test — isolate replay bug")
   331	    @Timeout(value = TEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, unit = TimeUnit.SECONDS)
   332	    public void testDirectDecodeLoop() {
   333	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(modelsLoaded, "Models not loaded — skipping");
   334	
   335	        logGpuMemory("Test 4 start");
   336	
   337	        // Get decoder and embed_tokens from VLM
   338	        SameDiff decoder = vlm.getDecoder();
   339	        SameDiff embedTokens = vlm.getEmbedTokens();
   340	
   341	        // Create simple prompt
   342	        int[] promptTokens = {0, 44, 2692, 46}; // Simple 4-token prompt
   343	        // Use the embedding table's hidden dimension directly rather than relying on config.json
   344	        // (which may not be downloaded or may have hidden_size nested under text_config).
   345	        // StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop also auto-resolves from prefillEmbeddings.shape()[2] when hiddenSize <= 0.
   346	        long hiddenSize = 0; // auto-resolve from embedding shape
   347	
   348	        // Build prefill embeddings
   349	        INDArray embeddingTable = null;
   350	        for (org.nd4j.autodiff.samediff.SDVariable var : embedTokens.variables()) {
   351	            if (var.getVariableType() == org.nd4j.autodiff.samediff.VariableType.CONSTANT ||
   352	                var.getVariableType() == org.nd4j.autodiff.samediff.VariableType.VARIABLE) {
   353	                INDArray arr = var.getArr();
   354	                if (arr != null && arr.rank() == 2) {
   355	                    if (embeddingTable == null || arr.length() > embeddingTable.length()) {
   356	                        embeddingTable = arr;
   357	                    }
   358	                }
   359	            }
   360	        }
   361	        assertNotNull(embeddingTable, "Could not find embedding table");
   362	
   363	        INDArray prefillEmbeds = buildPrefillEmbeddings(embeddingTable, promptTokens);
   364	        log.info("Prefill embeddings shape: {}", java.util.Arrays.toString(prefillEmbeds.shape()));
   365	
   366	        // Build StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop
   367	        org.eclipse.deeplearning4j.llm.generation.SamplingConfig samplingCfg =
   368	                org.eclipse.deeplearning4j.llm.generation.SamplingConfig.greedy();
   369	
   370	        org.eclipse.deeplearning4j.llm.generation.ModelIOConfig decoderIOConfig =
   371	                org.eclipse.deeplearning4j.llm.generation.ModelIOConfig.discover(decoder);
   372	
   373	        org.eclipse.deeplearning4j.llm.generation.StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop loop =
   374	                org.eclipse.deeplearning4j.llm.generation.StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.builder()
   375	                        .decoder(decoder)
   376	                        .embedTokens(embedTokens)
   377	                        .tokenizer(vlm.getTokenizer())
   378	                        .ioConfig(decoderIOConfig)
   379	                        .samplingConfig(samplingCfg)
   380	                        .maxNewTokens(MAX_NEW_TOKENS)
   381	                        .hiddenSize(hiddenSize)
   382	                        .build();
   383	
   384	        log.info("Running StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop with maxNewTokens={}", MAX_NEW_TOKENS);
   385	        logGpuMemory("Before decode loop");
   386	
   387	        GenerationResult result = loop.decode(prefillEmbeds, promptTokens);
   388	
   389	        logGpuMemory("After decode loop");
   390	
   391	        assertNotNull(result);
   392	        log.info("Direct decode result: {} tokens, text='{}', finishReason={}",
   393	                result.getGeneratedTokenCount(),
   394	                result.getText(),
   395	                result.getFinishReason());
   396	        log.info("Direct decode timing: firstTokenLatency={}ms, totalTime={}ms, {:.1f} tok/s",
   397	                result.getFirstTokenLatencyMs(),
   398	                result.getGenerationTimeMs(),
   399	                result.getTokensPerSecond());
   400	
   401	        // Verify we got some output (not hanging)
   402	        assertTrue(result.getGeneratedTokenCount() > 0, "No tokens generated — decode loop may have hung");
   403	    }
   404	
   405	    private INDArray buildPrefillEmbeddings(INDArray embeddingTable, int[] tokens) {
   406	        long hiddenSize = embeddingTable.size(1);
   407	        INDArray result = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, 1, tokens.length, hiddenSize);
   408	        for (int i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
   409	            result.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   410	                    org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(i),
   411	                    org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.all())
   412	                    .assign(embeddingTable.getRow(tokens[i]));
   413	        }
   414	        return result;
   415	    }

    44	/**
    45	 * Tests DSP memory stability across repeated frozen executions.
    46	 *
    47	 * <p>Verifies that GPU memory pool usage remains bounded after the initial
    48	 * execution when shapes are frozen. The key invariant:
    49	 * <ul>
    50	 *   <li>Pool used after cleanup should return to baseline (±10%)</li>
    51	 *   <li>Device free memory should not decrease monotonically</li>
    52	 *   <li>No OOM after N iterations with constant shapes</li>
    53	 * </ul>
    54	 *
    55	 * <p>Uses DSP diagnostics APIs to inspect pool stats at each step.
    56	 *
    57	 * <p>Run:
    58	 * <pre>
    59	 *   cd platform-tests && mvn test \
    60	 *     -Dtest=TestDSPMemoryStability \
    61	 *     -Dbackend.artifactId=nd4j-cuda-12.9
    62	 * </pre>
    63	 */
    64	@Slf4j
    65	@TestMethodOrder(MethodOrderer.OrderAnnotation.class)
    66	public class TestDSPMemoryStability {

    69	    private static boolean modelsLoaded = false;
    70	    private static NativeOps nativeOps;

    72	    @BeforeAll
    73	    public static void setup() throws Exception {
    74	        System.setProperty(ND4JSystemProperties.DYNAMIC_SHAPE_PLAN_ENABLED, "true");

    76	        System.setProperty(ND4JSystemProperties.DSP_DIAGNOSTICS_LEVEL, "full");
    77	        InferenceSession.setDynamicShapePlanEnabled(true);
    78	        nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
    79	        DspDiagnostics.initialize();

    85	            visionEncoder = OnnxModelCache.importWithCache(visionDir.getAbsolutePath());
    86	            visionEncoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
    87	            visionEncoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
    88	            log.info("Vision encoder loaded: {} ops", visionEncoder.ops().length);
    89	            modelsLoaded = true;
    90	        } catch (Exception e) {
    91	            log.error("Failed to load models: {}", e.getMessage());

   100	    /**
   101	     * Query pool stats via NativeOps.
   102	     */
   103	    private static long[] getPoolStats(int deviceId) {
   104	        try (LongPointer usedPtr = new LongPointer(1);
   105	             LongPointer reservedPtr = new LongPointer(1)) {
   106	            nativeOps.getMemoryPoolStats(deviceId, usedPtr, reservedPtr);
   107	            return new long[]{usedPtr.get(0), reservedPtr.get(0)};
   108	        }
   109	    }
   110	
   111	    private static long getDeviceFreeMemory(int deviceId) {
   112	        return nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemory(deviceId);
   113	    }
   114	
   115	    private static void logMemory(String label, int deviceId) {
   116	        long[] pool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   117	        long freeMem = getDeviceFreeMemory(deviceId);
   118	        long totalMem = nativeOps.getDeviceTotalMemory(deviceId);
   119	        log.info("[{}] dev={}: poolUsed={}MB poolReserved={}MB devUsed={}MB devFree={}MB",
   120	                label, deviceId,
   121	                pool[0] / (1024 * 1024), pool[1] / (1024 * 1024),
   122	                (totalMem - freeMem) / (1024 * 1024), freeMem / (1024 * 1024));
   123	    }

   125	    // =========================================================================
   126	    // Test 1: Pool stats return to baseline after frozen cleanup
   127	    // =========================================================================
   128	
   129	    @Test
   130	    @Order(1)
   131	    @DisplayName("Frozen execution: pool used returns to baseline between calls")
   132	    public void testPoolStatsReturnToBaseline() {
   133	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(modelsLoaded, "Models not loaded — skipping");
   134	
   135	        int targetSize = 512;
   136	        int deviceId = 0;
   137	        List<String> outputNames = List.of("image_features");
   138	
   139	        // Warmup call (compiles the plan)
   140	        logMemory("Before warmup", deviceId);
   141	        INDArray pv0 = Nd4j.rand(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 3, targetSize, targetSize);
   142	        INDArray mask0 = Nd4j.ones(DataType.BOOL, 1, targetSize, targetSize);
   143	        Map<String, INDArray> out0 = visionEncoder.output(
   144	                Map.of("pixel_values", pv0, "pixel_attention_mask", mask0), outputNames);
   145	        assertNotNull(out0.get("image_features"), "Warmup call failed");
   146	        pv0.close();
   147	        mask0.close();
   148	        for (INDArray a : out0.values()) {
   149	            if (a != null && !a.wasClosed()) { a.setCloseable(true); a.close(); }
   150	        }
   151	        logMemory("After warmup", deviceId);
   152	
   153	        // Trim pool to establish baseline
   154	        nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(deviceId);
   155	        logMemory("After trim (baseline)", deviceId);
   156	        long[] baselinePool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   157	        long baselineDevFree = getDeviceFreeMemory(deviceId);
   158	
   159	        // Freeze shapes
   160	        freezeDspShapes(visionEncoder);
   161	
   162	        // Run frozen calls and track pool stats
   163	        int numIterations = 6;
   164	        long[] poolUsedAfterCall = new long[numIterations];
   165	        long[] devFreeAfterCall = new long[numIterations];
   166	
   167	        for (int i = 0; i < numIterations; i++) {
   168	            INDArray pv = Nd4j.rand(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 3, targetSize, targetSize);
   169	            INDArray mask = Nd4j.ones(DataType.BOOL, 1, targetSize, targetSize);
   170	            Map<String, INDArray> out;
   171	            try {
   172	                out = visionEncoder.output(
   173	                        Map.of("pixel_values", pv, "pixel_attention_mask", mask), outputNames);
   174	            } catch (Exception e) {
   175	                logMemory("FAILED at iteration " + i, deviceId);
   176	                fail("Iteration " + i + " failed: " + e.getMessage(), e);
   177	                return;
   178	            }
   179	
   180	            INDArray features = out.get("image_features");
   181	            assertNotNull(features, "Iteration " + i + ": null output");
   182	            assertFalse(Double.isNaN(features.sumNumber().doubleValue()),
   183	                    "Iteration " + i + ": NaN in output");
   184	
   185	            pv.close();
   186	            mask.close();
   187	            for (INDArray a : out.values()) {
   188	                if (a != null && !a.wasClosed()) { a.setCloseable(true); a.close(); }
   189	            }
   190	
   191	            long[] pool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   192	            poolUsedAfterCall[i] = pool[0];
   193	            devFreeAfterCall[i] = getDeviceFreeMemory(deviceId);
   194	
   195	            log.info("Frozen iter {}: poolUsed={}MB devFree={}MB",
   196	                    i, pool[0] / (1024 * 1024), devFreeAfterCall[i] / (1024 * 1024));
   197	        }
   198	
   199	        // Verify: pool used after last call should not be more than 2x the baseline
   200	        // (some overhead from the frozen execution is expected)
   201	        long lastPoolUsed = poolUsedAfterCall[numIterations - 1];
   202	        long basePoolUsed = baselinePool[0];
   203	        log.info("Pool used: baseline={}MB final={}MB ratio={:.2f}",
   204	                basePoolUsed / (1024 * 1024), lastPoolUsed / (1024 * 1024),
   205	                basePoolUsed > 0 ? (double) lastPoolUsed / basePoolUsed : 0.0);
   206	
   207	        // The pool should not grow unboundedly. After warmup, subsequent calls
   208	        // should reuse memory. Allow 3x headroom for intermediates.
   209	        assertTrue(lastPoolUsed < basePoolUsed + 10L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024,
   210	                "Pool used grew unboundedly: baseline=" + basePoolUsed / (1024 * 1024) +
   211	                        "MB, final=" + lastPoolUsed / (1024 * 1024) + "MB");
   212	
   213	        // Verify: device free memory should not decrease monotonically
   214	        // (if every call leaks, free decreases each time)
   215	        int decreaseCount = 0;
   216	        for (int i = 1; i < numIterations; i++) {
   217	            if (devFreeAfterCall[i] < devFreeAfterCall[i - 1] - 50 * 1024 * 1024) {
   218	                decreaseCount++;
   219	            }
   220	        }
   221	        log.info("Device free monotonic decreases: {}/{}", decreaseCount, numIterations - 1);
   222	        assertTrue(decreaseCount < numIterations - 1,
   223	                "Device free memory decreased monotonically every iteration — likely a leak");
   224	
   225	        unfreezeDspShapes(visionEncoder);
   226	        log.info("Pool stats baseline test passed");
   227	    }

   383	    // =========================================================================
   384	    // Helpers
   385	    // =========================================================================
   386	
   387	    private void freezeDspShapes(SameDiff sd) {
   388	        try {
   389	            var sessionsField = SameDiff.class.getDeclaredField("sessions");
   390	            sessionsField.setAccessible(true);
   391	            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
   392	            Map<Long, InferenceSession> sessions = (Map<Long, InferenceSession>) sessionsField.get(sd);
   393	            InferenceSession session = sessions.get(Thread.currentThread().getId());
   394	            if (session != null) {
   395	                DynamicShapePlanExecutor dsp = session.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor();
   396	                if (dsp != null) {
   397	                    dsp.setShapesFrozen(true);
   398	                    log.info("Froze DSP shapes");
   399	                }
   400	            }
   401	        } catch (Exception e) {
   402	            log.warn("Could not freeze DSP shapes: {}", e.getMessage());
   403	        }
   404	    }
   405	
   406	    private void unfreezeDspShapes(SameDiff sd) {
   407	        try {
   408	            var sessionsField = SameDiff.class.getDeclaredField("sessions");
   409	            sessionsField.setAccessible(true);
   410	            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
   411	            Map<Long, InferenceSession> sessions = (Map<Long, InferenceSession>) sessionsField.get(sd);
   412	            InferenceSession session = sessions.get(Thread.currentThread().getId());
   413	            if (session != null) {
   414	                DynamicShapePlanExecutor dsp = session.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor();
   415	                if (dsp != null) {
   416	                    dsp.setShapesFrozen(false);
   417	                    log.info("Unfroze DSP shapes");
   418	                }
   419	            }
   420	        } catch (Exception e) {
   421	            log.warn("Could not unfreeze DSP shapes: {}", e.getMessage());
   422	        }
   423	    }

    40	/**
    41	 * Compares decode paths using the REAL SmolDocling decoder model.
    42	 * Loads decoder + embed_tokens ONCE. No vision encoder (saves GPU memory).
    43	 *
    44	 * Tests isolate the exact point where DSP/Triton configuration breaks output.
    45	 */
    46	@Slf4j
    47	@TestInstance(TestInstance.Lifecycle.PER_CLASS)
    48	@DisplayName("TestStaticKvVsManualDecode")
    49	@TestMethodOrder(MethodOrderer.OrderAnnotation.class)
    50	public class TestStaticKvVsManualDecode {
    51	
    52	    private SameDiff decoder;
    53	    private SameDiff embedTokens;
    54	    private INDArray embeddingTable;
    55	    private String logitsName;
    56	    private List<String> kvOutputNames;
    57	    private List<String> allOutputNames;
    58	    private List<String> keyNames;
    59	    private List<String> valueNames;
    60	    private static final int MAX_STEPS = 20;
    61	
    62	    @BeforeAll
    63	    public void loadModel() throws Exception {
    64	        var decoderResult = VLMModelDownloader.download(VLMModelDownloader.VLMModel.SMOLDOCLING_DECODER);
    65	        var embedResult = VLMModelDownloader.download(VLMModelDownloader.VLMModel.SMOLDOCLING_EMBED_TOKENS);
    66	
    67	        decoder = OnnxModelCache.importWithCache(decoderResult.getModelFile().getAbsolutePath());
    68	        embedTokens = OnnxModelCache.importWithCache(embedResult.getModelFile().getAbsolutePath());
    69	
    70	        // Find embedding table (largest 2D constant)
    71	        embeddingTable = null;
    72	        long bestRows = 0;
    73	        for (SDVariable var : embedTokens.variables()) {
    74	            INDArray arr = embedTokens.getArrForVarName(var.name());
    75	            if (arr != null && arr.rank() == 2 && arr.size(0) > bestRows) {
    76	                bestRows = arr.size(0);
    77	                embeddingTable = arr;
    78	            }
    79	        }
    80	        assertNotNull(embeddingTable, "Could not find embedding table");
    81	
    82	        // Find output names
    83	        kvOutputNames = new ArrayList<>();
    84	        for (String name : decoder.outputs()) {
    85	            if (name.contains("logit")) {
    86	                logitsName = name;
    87	            } else if (name.startsWith("present")) {
    88	                kvOutputNames.add(name);
    89	            }
    90	        }
    91	        if (logitsName == null) logitsName = decoder.outputs().get(0);
    92	
    93	        allOutputNames = new ArrayList<>();
    94	        allOutputNames.add(logitsName);
    95	        allOutputNames.addAll(kvOutputNames);
    96	
    97	        keyNames = new ArrayList<>();
    98	        valueNames = new ArrayList<>();
    99	        for (String kvName : kvOutputNames) {
   100	            if (kvName.contains(".key")) keyNames.add(kvName);
   101	            else if (kvName.contains(".value")) valueNames.add(kvName);
   102	        }
   103	
   104	        log.info("Loaded: inputs={} outputs={} kvPairs={}",
   105	                decoder.inputs().size(), decoder.outputs().size(), keyNames.size());
   106	    }
   107	
   108	    @AfterAll
   109	    public void cleanup() {
   110	        if (decoder != null) decoder.close();
   111	        if (embedTokens != null) embedTokens.close();
   112	    }
   113	
   114	    private INDArray buildPrefillEmbeddings(int[] tokens) {
   115	        long hiddenSize = embeddingTable.size(1);
   116	        INDArray result = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, 1, tokens.length, hiddenSize);
   117	        for (int i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
   118	            result.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(i), NDArrayIndex.all())
   119	                    .assign(embeddingTable.getRow(tokens[i]));
   120	        }
   121	        return result;
   122	    }

   124	    /**
   125	     * Test 0: Single-step prefill comparison — DSP vs non-DSP.
   126	     * Runs the SAME input through the decoder ONCE, with and without DSP.
   127	     * If the output logits differ, the DSP plan compilation or execution is wrong.
   128	     * Also tests with native disabled (Java DSP only) to narrow down.
   129	     */
   130	    @Test
   131	    @Order(0)
   132	    @DisplayName("0. Single-step DSP vs non-DSP comparison")
   133	    public void testSingleStepDspVsNonDsp() {
   134	        long hiddenSize = embeddingTable.size(1);
   135	        int[] promptTokens = {0, 44, 2692, 46};
   136	        INDArray prefillEmbeds = buildPrefillEmbeddings(promptTokens);
   137	        long seqLen = prefillEmbeds.shape()[1];
   138	
   139	        // --- Run 1: Non-DSP (baseline) ---
   140	        decoder.resetSession();
   141	        decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(false);
   142	        decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(false);
   143	        decoder.clearDynamicShapePlanCache();
   144	        ArrayCacheMemoryMgr.setGrowthFactor(1.0);
   145	
   146	        Map<String, INDArray> inputs = DecoderUtils.buildDecoderInputMap(
   147	                decoder.inputs(), decoder,
   148	                prefillEmbeds, null,
   149	                0, seqLen, null, 0, 0,
   150	                false, hiddenSize);
   151	
   152	        Map<String, INDArray> baselineResult = decoder.output(inputs, logitsName);
   153	        INDArray baselineLogits = baselineResult.get(logitsName);
   154	        int baselineToken = baselineLogits.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   155	                NDArrayIndex.point(seqLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all()).argMax().getInt(0);
   156	        INDArray baselineLastLogits = baselineLogits.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   157	                NDArrayIndex.point(seqLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all()).dup();
   158	        log.info("Baseline (no DSP): firstToken={} logits[0:5]={}", baselineToken,
   159	                baselineLastLogits.get(NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 5)));
   160	
   161	        // Snapshot checksums of ALL constants and variables BEFORE DSP
   162	        Map<String, Double> preChecksums = new LinkedHashMap<>();
   163	        for (SDVariable v : decoder.variables()) {
   164	            if (v.getVariableType() == org.nd4j.autodiff.samediff.VariableType.CONSTANT
   165	                    || v.getVariableType() == org.nd4j.autodiff.samediff.VariableType.VARIABLE) {
   166	                INDArray arr = decoder.getArrForVarName(v.name());
   167	                if (arr != null && !arr.wasClosed() && arr.length() > 0 && !arr.isEmpty()) {
   168	                    try {
   169	                        preChecksums.put(v.name(), arr.sumNumber().doubleValue());
   170	                    } catch (Exception e) {
   171	                        // skip arrays that can't be summed
   172	                    }
   173	                }
   174	            }
   175	        }
   176	        log.info("Pre-DSP: captured {} checksums", preChecksums.size());
   177	
   178	        // --- Run 2: Java DSP only (native disabled) ---
   179	        decoder.resetSession();
   180	        decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   181	        decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(false);
   182	        decoder.clearDynamicShapePlanCache();
   183	        ArrayCacheMemoryMgr.setGrowthFactor(1.0);
   184	
   185	        // Log DSP plan info after first execution
   186	        Map<String, INDArray> javaDspResult = decoder.output(inputs, logitsName);
   187	        {
   188	            InferenceSession sess = decoder.getOrCreateSession();
   189	            DynamicShapePlanExecutor exec = sess.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor();
   190	            if (exec != null && exec.getCurrentPlan() != null) {
   191	                var plan = exec.getCurrentPlan();
   192	                log.info("DSP plan: slots={} extInputs={} outputs={}",
   193	                        plan.getSlots().length,
   194	                        plan.getExternalInputKeys().length,
   195	                        plan.getRequestedOutputs());
   196	                // Check a few external inputs
   197	                String[] extKeys = plan.getExternalInputKeys();
   198	                byte[] extTypes = plan.getExternalInputSourceTypes();
   199	                int phCount = 0, constCount = 0, varCount = 0;
   200	                for (int i = 0; i < extTypes.length; i++) {
   201	                    switch (extTypes[i]) {
   202	                        case 0: constCount++; break; // SOURCE_CONSTANT
   203	                        case 1: varCount++; break;   // SOURCE_VARIABLE
   204	                        case 2: phCount++; break;    // SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER
   205	                    }
   206	                }
   207	                log.info("External inputs: {} constants, {} variables, {} placeholders",
   208	                        constCount, varCount, phCount);
   209	                // Log placeholder names
   210	                for (int i = 0; i < extKeys.length; i++) {
   211	                    if (extTypes[i] == 2) { // SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER
   212	                        log.info("  Placeholder[{}]: '{}'", i, extKeys[i]);
   213	                    }
   214	                }
   215	            }
   216	        }
   217	        INDArray javaDspLogits = javaDspResult.get(logitsName);
   218	        int javaDspToken = javaDspLogits.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   219	                NDArrayIndex.point(seqLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all()).argMax().getInt(0);
   220	        INDArray javaDspLastLogits = javaDspLogits.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   221	                NDArrayIndex.point(seqLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all()).dup();
   222	        log.info("Java DSP: firstToken={} logits[0:5]={}", javaDspToken,
   223	                javaDspLastLogits.get(NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 5)));
   224	
   225	        double javaDspDiff = javaDspLastLogits.sub(baselineLastLogits).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   226	        log.info("Java DSP vs baseline: maxDiff={}", javaDspDiff);
   227	
   228	        // Checksum comparison: find which constants/variables were corrupted by DSP
   229	        int corrupted = 0;
   230	        for (Map.Entry<String, Double> entry : preChecksums.entrySet()) {
   231	            String name = entry.getKey();
   232	            double preSumVal = entry.getValue();
   233	            INDArray arr = decoder.getArrForVarName(name);
   234	            if (arr != null && !arr.wasClosed() && arr.length() > 0 && !arr.isEmpty()) {
   235	                try {
   236	                    double postSum = arr.sumNumber().doubleValue();
   237	                    double diff = Math.abs(postSum - preSumVal);
   238	                    if (diff > 1e-6) {
   239	                        SDVariable sdv = decoder.getVariable(name);
   240	                        log.error("CORRUPTED: '{}' type={} shape={} preSum={} postSum={} diff={}",
   241	                                name, sdv != null ? sdv.getVariableType() : "?",
   242	                                Arrays.toString(arr.shape()), preSumVal, postSum, diff);
   243	                        corrupted++;
   244	                    }
   245	                } catch (Exception e) {
   246	                    // skip
   247	                }
   248	            } else {
   249	                log.warn("POST-DSP: '{}' is null/closed/empty", name);
   250	            }
   251	        }
   252	        log.info("Checksum comparison: {} of {} constants/variables corrupted", corrupted, preChecksums.size());
   253	
   254	        // Try running non-DSP on the SAME session (without resetSession) to check contamination
   255	        decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(false);
   256	        Map<String, INDArray> postDspNoReset = decoder.output(inputs, logitsName);
   257	        int postDspNoResetToken = postDspNoReset.get(logitsName).get(NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   258	                NDArrayIndex.point(seqLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all()).argMax().getInt(0);
   259	        log.info("Post-DSP (no reset, DSP off): token={}", postDspNoResetToken);
   260	
   261	        assertEquals(baselineToken, javaDspToken,
   262	                "Java DSP should produce same token as baseline. Baseline=" + baselineToken + " JavaDSP=" + javaDspToken);
   263	
   264	        // --- Run 3: Native DSP (Java + native) ---
   265	        decoder.resetSession();
   266	        decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   267	        decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   268	        decoder.clearDynamicShapePlanCache();
   269	        ArrayCacheMemoryMgr.setGrowthFactor(1.0);
   270	
   271	        Map<String, INDArray> nativeDspResult = decoder.output(inputs, logitsName);

   121	    // =========================================================================
   122	    // Test 0: isolate the exact benchmark prefill RMSNorm outside DSP.
   123	    // If this fails, the CUDA rms_norm path itself is broken for the prompt shape.
   124	    // If this passes, the fault is in DSP slot/buffer handling around slot 420.
   125	    // =========================================================================
   126	
   127	    @Test
   128	    @Order(0)
   129	    @DisplayName("0. Benchmark prefill rms_norm isolation")
   130	    public void testBenchmarkPrefillRmsNormIsolation() {
   131	        INDArray gamma = decoder.getArrForVarName("model.layers.0.input_layernorm.weight");
   132	        assertNotNull(gamma, "Layer 0 input_layernorm gamma not found");
   133	
   134	        INDArray input = benchmarkEmbeddings.dup();
   135	        assertNotNull(input, "Benchmark embeddings should exist");
   136	        assertEquals(3, input.rank(), "Benchmark embeddings should be rank 3");
   137	
   138	        log.info("Benchmark prefill rms_norm isolation: input shape={} dtype={} order={} view={}",
   139	                Arrays.toString(input.shape()), input.dataType(), input.ordering(), input.isView());
   140	        log.info("Benchmark prefill rms_norm isolation: gamma shape={} dtype={} order={} view={}",
   141	                Arrays.toString(gamma.shape()), gamma.dataType(), gamma.ordering(), gamma.isView());
   142	
   143	        INDArray direct = Nd4j.nn.rmsNorm(input, gamma, 1e-5f);
   144	        assertArrayEquals(input.shape(), direct.shape(), "Direct rms_norm shape should match input");
   145	
   146	        SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
   147	        try {
   148	            SDVariable x = sd.placeHolder("x", DataType.FLOAT, input.shape());
   149	            SDVariable g = sd.constant("gamma", gamma.dup());
   150	            SDVariable out = sd.nn.rmsNorm("out", x, g, 1e-5f);
   151	            Map<String, INDArray> result = sd.output(Map.of("x", input.dup()), out.name());
   152	            INDArray sameDiffOut = result.get(out.name());
   153	            assertNotNull(sameDiffOut, "SameDiff rms_norm output should exist");
   154	            assertArrayEquals(input.shape(), sameDiffOut.shape(), "SameDiff rms_norm shape should match input");
   155	
   156	            double maxDiff = direct.sub(sameDiffOut).normmaxNumber().doubleValue();
   157	            log.info("Benchmark prefill rms_norm isolation: direct vs SameDiff max diff={}", maxDiff);
   158	            assertTrue(maxDiff < 1e-3, "Benchmark prefill rms_norm direct vs SameDiff max diff=" + maxDiff);
   159	        } finally {
   160	            sd.close();
   161	        }
   162	    }

   247	    // =========================================================================
   248	    // Test 3: Step-by-step divergence — at which step does StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop
   249	    // diverge from manual decode? Compares token-by-token.
   250	    // =========================================================================
   251	
   252	    @Test
   253	    @Order(3)
   254	    @DisplayName("3. Step-by-step divergence: manual vs StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop")
   255	    public void testStepByStepDivergence() {
   256	        if (manualDecodeTokens == null || manualDecodeTokens.isEmpty()) {
   257	            log.warn("Skipping — manual decode tokens not available (test 1 may have failed)");
   258	            return;
   259	        }
   260	
   261	        resetDecoder();
   262	
   263	        System.setProperty("nd4j.dsp.noDirect", "true");
   264	        try {
   265	            StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop loop = StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.builder()
   266	                    .decoder(decoder)
   267	                    .embedTokens(embedTokens)
   268	                    .tokenizer(tokenizer)
   269	                    .samplingConfig(SamplingConfig.greedy())
   270	                    .maxNewTokens(10)
   271	                    .hiddenSize((int) benchmarkEmbeddings.shape()[2])
   272	                    .build();
   273	
   274	            GenerationResult loopResult = loop.decode(benchmarkEmbeddings.dup(), benchmarkPromptTokenIds);
   275	
   276	            log.info("Manual tokens: {}", manualDecodeTokens.subList(0, Math.min(10, manualDecodeTokens.size())));
   277	            log.info("Loop tokens:   {}", Arrays.toString(loopResult.getTokenIds()));
   278	
   279	            int divergeStep = -1;
   280	            int maxCompare = Math.min(Math.min(manualDecodeTokens.size(), loopResult.getTokenIds().length), 10);
   281	            for (int i = 0; i < maxCompare; i++) {
   282	                int manual = manualDecodeTokens.get(i);
   283	                int loopTok = loopResult.getTokenIds()[i];
   284	                String manualText = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{manual}, false);
   285	                String loopText = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{loopTok}, false);
   286	                boolean match = manual == loopTok;
   287	                log.info("Step {}: manual={}('{}') loop={}('{}') {}",
   288	                        i, manual, manualText, loopTok, loopText, match ? "MATCH" : "*** DIVERGE ***");
   289	                if (!match && divergeStep < 0) {
   290	                    divergeStep = i;
   291	                }
   292	            }
   293	
   294	            if (divergeStep >= 0) {
   295	                log.warn("FINDING: Outputs diverge at step {}.", divergeStep);
   296	                if (divergeStep == 0) {
   297	                    log.warn("  Diverges at PREFILL — same code path, different result. Check session state.");
   298	                } else if (divergeStep == 1) {
   299	                    log.warn("  Diverges at first DECODE step — padded KV transition is suspect.");
   300	                } else {
   301	                    log.warn("  Diverges at step {} — KV scatter or attention mask accumulation error.", divergeStep);
   302	                }
   303	            } else {
   304	                log.info("FINDING: Manual and StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop produce IDENTICAL tokens for {} steps", maxCompare);
   305	            }
   306	        } finally {
   307	            System.clearProperty("nd4j.dsp.noDirect");
   308	            resetDecoder();
   309	        }
   310	    }

   396	    // =========================================================================
   397	    // Test 6: Attention mask verification — compare what manual decode
   398	    // and padded mode produce at step 2 for the actual model inputs.
   399	    // =========================================================================
   400	
   401	    @Test
   402	    @Order(6)
   403	    @DisplayName("6. Attention mask: manual (all-ones) vs padded (sparse) produce same logits at step 2")
   404	    public void testAttentionMaskEquivalence() {
   405	        resetDecoder();
   406	        INDArray embeddingTable = extractEmbeddingTable();
   407	        assertNotNull(embeddingTable, "Embedding table not found");
   408	
   409	        long seqLen = benchmarkEmbeddings.shape()[1];
   410	        long hiddenSize = benchmarkEmbeddings.shape()[2];
   411	
   412	        String logitsName = findLogitsName();
   413	        List<String> kvOutputNames = findKvOutputNames();
   414	        List<String> allOutputs = new ArrayList<>();
   415	        allOutputs.add(logitsName);
   416	        allOutputs.addAll(kvOutputNames);
   417	
   418	        // === PREFILL (same for both paths) ===
   419	        Map<String, INDArray> inputs = buildPrefillInputs(seqLen);
   420	        Map<String, INDArray> prefillResult = decoder.output(inputs, allOutputs.toArray(new String[0]));
   421	        INDArray prefillLogits = prefillResult.get(logitsName);
   422	        INDArray lastLogits = prefillLogits.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   423	                NDArrayIndex.point(seqLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all());
   424	        int firstToken = lastLogits.argMax().getInt(0);
   425	
   426	        // Save KV for manual path
   427	        Map<String, INDArray> manualKv = new HashMap<>();
   428	        for (String kvName : kvOutputNames) {
   429	            String pastName = kvName.replace("present", "past_key_values");
   430	            manualKv.put(pastName, prefillResult.get(kvName).dup());
   431	        }
   432	
   433	        // Save KV for padded path (pad to static size)
   434	        long maxKvLen = seqLen + 30;
   435	        Map<String, INDArray> staticKv = new HashMap<>();
   436	        for (String kvName : kvOutputNames) {
   437	            String pastName = kvName.replace("present", "past_key_values");
   438	            INDArray kv = prefillResult.get(kvName);
   439	            long[] shape = kv.shape(); // [1, heads, seqLen, dim]
   440	            INDArray padded = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, shape[0], shape[1], maxKvLen, shape[3]);
   441	            padded.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   442	                    NDArrayIndex.interval(0, shape[2]), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(kv);
   443	            staticKv.put(pastName, padded);
   444	        }
   445	
   446	        // === STEP 1: Manual path (growing KV, all-ones mask) ===
   447	        resetDecoder();
   448	        INDArray tokenEmbed = embeddingTable.getRow(firstToken).reshape(1, 1, hiddenSize);
   449	        Map<String, INDArray> manualInputs = new HashMap<>();
   450	        for (String name : decoder.inputs()) {
   451	            if (name.equals("inputs_embeds")) manualInputs.put(name, tokenEmbed);
   452	            else if (name.equals("attention_mask")) manualInputs.put(name, Nd4j.ones(DataType.LONG, 1, seqLen + 1));
   453	            else if (name.equals("position_ids")) manualInputs.put(name, Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[]{seqLen}).reshape(1, 1));
   454	            else if (name.startsWith("past_key_values.") && manualKv.containsKey(name)) manualInputs.put(name, manualKv.get(name));
   455	        }
   456	        Map<String, INDArray> manualStep1 = decoder.output(manualInputs, logitsName);
   457	        INDArray manualLogits1 = manualStep1.get(logitsName).dup();
   458	        int manualToken1 = manualLogits1.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.all())
   459	                .argMax().getInt(0);
   460	
   461	        // === STEP 1: Padded path (full static KV, sparse mask) ===
   462	        resetDecoder();
   463	        long totalSeqLen = maxKvLen + 1;
   464	        INDArray sparseMask = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, totalSeqLen);
   465	        sparseMask.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.interval(0, seqLen)).assign(1);
   466	        sparseMask.putScalar(0, totalSeqLen - 1, 1); // current token
   467	
   468	        Map<String, INDArray> paddedInputs = new HashMap<>();
   469	        for (String name : decoder.inputs()) {
   470	            if (name.equals("inputs_embeds")) paddedInputs.put(name, tokenEmbed);
   471	            else if (name.equals("attention_mask")) paddedInputs.put(name, sparseMask);
   472	            else if (name.equals("position_ids")) paddedInputs.put(name, Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[]{seqLen}).reshape(1, 1));
   473	            else if (name.startsWith("past_key_values.") && staticKv.containsKey(name)) paddedInputs.put(name, staticKv.get(name));
   474	        }
   475	        Map<String, INDArray> paddedStep1 = decoder.output(paddedInputs, logitsName);
   476	        INDArray paddedLogits1 = paddedStep1.get(logitsName).dup();
   477	        int paddedToken1 = paddedLogits1.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.all())
   478	                .argMax().getInt(0);
   479	
   480	        // Compare
   481	        String manualText = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{manualToken1}, false);
   482	        String paddedText = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{paddedToken1}, false);
   483	        log.info("Step 1 comparison:");
   484	        log.info("  Manual (all-ones mask, growing KV):  token={} text='{}'", manualToken1, manualText);
   485	        log.info("  Padded (sparse mask, static KV):     token={} text='{}'", paddedToken1, paddedText);
   486	
   487	        // Compare top-5
   488	        INDArray manualL = manualLogits1.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.all());
   489	        INDArray paddedL = paddedLogits1.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.all());
   490	
   491	        double maxLogitDiff = manualL.sub(paddedL).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   492	        log.info("  Max logit difference: {}", maxLogitDiff);
   493	
   494	        if (manualToken1 != paddedToken1) {
   495	            log.warn("FINDING: Manual and padded paths produce DIFFERENT tokens at step 1!");
   496	            log.warn("  This means padded KV + sparse attention mask changes model behavior.");
   497	            log.warn("  Root cause: attn_mask_reformat with sparse mask produces different attention bias.");
   498	
   499	            // Log top-5 for each
   500	            logTop5("Manual", manualL);
   501	            logTop5("Padded", paddedL);
   502	        } else {
   503	            log.info("  Tokens MATCH at step 1.");
   504	        }
   505	
   506	        // Clean up static KV
   507	        for (INDArray buf : staticKv.values()) {
   508	            if (buf != null && !buf.wasClosed()) { buf.setCloseable(true); buf.close(); }
   509	        }
   510	        for (INDArray buf : manualKv.values()) {
   511	            if (buf != null && !buf.wasClosed()) { buf.setCloseable(true); buf.close(); }
   512	        }
   513	
   514	        assertEquals(manualToken1, paddedToken1,
   515	                "Padded path should produce same token as manual path at step 1. " +
   516	                        "Manual='" + manualText + "' Padded='" + paddedText + "' maxLogitDiff=" + maxLogitDiff);
   517	    }

   544	    // =========================================================================
   545	
   546	    @Test
   547	    @Order(8)
   548	    @DisplayName("8. Best Triton config: TRITON_compileAll_best_ATTN_gc_argOpt_batchOps")
   549	    public void testBestTritonConfig() {
   550	        if (!Nd4j.getNativeOps().isTritonAvailable()) {
   551	            log.info("Triton not available, skipping");
   552	            return;
   553	        }
   554	
   555	        List<Integer> expected = ensureManualDecodeTokens(REPLAY_PREFIX_TOKENS);

   558	        GenerationResult result = runConfiguredLoop(config, 100);
   559	
   560	        log.info("BEST TRITON -> {} tokens: '{}'", result.getGeneratedTokenCount(), result.getText());
   561	
   562	        Set<Integer> unique = new HashSet<>();
   563	        for (int id : result.getTokenIds()) unique.add(id);
   564	        double diversityPct = (double) unique.size() / result.getTokenIds().length * 100;
   565	        log.info("Unique: {}/{} ({}%)", unique.size(), result.getGeneratedTokenCount(),
   566	                String.format("%.1f", diversityPct));
   567	
   568	        // Performance
   569	        long decodeTokens = result.getGeneratedTokenCount();
   570	        double totalMs = result.getGenerationTimeMs();
   571	        double tokPerSec = decodeTokens > 0 ? decodeTokens * 1000.0 / totalMs : 0;
   572	        log.info("Performance: {} tok/s ({} tokens in {}ms)",
   573	                String.format("%.1f", tokPerSec), decodeTokens, String.format("%.0f", totalMs));
   574	
   575	        // Must produce at least 10 tokens
   576	        assertTrue(result.getGeneratedTokenCount() >= 10,
   577	                "Best Triton config should produce >= 10 tokens, got " + result.getGeneratedTokenCount());
   578	
   579	        assertTrue(decoder.isDspShapesFrozen(),
   580	                "Best Triton config should freeze shapes so decode runs through replay/outputDirect()");
   581	        assertTokenPrefixMatches("Best Triton batchOps", expected, result.getTokenIds(), REPLAY_PREFIX_TOKENS);
   582	
   583	        // Check for structural tags (doctag, text, section_header, etc.)
   584	        String text = result.getText();
   585	        boolean hasStructuralTag = text.contains("<doctag>") || text.contains("<text") ||
   586	                text.contains("<section_header") || text.contains("<page") || text.contains("<otsl");
   587	        assertTrue(hasStructuralTag,
   588	                "Output should contain SmolDocling structural tags. Got: '" + text + "'");
   589	    }

   593	    @DisplayName("9. Layer 4 repeat_kv boundary: step-2 SLOT_BY_SLOT vs OPTIMAL")
   594	    public void testLayer4RepeatKvBoundaryStep2() {
   595	        List<String> boundaryVars = List.of(
   596	                "/model/layers.4/attn/k_proj/repeat_kv/Reshape_2/output_0",
   597	                "/model/layers.4/attn/k_proj/repeat_kv/Where/output_0",
   598	                "/model/layers.4/attn/k_proj/repeat_kv/Expand/output_0",
   599	                "/model/layers.4/attn/k_proj/repeat_kv/Concat_3/output_0",
   600	                "/model/layers.4/attn/k_proj/repeat_kv/Reshape_3/output_0"
   601	        );
   602	
   603	        BenchmarkConfig slotBySlotConfig = BenchmarkConfig.create("layer4_repeat_kv_slot_by_slot")
   604	                .executionMode(GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT)
   605	                .maxTokens(4).minDiversityPct(0);
   606	
   607	        BenchmarkConfig optimalConfig = BenchmarkConfig.optimal()
   608	                .maxTokens(4).minDiversityPct(0);
   609	        BenchmarkConfig bestConfig = createBestTritonConfig("layer4_repeat_kv_best", 100);
   610	        List<String> preReshapeBoundaryVars = boundaryVars.subList(0, boundaryVars.size() - 1);
   611	
   612	        Map<String, INDArray> baseline = runDecodeStepOutputs(slotBySlotConfig, 2, boundaryVars, false, true);
   613	        try {
   614	            INDArray baselineReshape = baseline.get("/model/layers.4/attn/k_proj/repeat_kv/Reshape_3/output_0");
   615	            assertNotNull(baselineReshape, "SLOT_BY_SLOT must materialize layer-4 repeat_kv Reshape_3 at step 2");
   616	            long expectedSeqLen = benchmarkEmbeddings.shape()[1] + 2;
   617	            assertArrayEquals(new long[]{1, 9, expectedSeqLen, 64}, baselineReshape.shape(),
   618	                    "Baseline layer-4 repeat_kv Reshape_3 shape must match the expected repeated KV layout");
   619	
   620	            Map<String, INDArray> paddedSlotBySlot = runStaticPaddedDecodeStepOutputs(slotBySlotConfig, 2, 100,
   621	                    boundaryVars, false);
   622	            try {
   623	                List<String> paddedMismatches = new ArrayList<>();
   624	                for (String varName : boundaryVars) {
   625	                    INDArray ref = baseline.get(varName);
   626	                    INDArray test = paddedSlotBySlot.get(varName);
   627	                    assertNotNull(ref, "Missing growing-KV baseline capture for " + varName);
   628	                    assertNotNull(test, "Missing static-padded SLOT_BY_SLOT capture for " + varName);
   629	
   630	                    log.info("LAYER4_REPEAT_KV_PADDED step2 var='{}' baselineShape={} paddedShape={}",
   631	                            varName, Arrays.toString(ref.shape()), Arrays.toString(test.shape()));
   632	                    if (ref.length() <= 16 && test.length() <= 16) {
   633	                        log.info("  baseline={}", Arrays.toString(ref.toLongVector()));
   634	                        log.info("  padded={}", Arrays.toString(test.toLongVector()));
   635	                    }
   636	
   637	                    if (!Arrays.equals(ref.shape(), test.shape())) {
   638	                        paddedMismatches.add("shape mismatch for " + varName
   639	                                + " baseline=" + Arrays.toString(ref.shape())
   640	                                + " padded=" + Arrays.toString(test.shape()));
   641	                        continue;
   642	                    }
   643	
   644	                    var divergence = DspAccuracyValidator.compareArrays(
   645	                            ref, test, varName, "layer4_repeat_kv_padded_step2", 2, 0.0, 0.0, null);
   646	                    if (divergence != null) {
   647	                        paddedMismatches.add(divergence.toString());
   648	                    }
   649	                }
   650	                if (!paddedMismatches.isEmpty()) {
   651	                    log.warn("Static padded path diverges before replay:\n{}",
   652	                            String.join("\n", paddedMismatches));
   653	                }
   654	
   655	                Map<String, INDArray> paddedOptimal = runStaticPaddedDecodeStepOutputs(optimalConfig, 2, 100,
   656	                        preReshapeBoundaryVars, true);
   657	                try {
   658	                    List<String> replayMismatches = new ArrayList<>();
   659	                    for (String varName : preReshapeBoundaryVars) {
   660	                        INDArray ref = paddedSlotBySlot.get(varName);
   661	                        INDArray test = paddedOptimal.get(varName);
   662	                        assertNotNull(ref, "Missing static-padded SLOT_BY_SLOT capture for " + varName);
   663	                        assertNotNull(test, "Missing static-padded OPTIMAL capture for " + varName);
   664	
   665	                        log.info("LAYER4_REPEAT_KV_PADDED_OPTIMAL step2 var='{}' slotBySlotShape={} optimalShape={}",
   666	                                varName, Arrays.toString(ref.shape()), Arrays.toString(test.shape()));
   667	                        if (ref.length() <= 16 && test.length() <= 16) {
   668	                            log.info("  slotBySlot={}", Arrays.toString(ref.toLongVector()));
   669	                            log.info("  optimal={}", Arrays.toString(test.toLongVector()));
   670	                        }
   671	
   672	                        if (!Arrays.equals(ref.shape(), test.shape())) {
   673	                            replayMismatches.add("shape mismatch for " + varName
   674	                                    + " slotBySlot=" + Arrays.toString(ref.shape())
   675	                                    + " optimal=" + Arrays.toString(test.shape()));
   676	                            continue;
   677	                        }
   678	                        double absTol = varName.endsWith("/Expand/output_0")
   679	                                ? TF32_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE.getDefaultAbsTol()
   680	                                : 0.0;
   681	                        double relTol = varName.endsWith("/Expand/output_0")
   682	                                ? TF32_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE.getDefaultRelTol()
   683	                                : 0.0;
   684	                        var divergence = DspAccuracyValidator.compareArrays(
   685	                                ref, test, varName, "layer4_repeat_kv_padded_optimal_step2", 2, absTol, relTol, null);
   686	                        if (divergence != null) {
   687	                            replayMismatches.add(divergence.toString());
   688	                        }
   689	                    }
   690	                    if (!replayMismatches.isEmpty()) {
   691	                        fail("Static padded OPTIMAL diverges from padded SLOT_BY_SLOT before replay:\n"
   692	                                + String.join("\n", replayMismatches));
   693	                    }
   694	                } finally {
   695	                    closeAll(paddedOptimal);
   696	                }
   697	
   698	                Map<String, INDArray> paddedBest = runStaticPaddedDecodeStepOutputs(bestConfig, 2, 100,
   699	                        preReshapeBoundaryVars, true);
   700	                try {
   701	                    List<String> bestMismatches = new ArrayList<>();
   702	                    for (String varName : preReshapeBoundaryVars) {
   703	                        INDArray ref = paddedSlotBySlot.get(varName);

   710	                        if (ref.length() <= 16 && test.length() <= 16) {
   711	                            log.info("  slotBySlot={}", Arrays.toString(ref.toLongVector()));
   712	                            log.info("  best={}", Arrays.toString(test.toLongVector()));
   713	                        }
   714	
   715	                        if (!Arrays.equals(ref.shape(), test.shape())) {
   716	                            bestMismatches.add("shape mismatch for " + varName
   717	                                    + " slotBySlot=" + Arrays.toString(ref.shape())
   718	                                    + " best=" + Arrays.toString(test.shape()));
   719	                            continue;
   720	                        }
   721	                        double absTol = varName.endsWith("/Expand/output_0")
   722	                                ? TF32_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE.getDefaultAbsTol()

   724	                        double relTol = varName.endsWith("/Expand/output_0")
   725	                                ? TF32_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE.getDefaultRelTol()
   726	                                : 0.0;
   727	                        var divergence = DspAccuracyValidator.compareArrays(

   729	                        if (divergence != null) {
   730	                            bestMismatches.add(divergence.toString());

   732	                    }
   733	                    if (!bestMismatches.isEmpty()) {
   734	                        fail("Static padded BEST config diverges from padded SLOT_BY_SLOT before Reshape_3:\n"
   735	                                + String.join("\n", bestMismatches));
   736	                    }
   737	                } finally {
   738	                    closeAll(paddedBest);
   739	                }
   740	            } finally {
   741	                closeAll(paddedSlotBySlot);
   742	            }
   743	
   744	            Map<String, INDArray> optimal = runDecodeStepOutputs(optimalConfig, 2,
   745	                    boundaryVars.subList(0, boundaryVars.size() - 1), true, true);
   746	            try {
   747	                for (String varName : boundaryVars.subList(0, boundaryVars.size() - 1)) {
   748	                    INDArray ref = baseline.get(varName);
   749	                    INDArray test = optimal.get(varName);

   753	                    log.info("LAYER4_REPEAT_KV step2 var='{}' baselineShape={} optimalShape={}",

   755	                    if (ref.length() <= 16 && test.length() <= 16) {

   761	                    var divergence = DspAccuracyValidator.compareArrays(

   763	                    assertNull(divergence, "Value mismatch for " + varName + ": " + divergence);
