   813	    private INDArray buildBenchmarkEmbeddings() throws Exception {
   814	        BufferedImage image = createBenchmarkImage();
   815	        int targetSize = 512;
   816	        PreprocessorConfig ppConfig = new PreprocessorConfig();
   817	        ppConfig.setSize(new PreprocessorConfig.ImageSize(targetSize, targetSize));
   818	        ppConfig.setDoRescale(true);
   819	        ppConfig.setRescaleFactor(1.0 / 255.0);
   820	        ppConfig.setDoNormalize(true);
   821	        ppConfig.setImageMean(new double[]{0.5, 0.5, 0.5});
   822	        ppConfig.setImageStd(new double[]{0.5, 0.5, 0.5});
   823	        VLMImagePreprocessor preprocessor = VLMImagePreprocessor.fromConfig(ppConfig);
   824	
   825	        BufferedImage resized = ImageTiler.resizeLongestEdge(image, 2048);
   826	        ImageTiler.SplitImageResult splitResult = ImageTiler.splitImageForVLM(resized, targetSize, 9);
   827	
   828	        List<String> visionInputNames = visionEncoder.inputs();
   829	        String[] visionOutputNames = visionEncoder.outputs().toArray(new String[0]);
   830	        List<INDArray> frameEmbeddings = new ArrayList<>();
   831	
   832	        for (int i = 0; i < splitResult.getTotalFrames(); i++) {
   833	            BufferedImage frame = splitResult.frames.get(i);
   834	            INDArray frameTensor = preprocessor.preprocess(frame);
   835	            INDArray singleFrame = frameTensor.reshape(1, 1, 3, targetSize, targetSize);
   836	
   837	            Map<String, INDArray> visionInputMap = new HashMap<>();
   838	            for (String name : visionInputNames) {
   839	                if (name.equals("pixel_values")) {
   840	                    visionInputMap.put(name, singleFrame);
   841	                } else if (name.equals("pixel_attention_mask")) {
   842	                    ImageTiler.ContentRegion region = splitResult.contentRegions.get(i);
   843	                    visionInputMap.put(name,
   844	                            ImageTiler.createPixelAttentionMask(region.width, region.height, targetSize));
   845	                }
   846	            }
   847	
   848	            Map<String, INDArray> visionOutputs = visionEncoder.output(visionInputMap, visionOutputNames);
   849	            VisionEncoderUtils.VisionOutput selected = VisionEncoderUtils.selectVisionOutput(visionOutputs);
   850	            frameEmbeddings.add(selected.tensor.dup());
   851	
   852	            singleFrame.close();
   853	            visionEncoder.clearPlaceholders(false);
   854	            visionEncoder.clearOpInputs();
   855	            visionEncoder.resetSession();
   856	        }
   857	
   858	        INDArray visionEmbeddings = frameEmbeddings.size() == 1
   859	                ? frameEmbeddings.get(0).dup()
   860	                : Nd4j.concat(1, frameEmbeddings.toArray(new INDArray[0])).dup();
   861	        for (INDArray fe : frameEmbeddings) {
   862	            if (fe != null && fe.closeable() && !fe.wasClosed()) fe.close();
   863	        }
   864	
   865	        int imageTokenId = ImagePromptBuilder.resolveImageTokenId(tokenizer);
   866	        int imageSeqLen = (int) visionEmbeddings.shape()[1] / splitResult.getTotalFrames();
   867	        String imagePrompt = ImagePromptBuilder.buildImagePromptString(
   868	                splitResult.numRows, splitResult.numCols, imageSeqLen);
   869	        String chatPrompt = "<|im_start|>User:" + imagePrompt + "Convert this page to docling.<end_of_utterance>\nAssistant:";
   870	        int[] promptTokenIds = tokenizer.encode(chatPrompt, false).getIds();
   871	
   872	        String embedInputName = embedTokens.inputs().get(0);
   873	        String[] embedOutputNames = embedTokens.outputs().toArray(new String[0]);
   874	        INDArray promptIdsTensor = Nd4j.createFromArray(promptTokenIds)
   875	                .reshape(1, promptTokenIds.length).castTo(DataType.LONG);
   876	        Map<String, INDArray> embedOutputs = embedTokens.output(
   877	                Map.of(embedInputName, promptIdsTensor), embedOutputNames);
   878	        INDArray textEmbeddings = embedOutputs.values().iterator().next().dup();
   879	
   880	        return EmbeddingMerger.mergeEmbeddings(textEmbeddings, visionEmbeddings, promptTokenIds, imageTokenId);
   881	    }

   896	    private INDArray extractEmbeddingTable() {
   897	        INDArray embeddingTable = null;
   898	        for (SDVariable var : embedTokens.variables()) {
   899	            if (var.getVariableType() == VariableType.CONSTANT || var.getVariableType() == VariableType.VARIABLE) {
   900	                INDArray arr = var.getArr();
   901	                if (arr != null && arr.rank() == 2) {
   902	                    if (embeddingTable == null || arr.length() > embeddingTable.length()) {
   903	                        embeddingTable = arr;
   904	                    }
   905	                }
   906	            }
   907	        }
   908	        return embeddingTable;
   909	    }

   926	    private Map<String, INDArray> buildPrefillInputs(long seqLen) {
   927	        Map<String, INDArray> inputs = new HashMap<>();
   928	        for (String name : decoder.inputs()) {
   929	            if (name.equals("inputs_embeds")) inputs.put(name, benchmarkEmbeddings.dup());
   930	            else if (name.equals("attention_mask")) inputs.put(name, Nd4j.ones(DataType.LONG, 1, seqLen));
   931	            else if (name.equals("position_ids")) inputs.put(name, Nd4j.arange(seqLen).reshape(1, seqLen).castTo(DataType.LONG));
   932	            else if (name.startsWith("past_key_values.")) inputs.put(name, Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 3, 0, 64));
   933	        }
   934	        return inputs;
   935	    }

   937	    private void logTop5(String label, INDArray logits) {
   938	        int len = (int) logits.length();
   939	        int[] topIds = new int[5];
   940	        float[] topVals = new float[5];
   941	        Arrays.fill(topVals, Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
   942	
   943	        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   944	            float v = logits.getFloat(i);
   945	            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
   946	                if (v > topVals[j]) {
   947	                    System.arraycopy(topVals, j, topVals, j + 1, 4 - j);
   948	                    System.arraycopy(topIds, j, topIds, j + 1, 4 - j);
   949	                    topVals[j] = v;
   950	                    topIds[j] = i;
   951	                    break;
   952	                }
   953	            }
   954	        }
   955	
   956	        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   957	            String text = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{topIds[i]}, false);
   958	            log.info("  {} top-{}: id={} logit={} text='{}'", label, i + 1, topIds[i], topVals[i], text);
   959	        }
   960	    }

   962	    private List<Integer> ensureManualDecodeTokens(int requiredTokens) {
   963	        if (manualDecodeTokens == null || manualDecodeTokens.size() < requiredTokens) {
   964	            resetDecoder();
   965	            INDArray manualInputs = benchmarkEmbeddings.dup();
   966	            try {
   967	                manualDecodeTokens = manualDecode(manualInputs, Math.max(requiredTokens, 6));
   968	            } finally {
   969	                if (manualInputs.closeable() && !manualInputs.wasClosed()) {
   970	                    manualInputs.close();
   971	                }
   972	            }
   973	            resetDecoder();
   974	        }
   975	
   976	        assertNotNull(manualDecodeTokens, "Manual decode baseline must exist");
   977	        assertTrue(manualDecodeTokens.size() >= requiredTokens,
   978	                "Manual decode baseline produced only " + manualDecodeTokens.size()
   979	                        + " tokens, need at least " + requiredTokens);
   980	        return manualDecodeTokens;
   981	    }

   983	    private GenerationResult runConfiguredLoop(BenchmarkConfig config, int maxNewTokens) {
   984	        resetDecoder();
   985	        config.maxTokens(maxNewTokens);
   986	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.apply(config);
   987	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.compileModels(decoder, "decoder", embedTokens, "embed_tokens", config);
   988	
   989	        StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop loop = StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.builder()
   990	                .decoder(decoder)
   991	                .embedTokens(embedTokens)
   992	                .tokenizer(tokenizer)
   993	                .samplingConfig(SamplingConfig.greedy())
   994	                .maxNewTokens(maxNewTokens)
   995	                .hiddenSize((int) benchmarkEmbeddings.shape()[2])
   996	                .build();
   997	
   998	        INDArray decodeInputs = benchmarkEmbeddings.dup();
   999	        try {
  1000	            return loop.decode(decodeInputs, benchmarkPromptTokenIds);
  1001	        } finally {
  1002	            if (decodeInputs.closeable() && !decodeInputs.wasClosed()) {
  1003	                decodeInputs.close();
  1004	            }
  1005	        }
  1006	    }

  1008	    private BenchmarkConfig createBestTritonConfig(String name, int maxTokens) {
  1009	        return BenchmarkConfig.create(name)
  1010	                .tritonIncludeTypes("CONST_GEN,GATHER,CONCAT,SPLIT,STACK,ATTENTION")
  1011	                .tritonSectionFusion(true).tritonCompileAll(true)
  1012	                .tritonGraphCapture(true).tritonAllowFallbackCapture(true)
  1013	                .tritonConsolidatedArgTable(true).tritonArgDirtyTracking(true)
  1014	                .dspBatchZero(true).dspBatchZeroKernel(true)
  1015	                .dspBatchedGemm(true)
  1016	                .dspCastSinkMatmul(true)
  1017	                .maxTokens(maxTokens).minDiversityPct(0);
  1018	    }

  1020	    private Map<String, INDArray> runDecodeStepOutputs(BenchmarkConfig config, int targetStep,
  1021	                                                       List<String> requestedOutputs,
  1022	                                                       boolean useOutputDirect,
  1023	                                                       boolean includeIntermediateCompileOutputs) {
  1024	        resetDecoder();
  1025	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.apply(config);
  1026	
  1027	        String logitsName = findLogitsName();

   234	    // ========================================================================
   235	    // Core validation: run one subgraph across the execution mode matrix
   236	    // ========================================================================
   237	
   238	    private void runSubgraphMatrix(SameDiff sd, Map<String, INDArray> inputs, String label) {
   239	        // Reference: standard output() (no DSP)
   240	        Map<String, INDArray> refOutputs = sd.output(inputs, sd.outputs().toArray(new String[0]));
   241	        Map<String, INDArray> refDuped = dupAll(refOutputs);
   242	
   243	        // Test configs
   244	        BenchmarkConfig[] configs = {
   245	            BenchmarkConfig.create(label + "_triton")
   246	                    .tritonIncludeTypes("CONST_GEN,GATHER,CONCAT,SPLIT,STACK,ELEMENTWISE,SHAPE_MANIPULATION,ATTENTION,TILE,STRIDED_SLICE,REDUCTION,NORMALIZATION")
   247	                    .tritonSectionFusion(true)
   248	                    .tritonCompileAll(true)
   249	                    .tritonNumWarps(4)
   250	                    .tritonNumStages(1)
   251	                    .maxTokens(1).minDiversityPct(0),
   252	
   253	            BenchmarkConfig.create(label + "_optimal")
   254	                    .tritonIncludeTypes("CONST_GEN,GATHER,CONCAT,SPLIT,STACK,ELEMENTWISE,SHAPE_MANIPULATION,ATTENTION,TILE,STRIDED_SLICE,REDUCTION,NORMALIZATION")
   255	                    .tritonSectionFusion(true)
   256	                    .tritonCompileAll(true)
   257	                    .tritonNumWarps(4)
   258	                    .tritonNumStages(1)
   259	                    .tritonConsolidatedArgTable(true)
   260	                    .tritonArgDirtyTracking(true)
   261	                    .cublasTf32(true)
   262	                    .tritonTf32(true)
   263	                    .dspBatchedGemm(true)
   264	                    .maxTokens(1).minDiversityPct(0),
   265	        };
   266	
   267	        for (BenchmarkConfig config : configs) {
   268	            Map<String, INDArray> testOutputs = runWithConfig(sd, config, inputs);
   269	            compareSubgraphOutputs(label + "/" + config.getName(), refDuped, testOutputs);
   270	            closeAll(testOutputs);
   271	        }
   272	
   273	        closeAll(refDuped);
   274	    }
   275	
   276	    // ========================================================================
   277	    // Execution helpers
   278	    // ========================================================================
   279	
   280	    private Map<String, INDArray> runWithConfig(SameDiff sd, BenchmarkConfig config,
   281	                                                  Map<String, INDArray> inputs) {
   282	        sd.resetSession();
   283	        sd.clearDynamicShapePlanCache();
   284	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.apply(config);
   285	        sd.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   286	        sd.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   287	        sd.compileNativeDynamicShapePlan(sd.outputs(), config.getExecutionMode(), true);
   288	        Map<String, INDArray> result = sd.outputDirect(inputs, sd.outputs().toArray(new String[0]));
   289	        return dupAll(result);
   290	    }
   291	
   292	    private Map<String, INDArray> dupAll(Map<String, INDArray> outputs) {
   293	        Map<String, INDArray> duped = new LinkedHashMap<>();
   294	        for (Map.Entry<String, INDArray> e : outputs.entrySet()) {
   295	            duped.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue().dup());
   296	        }
   297	        return duped;
   298	    }
   299	
   300	    private void closeAll(Map<String, INDArray> outputs) {
   301	        for (INDArray arr : outputs.values()) {
   302	            if (arr != null && !arr.wasClosed()) { arr.setCloseable(true); arr.close(); }
   303	        }
   304	    }
   305	
   306	    private void compareSubgraphOutputs(String label,
   307	                                          Map<String, INDArray> reference,
   308	                                          Map<String, INDArray> test) {
   309	        for (Map.Entry<String, INDArray> entry : reference.entrySet()) {
   310	            String varName = entry.getKey();
   311	            INDArray refArr = entry.getValue();
   312	            INDArray testArr = test.get(varName);
   313	
   314	            assertNotNull(testArr, label + ": missing output " + varName);
   315	            assertArrayEquals(refArr.shape(), testArr.shape(),
   316	                    label + ": shape mismatch for " + varName);
   317	
   318	            if (refArr.dataType().isFPType()) {
   319	                INDArray refF = refArr.dataType() == DataType.FLOAT ? refArr : refArr.castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   320	                INDArray testF = testArr.dataType() == DataType.FLOAT ? testArr : testArr.castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   321	                INDArray diff = org.nd4j.linalg.ops.transforms.Transforms.abs(refF.sub(testF));
   322	                double maxDiff = diff.maxNumber().doubleValue();
   323	                double tol = TOLERANCE.getDefaultAbsTol();
   324	
   325	                if (refArr != refF && refArr.closeable()) refF.close();
   326	                if (testArr != testF && testArr.closeable()) testF.close();
   327	                diff.close();
   328	
   329	                log.info("[{}] {} maxDiff={:.6e} (tol={:.2e})", label, varName, maxDiff, tol);
   330	                assertTrue(maxDiff <= tol,
   331	                        String.format("%s: %s maxDiff=%.6e exceeds tol=%.6e",
   332	                                label, varName, maxDiff, tol));
   333	            }
   334	        }
   335	    }
   336	}

    46	/**
    47	 * Comprehensive test battery for DSP (DynamicShapePlan) slot lifecycle,
    48	 * buffer management, and re-execution correctness.
    49	 *
    50	 * <p>Exercises and validates:
    51	 * <ol>
    52	 *   <li>Slot output buffer validity - all output arrays have valid, non-closed DataBuffers</li>
    53	 *   <li>Cleanup effectiveness - pool stats before/after show GPU memory is freed</li>
    54	 *   <li>Re-execution correctness - same model, same inputs produce matching outputs</li>
    55	 *   <li>Constant array preservation - weight arrays survive cleanup with valid GPU memory</li>
    56	 *   <li>View chain integrity - reshape/permute ops produce valid views with live backing buffers</li>
    57	 *   <li>Segment boundary correctness - capturable segment outputs are valid after re-execution</li>
    58	 *   <li>Memory pool baseline recovery - after cleanup+trim, pool used returns near baseline</li>
    59	 * </ol>
    60	 *
    61	 * <p>Run:
    62	 * <pre>
    63	 *   cd platform-tests && mvn test \
    64	 *     -Dtest=TestDSPSlotLifecycle \
    65	 *     -Dbackend.artifactId=nd4j-cuda-12.9
    66	 * </pre>
    67	 */
    68	@Slf4j
    69	@Tag("long-running")
    70	@TestMethodOrder(MethodOrderer.OrderAnnotation.class)
    71	public class TestDSPSlotLifecycle {

    97	        }

   133	    /**
   134	     * Create a random pixel_values input tensor for the vision encoder.
   135	     * Shape: [batch=1, frames=1, channels=3, H, W]
   136	     */
   137	    private static INDArray createPixelValues() {
   138	        return Nd4j.rand(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 3, TARGET_SIZE, TARGET_SIZE);
   139	    }
   140	
   141	    /**
   142	     * Create a pixel attention mask.
   143	     * Shape: [batch=1, H, W]
   144	     */
   145	    private static INDArray createPixelMask() {
   146	        return Nd4j.ones(DataType.BOOL, 1, TARGET_SIZE, TARGET_SIZE);
   147	    }
   148	
   149	    /**
   150	     * Build the standard input map for the vision encoder.
   151	     */
   152	    private static Map<String, INDArray> createInputs(INDArray pixelValues, INDArray pixelMask) {
   153	        Map<String, INDArray> inputs = new LinkedHashMap<>();
   154	        inputs.put("pixel_values", pixelValues);
   155	        inputs.put("pixel_attention_mask", pixelMask);
   156	        return inputs;
   157	    }
   158	
   159	    /**
   160	     * Query GPU memory pool stats for the given device.
   161	     * Returns [poolUsedBytes, poolReservedBytes].
   162	     * Returns [0, 0] on CPU backend.
   163	     */
   164	    private static long[] getPoolStats(int deviceId) {
   165	        if (isCPU) {
   166	            return new long[]{0L, 0L};
   167	        }
   168	        try (LongPointer usedPtr = new LongPointer(1);
   169	             LongPointer reservedPtr = new LongPointer(1)) {
   170	            nativeOps.getMemoryPoolStats(deviceId, usedPtr, reservedPtr);
   171	            return new long[]{usedPtr.get(0), reservedPtr.get(0)};
   172	        }
   173	    }
   174	
   175	    /**
   176	     * Get device free memory in bytes.
   177	     * Returns Long.MAX_VALUE on CPU backend.
   178	     */
   179	    private static long getDeviceFreeMemory(int deviceId) {
   180	        if (isCPU) {
   181	            return Long.MAX_VALUE;
   182	        }
   183	        return nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemory(deviceId);
   184	    }
   185	
   186	    /**
   187	     * Trim the memory pool on the given device.
   188	     */
   189	    private static void trimPool(int deviceId) {
   190	        if (isCPU) {
   191	            return;
   192	        }
   193	        try {
   194	            nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(deviceId);
   195	        } catch (Exception e) {
   196	            log.warn("trimMemoryPool failed on device {}: {}", deviceId, e.getMessage());
   197	        }
   198	    }
   199	
   200	    /**
   201	     * Log GPU memory stats at a labeled checkpoint.
   202	     */
   203	    private static void logMemory(String label, int deviceId) {
   204	        if (isCPU) {
   205	            log.info("[{}] CPU backend — no GPU memory stats", label);
   206	            return;
   207	        }
   208	        try {
   209	            long[] pool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   210	            long freeMem = getDeviceFreeMemory(deviceId);
   211	            long totalMem = nativeOps.getDeviceTotalMemory(deviceId);
   212	            log.info("[{}] dev={}: poolUsed={}MB poolReserved={}MB devUsed={}MB devFree={}MB",
   213	                    label, deviceId,
   214	                    pool[0] / (1024 * 1024), pool[1] / (1024 * 1024),
   215	                    (totalMem - freeMem) / (1024 * 1024), freeMem / (1024 * 1024));
   216	        } catch (Exception e) {
   217	            log.debug("Could not query GPU memory for label '{}': {}", label, e.getMessage());
   218	        }
   219	    }
   220	
   221	    /**
   222	     * Validate that an output array has a valid, non-closed DataBuffer.
   223	     * On CUDA, also checks that the GPU (special) buffer pointer exists.
   224	     */
   225	    private static void assertBufferValid(INDArray arr, String context) {
   226	        assertNotNull(arr, context + ": array is null");
   227	        assertFalse(arr.wasClosed(), context + ": array is closed");
   228	        assertTrue(arr.length() > 0, context + ": array has zero length");
   229	
   230	        DataBuffer db = arr.data();
   231	        assertNotNull(db, context + ": DataBuffer is null");
   232	        assertFalse(db.wasClosed(), context + ": DataBuffer is closed");
   233	
   234	        // On CUDA backends, verify the GPU buffer pointer is non-null
   235	        if (!isCPU) {
   236	            try {
   237	                assertNotNull(db.pointer(), context + ": DataBuffer pointer() is null");
   238	                assertTrue(db.address() != 0, context + ": DataBuffer address is 0");
   239	            } catch (Exception e) {
   240	                // If pointer access throws, the buffer is likely freed
   241	                fail(context + ": DataBuffer pointer access failed — buffer may be freed: " + e.getMessage());
   242	            }
   243	        }
   244	    }
   245	
   246	    /**
   247	     * Close all arrays in an output map safely.
   248	     */
   249	    private static void closeOutputs(Map<String, INDArray> outputs) {
   250	        for (INDArray a : outputs.values()) {
   251	            if (a != null && !a.wasClosed()) {
   252	                a.setCloseable(true);
   253	                a.close();
   254	            }
   255	        }
   256	    }
   257	
   258	    /**
   259	     * Freeze DSP shapes on the current thread's session.
   260	     */
   261	    private void freezeDspShapes(SameDiff sd) {
   262	        try {
   263	            var sessionsField = SameDiff.class.getDeclaredField("sessions");
   264	            sessionsField.setAccessible(true);
   265	            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
   266	            Map<Long, InferenceSession> sessions = (Map<Long, InferenceSession>) sessionsField.get(sd);
   267	            InferenceSession session = sessions.get(Thread.currentThread().getId());
   268	            if (session != null) {
   269	                DynamicShapePlanExecutor dsp = session.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor();
   270	                if (dsp != null) {
   271	                    dsp.setShapesFrozen(true);
   272	                    log.info("Froze DSP shapes");
   273	                }
   274	            }
   275	        } catch (Exception e) {
   276	            log.warn("Could not freeze DSP shapes: {}", e.getMessage());
   277	        }
   278	    }
   279	
   280	    /**
   281	     * Unfreeze DSP shapes on the current thread's session.
   282	     */
   283	    private void unfreezeDspShapes(SameDiff sd) {
   284	        try {
   285	            var sessionsField = SameDiff.class.getDeclaredField("sessions");
   286	            sessionsField.setAccessible(true);
   287	            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
   288	            Map<Long, InferenceSession> sessions = (Map<Long, InferenceSession>) sessionsField.get(sd);
   289	            InferenceSession session = sessions.get(Thread.currentThread().getId());
   290	            if (session != null) {
   291	                DynamicShapePlanExecutor dsp = session.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor();
   292	                if (dsp != null) {
   293	                    dsp.setShapesFrozen(false);
   294	                    log.info("Unfroze DSP shapes");
   295	                }
   296	            }
   297	        } catch (Exception e) {
   298	            log.warn("Could not unfreeze DSP shapes: {}", e.getMessage());
   299	        }
   300	    }

   302	    // =========================================================================
   303	    // Test 1: Slot output buffer validity after each execution
   304	    // =========================================================================
   305	
   306	    @Test
   307	    @Order(1)
   308	    @DisplayName("Slot output buffers are valid (non-null, non-closed) after each execution")
   309	    public void testSlotOutputBufferValidity() {
   310	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(modelsLoaded, "Models not loaded — skipping");
   311	
   312	        int numExecutions = 3;
   313	        for (int exec = 1; exec <= numExecutions; exec++) {
   314	            log.info("--- Execution {}/{}: checking output buffer validity ---", exec, numExecutions);
   315	
   316	            INDArray pixelValues = createPixelValues();
   317	            INDArray pixelMask = createPixelMask();
   318	            Map<String, INDArray> inputs = createInputs(pixelValues, pixelMask);
   319	
   320	            Map<String, INDArray> outputs;
   321	            try {
   322	                outputs = visionEncoder.output(inputs, OUTPUT_NAMES);
   323	            } catch (Exception e) {
   324	                fail("Execution " + exec + " failed: " + e.getMessage(), e);
   325	                return;
   326	            }
   327	
   328	            // Validate every output array's buffer
   329	            for (Map.Entry<String, INDArray> entry : outputs.entrySet()) {
   330	                String name = entry.getKey();
   331	                INDArray arr = entry.getValue();
   332	                String ctx = "Exec " + exec + ", output '" + name + "'";
   333	
   334	                assertBufferValid(arr, ctx);
   335	
   336	                // Verify we can actually read the data (forces device-to-host sync on CUDA)
   337	                double sum = arr.sumNumber().doubleValue();
   338	                assertFalse(Double.isNaN(sum), ctx + ": sum is NaN (invalid data)");
   339	                assertFalse(Double.isInfinite(sum), ctx + ": sum is Inf (invalid data)");
   340	                log.info("{}: shape={}, sum={}", ctx, Arrays.toString(arr.shape()), sum);
   341	            }
   342	
   343	            // Clean up for next iteration
   344	            closeOutputs(outputs);
   345	            pixelValues.close();
   346	            pixelMask.close();
   347	        }
   348	
   349	        log.info("Slot output buffer validity test PASSED for {} executions", numExecutions);
   350	    }

   352	    // =========================================================================
   353	    // Test 2: Cleanup effectiveness - pool stats before/after
   354	    // =========================================================================
   355	
   356	    @Test
   357	    @Order(2)
   358	    @DisplayName("Cleanup effectiveness: GPU memory pool used drops after output closure and trim")
   359	    public void testCleanupEffectiveness() {
   360	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(modelsLoaded, "Models not loaded — skipping");
   361	
   362	        int deviceId = 0;
   363	
   364	        // Establish baseline: run once, close outputs, trim
   365	        INDArray pv0 = createPixelValues();
   366	        INDArray mask0 = createPixelMask();
   367	        Map<String, INDArray> warmup = visionEncoder.output(createInputs(pv0, mask0), OUTPUT_NAMES);
   368	        assertNotNull(warmup.get("image_features"), "Warmup execution failed");
   369	        closeOutputs(warmup);
   370	        pv0.close();
   371	        mask0.close();
   372	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   373	        trimPool(deviceId);
   374	        logMemory("Baseline after warmup+trim", deviceId);
   375	        long[] baselinePool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   376	
   377	        // Execute again — this will allocate intermediates and output buffers
   378	        INDArray pv1 = createPixelValues();
   379	        INDArray mask1 = createPixelMask();
   380	        Map<String, INDArray> out1 = visionEncoder.output(createInputs(pv1, mask1), OUTPUT_NAMES);
   381	        assertNotNull(out1.get("image_features"), "Post-baseline execution failed");
   382	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   383	        logMemory("After execution (before cleanup)", deviceId);
   384	        long[] afterExecPool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   385	
   386	        // Close outputs — should free output buffers back to pool
   387	        closeOutputs(out1);
   388	        pv1.close();
   389	        mask1.close();
   390	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   391	        logMemory("After close (before trim)", deviceId);
   392	        long[] afterClosePool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   393	
   394	        // Trim pool — should release freed blocks back to device
   395	        trimPool(deviceId);
   396	        logMemory("After trim", deviceId);
   397	        long[] afterTrimPool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   398	
   399	        if (!isCPU) {
   400	            // After closing outputs, pool used should not have grown compared to
   401	            // post-exec (some memory returned to pool's free list)
   402	            log.info("Pool used: baseline={}MB afterExec={}MB afterClose={}MB afterTrim={}MB",
   403	                    baselinePool[0] / (1024 * 1024),
   404	                    afterExecPool[0] / (1024 * 1024),
   405	                    afterClosePool[0] / (1024 * 1024),
   406	                    afterTrimPool[0] / (1024 * 1024));
   407	
   408	            // After trim, pool used should be closer to baseline than afterExec
   409	            // Allow generous tolerance — the key invariant is that trim reduces usage
   410	            long growthAfterExec = afterExecPool[0] - baselinePool[0];
   411	            long growthAfterTrim = afterTrimPool[0] - baselinePool[0];
   412	            if (growthAfterExec > 0) {
   413	                double recoveryRatio = 1.0 - ((double) growthAfterTrim / growthAfterExec);
   414	                log.info("Memory recovery ratio after trim: {}", String.format("%.2f", recoveryRatio));
   415	                // We expect at least some recovery. Constants and cached plan data will remain.
   416	                assertTrue(growthAfterTrim <= growthAfterExec,
   417	                        "Pool used grew after trim: afterExec=" + afterExecPool[0] / (1024 * 1024) +
   418	                                "MB, afterTrim=" + afterTrimPool[0] / (1024 * 1024) + "MB");
   419	            }
   420	        } else {
   421	            log.info("CPU backend — skipping GPU pool stat assertions");
   422	        }
   423	
   424	        log.info("Cleanup effectiveness test PASSED");
   425	    }

   427	    // =========================================================================
   428	    // Test 3: Re-execution correctness - deterministic outputs for same input
   429	    // =========================================================================
   430	
   431	    @Test
   432	    @Order(3)
   433	    @DisplayName("Re-execution correctness: same input produces matching outputs within tolerance")
   434	    public void testReExecutionCorrectness() {
   435	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(modelsLoaded, "Models not loaded — skipping");
   436	
   437	        // Use a fixed seed for reproducible input
   438	        Nd4j.getRandom().setSeed(42);
   439	        INDArray fixedInput = Nd4j.rand(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 3, TARGET_SIZE, TARGET_SIZE);
   440	        INDArray mask = createPixelMask();
   441	
   442	        int numRuns = 4;
   443	        double[] sums = new double[numRuns];
   444	        long[][] shapes = new long[numRuns][];
   445	        INDArray firstOutput = null;
   446	
   447	        for (int run = 0; run < numRuns; run++) {
   448	            log.info("--- Re-execution run {}/{} ---", run + 1, numRuns);
   449	
   450	            // Clone the fixed input so each run starts with identical data
   451	            INDArray inputClone = fixedInput.dup();
   452	            INDArray maskClone = mask.dup();
   453	
   454	            Map<String, INDArray> outputs = visionEncoder.output(
   455	                    createInputs(inputClone, maskClone), OUTPUT_NAMES);
   456	
   457	            INDArray features = outputs.get("image_features");
   458	            assertNotNull(features, "Run " + (run + 1) + ": output is null");
   459	            assertBufferValid(features, "Run " + (run + 1));
   460	
   461	            sums[run] = features.sumNumber().doubleValue();
   462	            shapes[run] = features.shape();
   463	            assertFalse(Double.isNaN(sums[run]), "Run " + (run + 1) + ": NaN in output");
   464	
   465	            log.info("Run {}: shape={}, sum={}", run + 1, Arrays.toString(shapes[run]), sums[run]);
   466	
   467	            if (run == 0) {
   468	                // Keep first output for element-wise comparison
   469	                firstOutput = features.dup();
   470	            } else {
   471	                // Shape must match across all runs
   472	                assertArrayEquals(shapes[0], shapes[run],
   473	                        "Shape mismatch: run 1=" + Arrays.toString(shapes[0]) +
   474	                                " vs run " + (run + 1) + "=" + Arrays.toString(shapes[run]));
   475	
   476	                // Values should be identical for deterministic ops with same input
   477	                // Use a tolerance for floating-point accumulation differences
   478	                double absDiff = Math.abs(sums[run] - sums[0]);
   479	                double relTol = Math.abs(sums[0]) * 1e-4; // 0.01% relative tolerance
   480	                assertTrue(absDiff < relTol + 1e-3,
   481	                        "Output values diverged: run 1 sum=" + sums[0] +
   482	                                " vs run " + (run + 1) + " sum=" + sums[run] +
   483	                                " (absDiff=" + absDiff + ", relTol=" + relTol + ")");
   484	
   485	                // Element-wise comparison on a subset (first 100 elements)
   486	                INDArray flat1 = firstOutput.reshape(-1);
   487	                INDArray flatN = features.reshape(-1);
   488	                long numToCheck = Math.min(100, flat1.length());
   489	                for (long i = 0; i < numToCheck; i++) {
   490	                    double v1 = flat1.getDouble(i);
   491	                    double vN = flatN.getDouble(i);
   492	                    double elemDiff = Math.abs(v1 - vN);
   493	                    assertTrue(elemDiff < 1e-3,
   494	                            "Element " + i + " diverged: run1=" + v1 + " vs run" +
   495	                                    (run + 1) + "=" + vN + " (diff=" + elemDiff + ")");
   496	                }
   497	            }
   498	
   499	            // Close this run's outputs (but not firstOutput which we kept)
   500	            inputClone.close();
   501	            maskClone.close();
   502	            closeOutputs(outputs);
   503	        }
   504	
   505	        // Clean up
   506	        if (firstOutput != null && !firstOutput.wasClosed()) {
   507	            firstOutput.close();
   508	        }
   509	        fixedInput.close();
   510	        mask.close();
   511	
   512	        log.info("Re-execution correctness test PASSED across {} runs", numRuns);
   513	    }

   557	            closeOutputs(outputs);
   558	            pv.close();
   559	            mask.close();
   560	        }
   561	
   562	        // Trim pool to force cleanup
   563	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   564	        trimPool(deviceId);
   565	        logMemory("After 2 executions + trim", deviceId);
   566	
   567	        // Verify constants survived with valid buffers and unchanged values
   568	        int checked = 0;
   569	        int preserved = 0;
   570	        for (SDVariable constant : sampled) {
   571	            String name = constant.name();
   572	            INDArray arr = constant.getArr();
   573	            if (arr == null || arr.isEmpty()) {
   574	                continue;
   575	            }
   576	            checked++;
   577	
   578	            // Buffer validity check
   579	            assertFalse(arr.wasClosed(),
   580	                    "Constant '" + name + "' was closed after cleanup");
   581	
   582	            DataBuffer db = arr.data();
   583	            assertNotNull(db, "Constant '" + name + "' has null DataBuffer after cleanup");
   584	            assertFalse(db.wasClosed(),
   585	                    "Constant '" + name + "' DataBuffer is closed after cleanup");
   586	
   587	            // On CUDA, check GPU pointer is still valid
   588	            if (!isCPU) {
   589	                try {
   590	                    assertTrue(db.address() != 0,
   591	                            "Constant '" + name + "' has zero address after cleanup");
   592	                } catch (Exception e) {
   593	                    fail("Constant '" + name + "' buffer access failed after cleanup: " + e.getMessage());
   594	                }
   595	            }
   596	
   597	            // Value preservation check
   598	            if (preExecSums.containsKey(name)) {
   599	                double postSum = arr.sumNumber().doubleValue();
   600	                double preSum = preExecSums.get(name);
   601	                long[] preShape = preExecShapes.get(name);
   602	
   603	                assertArrayEquals(preShape, arr.shape(),
   604	                        "Constant '" + name + "' shape changed: " +
   605	                                Arrays.toString(preShape) + " -> " + Arrays.toString(arr.shape()));
   606	
   607	                double diff = Math.abs(postSum - preSum);
   608	                assertTrue(diff < 1e-5,
   609	                        "Constant '" + name + "' value changed: preSum=" + preSum +
   610	                                " postSum=" + postSum + " diff=" + diff);
   611	                preserved++;
   612	            }
   613	        }
   614	
   615	        log.info("Constant preservation: checked={}, values preserved={}/{}", checked, preserved, preExecSums.size());
   616	        assertTrue(preserved > 0, "No constants were verified as preserved");
   617	        log.info("Constant array preservation test PASSED");
   618	    }

   624	    @Test

   626	    @DisplayName("View chain integrity: reshape/permute outputs have valid non-freed backing buffers")
   627	    public void testViewChainIntegrity() {
   628	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(modelsLoaded, "Models not loaded — skipping");
   629	
   630	        // Execute and get all intermediate arrays by requesting output
   631	        INDArray pixelValues = createPixelValues();

   634	        Map<String, INDArray> outputs = visionEncoder.output(
   635	                createInputs(pixelValues, pixelMask), OUTPUT_NAMES);

   637	        INDArray features = outputs.get("image_features");
   638	        assertNotNull(features, "Output is null");
   639	        assertBufferValid(features, "image_features output");
   640	
   641	        // Create view operations on the output to verify view chain integrity
   642	        // These simulate what downstream ops (decoder input preparation) would do
   643	        log.info("Output shape: {}", Arrays.toString(features.shape()));
   644	
   645	        // Test reshape view
   646	        long totalElements = features.length();
   647	        INDArray reshaped = features.reshape(1, -1);
   648	        assertBufferValid(reshaped, "reshaped view [1, -1]");
   649	        assertEquals(totalElements, reshaped.length(),
   650	                "Reshape changed total elements");
   651	        log.info("Reshape [1, -1]: shape={}, valid", Arrays.toString(reshaped.shape()));
   652	
   653	        // Test that the reshaped view shares backing buffer with original
   654	        assertEquals(features.data().address(), reshaped.data().address(),
   655	                "Reshape view should share backing buffer address with original");
   656	
   657	        // Test permute view (if rank >= 3)
   658	        if (features.rank() >= 3) {
   659	            long[] permutation = new long[features.rank()];
   660	            // Reverse dimension order
   661	            for (int i = 0; i < features.rank(); i++) {
   662	                permutation[i] = features.rank() - 1 - i;
   663	            }
   664	            INDArray permuted = features.permute(permutation);
   665	            assertBufferValid(permuted, "permuted view");
   666	            assertEquals(features.length(), permuted.length(),
   667	                    "Permute changed total elements");
   668	            log.info("Permute {}: shape={}, valid",
   669	                    Arrays.toString(permutation), Arrays.toString(permuted.shape()));
   670	
   671	            // Verify shared backing buffer
   672	            assertEquals(features.data().address(), permuted.data().address(),
   673	                    "Permute view should share backing buffer address with original");
   674	        }
   675	
   676	        // Test slice view
   677	        if (features.rank() >= 2 && features.size(0) > 0) {
   678	            INDArray slice = features.slice(0, 0);
   679	            assertBufferValid(slice, "slice(0, 0) view");
   680	            log.info("Slice [0, 0]: shape={}, valid", Arrays.toString(slice.shape()));
   681	        }
   682	
   683	        // Verify that after reading all views, the original is still valid
   684	        assertBufferValid(features, "original after view reads");
   685	        double sum = features.sumNumber().doubleValue();
   686	        assertFalse(Double.isNaN(sum), "Original output corrupted after view operations");
   687	        log.info("Original output still valid after view chain: sum={}", sum);
   688	
   689	        // Cleanup
   690	        closeOutputs(outputs);
   691	        pixelValues.close();
   692	        pixelMask.close();
   693	
   694	        log.info("View chain integrity test PASSED");
   695	    }

   740	                        e.getMessage(), e);
   741	                return;
   742	            }
   743	
   744	            INDArray features = out.get("image_features");
   745	            assertBufferValid(features, "Exec " + exec + " image_features");
   746	
   747	            // Shape must be identical to exec 1 (segments define shapes)
   748	            assertArrayEquals(shape1, features.shape(),
   749	                    "Shape changed at exec " + exec + ": expected " +
   750	                            Arrays.toString(shape1) + " got " + Arrays.toString(features.shape()));
   751	
   752	            // Output should be numerically valid
   753	            double sum = features.sumNumber().doubleValue();
   754	            assertFalse(Double.isNaN(sum), "Exec " + exec + ": NaN in segment output");
   755	            assertFalse(Double.isInfinite(sum), "Exec " + exec + ": Inf in segment output");

   765	        log.info("Segment boundary correctness test PASSED");
   766	    }

   769	    // Test 7: Memory pool baseline recovery after cleanup + trim
   770	    // =========================================================================
   771	
   772	    @Test
   773	    @Order(7)
   774	    @DisplayName("Memory pool baseline recovery: pool used returns near baseline after cleanup+trim")
   775	    public void testMemoryPoolBaselineRecovery() {
   776	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(modelsLoaded, "Models not loaded — skipping");
   777	
   778	        int deviceId = 0;
   779	
   780	        // Phase 1: Establish baseline
   781	        // Run a warmup, close everything, trim aggressively
   782	        INDArray pvWarm = createPixelValues();
   783	        INDArray maskWarm = createPixelMask();
   784	        Map<String, INDArray> warmup = visionEncoder.output(createInputs(pvWarm, maskWarm), OUTPUT_NAMES);
   785	        assertNotNull(warmup.get("image_features"), "Warmup failed");
   786	        closeOutputs(warmup);
   787	        pvWarm.close();
   788	        maskWarm.close();
   789	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   790	        trimPool(deviceId);
   791	        logMemory("Phase 1: Baseline", deviceId);
   792	        long[] baselinePool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   793	        long baselineDevFree = getDeviceFreeMemory(deviceId);
   794	
   795	        // Phase 2: Execute multiple times to accumulate allocations
   796	        int numAllocationRuns = 5;
   797	        for (int i = 0; i < numAllocationRuns; i++) {
   798	            INDArray pv = createPixelValues();
   799	            INDArray mask = createPixelMask();
   800	            Map<String, INDArray> out = visionEncoder.output(createInputs(pv, mask), OUTPUT_NAMES);
   801	            assertNotNull(out.get("image_features"), "Allocation run " + (i + 1) + " failed");
   802	            closeOutputs(out);
   803	            pv.close();
   804	            mask.close();
   805	        }
   806	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   807	        logMemory("Phase 2: After " + numAllocationRuns + " allocations (before trim)", deviceId);
   808	        long[] afterAllocPool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   809	
   810	        // Phase 3: Trim and check recovery
   811	        trimPool(deviceId);
   812	        logMemory("Phase 3: After trim", deviceId);
   813	        long[] afterTrimPool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   814	        long afterTrimDevFree = getDeviceFreeMemory(deviceId);
   815	
   816	        if (!isCPU) {
   817	            long baseUsed = baselinePool[0];
   818	            long afterAllocUsed = afterAllocPool[0];
   819	            long afterTrimUsed = afterTrimPool[0];
   820	
   821	            log.info("Pool used: baseline={}MB afterAlloc={}MB afterTrim={}MB",
   822	                    baseUsed / (1024 * 1024),
   823	                    afterAllocUsed / (1024 * 1024),
   824	                    afterTrimUsed / (1024 * 1024));
   825	
   826	            // Key invariant: pool used should NOT grow monotonically.
   827	            // After trim, pool used should be no more than the baseline + a constant
   828	            // overhead for DSP plan caches and compiled segments.
   829	            // Allow 500MB headroom for plan/segment cache overhead.
   830	            long maxAcceptableOverhead = 500L * 1024 * 1024;
   831	            assertTrue(afterTrimUsed < baseUsed + maxAcceptableOverhead,
   832	                    "Pool used did not recover to near baseline: baseline=" +
   833	                            baseUsed / (1024 * 1024) + "MB, afterTrim=" +
   834	                            afterTrimUsed / (1024 * 1024) + "MB, maxOverhead=" +
   835	                            maxAcceptableOverhead / (1024 * 1024) + "MB");
   836	
   837	            // Device free memory should also recover (within tolerance for fragmentation)
   838	            log.info("Device free: baseline={}MB afterTrim={}MB",
   839	                    baselineDevFree / (1024 * 1024),
   840	                    afterTrimDevFree / (1024 * 1024));
   841	        } else {
   842	            log.info("CPU backend — skipping GPU pool recovery assertions");
   843	        }
   844	
   845	        log.info("Memory pool baseline recovery test PASSED");
   846	    }

   849	    // Test 8: Pool used does NOT grow monotonically across iterations
   850	    // =========================================================================
   851	
   852	    @Test
   853	    @Order(8)
   854	    @DisplayName("Pool growth tracking: pool used does not grow monotonically over 8 iterations")
   855	    public void testPoolUsedNotMonotonic() {
   856	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(modelsLoaded, "Models not loaded — skipping");
   857	
   858	        int deviceId = 0;
   859	        int numIterations = 8;
   860	
   861	        // Warmup and baseline
   862	        INDArray pvWarm = createPixelValues();
   863	        INDArray maskWarm = createPixelMask();
   864	        Map<String, INDArray> warmup = visionEncoder.output(createInputs(pvWarm, maskWarm), OUTPUT_NAMES);
   865	        assertNotNull(warmup.get("image_features"), "Warmup failed");
   866	        closeOutputs(warmup);
   867	        pvWarm.close();
   868	        maskWarm.close();
   869	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   870	        trimPool(deviceId);
   871	
   872	        long[] poolUsedPerIteration = new long[numIterations];
   873	        long[] devFreePerIteration = new long[numIterations];
   874	
   875	        for (int i = 0; i < numIterations; i++) {
   876	            INDArray pv = createPixelValues();
   877	            INDArray mask = createPixelMask();
   878	            Map<String, INDArray> out = visionEncoder.output(createInputs(pv, mask), OUTPUT_NAMES);
   879	
   880	            INDArray features = out.get("image_features");
   881	            assertNotNull(features, "Iteration " + (i + 1) + ": null output");
   882	            assertBufferValid(features, "Iteration " + (i + 1));
   883	
   884	            // Close outputs between iterations (simulates real usage)
   885	            closeOutputs(out);
   886	            pv.close();
   887	            mask.close();
   888	            Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   889	
   890	            // Record stats after cleanup
   891	            long[] pool = getPoolStats(deviceId);
   892	            poolUsedPerIteration[i] = pool[0];
   893	            devFreePerIteration[i] = getDeviceFreeMemory(deviceId);
   894	
   895	            log.info("Iteration {}: poolUsed={}MB devFree={}MB",
   896	                    i + 1,
   897	                    pool[0] / (1024 * 1024),
   898	                    devFreePerIteration[i] / (1024 * 1024));
   899	        }
   900	
   901	        if (!isCPU) {
   902	            // Count strictly monotonic increases (each iteration uses more than previous)
   903	            int monotonicIncreases = 0;
   904	            for (int i = 1; i < numIterations; i++) {
   905	                // Consider it monotonically increasing if growth is >1MB per iteration
   906	                if (poolUsedPerIteration[i] > poolUsedPerIteration[i - 1] + 1024 * 1024) {
   907	                    monotonicIncreases++;
   908	                }
   909	            }
   910	
   911	            log.info("Monotonic pool increases: {}/{} (max acceptable: {})",
   912	                    monotonicIncreases, numIterations - 1, numIterations - 2);
   913	
   914	            // If ALL transitions are monotonically increasing, that is a memory leak.
   915	            // Allow at most N-2 increases (i.e., at least one stabilization/decrease).
   916	            assertTrue(monotonicIncreases < numIterations - 1,
   917	                    "Pool used grew monotonically every single iteration (" +
   918	                            monotonicIncreases + "/" + (numIterations - 1) +
   919	                            ") — this indicates a memory leak. " +
   920	                            "First=" + poolUsedPerIteration[0] / (1024 * 1024) + "MB, " +
   921	                            "Last=" + poolUsedPerIteration[numIterations - 1] / (1024 * 1024) + "MB");
   922	
   923	            // Also check total growth: should not exceed 2x from first to last
   924	            long totalGrowth = poolUsedPerIteration[numIterations - 1] - poolUsedPerIteration[0];
   925	            log.info("Total pool growth over {} iterations: {}MB",
   926	                    numIterations, totalGrowth / (1024 * 1024));
   927	        } else {
   928	            log.info("CPU backend — skipping monotonic pool growth assertions");
   929	        }
   930	
   931	        log.info("Pool growth tracking test PASSED across {} iterations", numIterations);
   932	    }
   933	}

   139	        if (decoder != null) decoder.close();
   140	    }
   141	
   142	    @AfterEach
   143	    public void cleanupBetweenTests() {
   144	        // Free cached native plan handles + reset sessions + trim GPU memory pool.
   145	        // resetSession() alone only clears Java-side state — the native plan handles
   146	        // (and their ~512MB capture buffers per segment) stay cached. We must free
   147	        // them explicitly so later tests have enough GPU memory.
   148	        log.info("=== Inter-test GPU cleanup ===");
   149	        logGpuMemory("Before inter-test cleanup");
   150	        // Order matters: resetSession() closes the executor which CACHES the
   151	        // native plan handle. freeAllCachedNativePlanHandles() then frees it.
   152	        if (visionEncoder != null) {
   153	            visionEncoder.resetSession();
   154	            visionEncoder.freeAllCachedNativePlanHandles();
   155	        }
   156	        if (embedTokens != null) {
   157	            embedTokens.resetSession();
   158	            embedTokens.freeAllCachedNativePlanHandles();
   159	        }
   160	        if (decoder != null) {
   161	            decoder.resetSession();
   162	            decoder.freeAllCachedNativePlanHandles();
   163	        }
   164	        try {
   165	            Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   166	            int numDevices = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getNumberOfDevices();
   167	            for (int d = 0; d < numDevices; d++) {
   168	                nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(d);
   169	            }
   170	            log.info("Trimmed memory pool on {} devices after test", numDevices);
   171	        } catch (Exception e) {
   172	            log.warn("Post-test trimMemoryPool failed: {}", e.getMessage());
   173	        }
   174	        logGpuMemory("After inter-test cleanup");
   175	    }
   176	
   177	    private static void logGpuMemory(String label) {
   178	        try {
   179	            int numDevices = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getNumberOfDevices();
   180	            for (int d = 0; d < numDevices; d++) {
   181	                long freeMem = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemory(d);
   182	                long totalMem = nativeOps.getDeviceTotalMemory(d);
   183	                log.info("[{}] Device {}: used={} MB, free={} MB",
   184	                        label, d,
   185	                        (totalMem - freeMem) / (1024 * 1024),
   186	                        freeMem / (1024 * 1024));
   187	            }
   188	        } catch (Exception e) {
   189	            log.debug("Could not query GPU memory: {}", e.getMessage());
   190	        }
   191	    }

   194	    // Test 1: Vision encoder called 3 times without session reset
   195	    // This is THE bug reproducer — page 2 fails with "Unknown DataType"
   196	    // =========================================================================
   197	
   198	    @Test
   199	    @Order(1)
   200	    @DisplayName("Vision encoder: 3 consecutive calls without session reset (page reuse)")
   201	    public void testVisionEncoderThreeCallsNoReset() {
   202	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(modelsLoaded, "Models not loaded — skipping");
   203	
   204	        int targetSize = 512;
   205	        int numPages = 3;
   206	        List<String> outputNames = List.of("image_features");
   207	        long[] expectedOutputShape = null;
   208	
   209	        for (int page = 1; page <= numPages; page++) {
   210	            log.info("=== Page {}/{} ===", page, numPages);
   211	            logGpuMemory("Before page " + page);
   212	
   213	            // Create rank-5 input: [batch=1, frames=1, C=3, H=512, W=512]
   214	            INDArray pixelValues = Nd4j.rand(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 3, targetSize, targetSize);
   215	            INDArray pixelMask = Nd4j.ones(DataType.BOOL, 1, targetSize, targetSize);
   216	
   217	            Map<String, INDArray> inputs = new LinkedHashMap<>();
   218	            inputs.put("pixel_values", pixelValues);
   219	            inputs.put("pixel_attention_mask", pixelMask);
   220	
   221	            Map<String, INDArray> outputs;
   222	            try {
   223	                outputs = visionEncoder.output(inputs, outputNames);
   224	            } catch (Exception e) {
   225	                logGpuMemory("FAILED at page " + page);
   226	                fail("Page " + page + "/" + numPages +
   227	                        " vision encoder FAILED — DSP re-execution bug. Error: " +
   228	                        e.getMessage(), e);
   229	                return;
   230	            }
   231	
   232	            INDArray features = outputs.get("image_features");
   233	            assertNotNull(features, "Page " + page + ": image_features is null");
   234	            assertEquals(3, features.rank(), "Page " + page + ": expected rank-3 output");
   235	            assertFalse(Double.isNaN(features.sumNumber().doubleValue()),
   236	                    "Page " + page + ": output contains NaN");
   237	
   238	            if (expectedOutputShape == null) {
   239	                expectedOutputShape = features.shape();
   240	            } else {
   241	                assertArrayEquals(expectedOutputShape, features.shape(),
   242	                        "Page " + page + ": output shape changed from " +
   243	                                Arrays.toString(expectedOutputShape));
   244	            }
   245	
   246	            log.info("Page {}/{}: output shape={}, sum={:.4f}", page, numPages,
   247	                    Arrays.toString(features.shape()), features.sumNumber().floatValue());
   248	            logGpuMemory("After page " + page);
   249	
   250	            // Close outputs to simulate VLM per-page processing
   251	            for (INDArray a : outputs.values()) {
   252	                if (a != null && !a.wasClosed()) {
   253	                    a.setCloseable(true);
   254	                    a.close();
   255	                }
   256	            }
   257	            pixelValues.close();
   258	            pixelMask.close();
   259	
   260	            // NO session reset between pages — this is the correct behavior
   261	        }
   262	
   263	        log.info("All {} pages succeeded with vision encoder DSP reuse", numPages);
   264	    }

   266	    // =========================================================================
   267	    // Test 2: Vision encoder with frozen shapes
   268	    // =========================================================================
   269	
   270	    @Test
   271	    @Order(2)
   272	    @DisplayName("Vision encoder: frozen shapes enable buffer reuse across pages")
   273	    public void testVisionEncoderFrozenShapes() {
   274	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(modelsLoaded, "Models not loaded — skipping");
   275	
   276	        int targetSize = 512;
   277	        List<String> outputNames = List.of("image_features");
   278	
   279	        // Call 1: compile plan
   280	        logGpuMemory("Before frozen test Call 1");
   281	        INDArray pv1 = Nd4j.rand(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 3, targetSize, targetSize);
   282	        INDArray mask1 = Nd4j.ones(DataType.BOOL, 1, targetSize, targetSize);
   283	        Map<String, INDArray> out1 = visionEncoder.output(
   284	                Map.of("pixel_values", pv1, "pixel_attention_mask", mask1), outputNames);
   285	        INDArray features1 = out1.get("image_features");
   286	        assertNotNull(features1, "Call 1 failed");
   287	        log.info("Call 1 (compile): shape={}", Arrays.toString(features1.shape()));
   288	        logGpuMemory("After frozen test Call 1");
   289	
   290	        // Close Call 1 outputs before freeze to reduce GPU pressure
   291	        pv1.close();
   292	        mask1.close();
   293	        for (INDArray a : out1.values()) {
   294	            if (a != null && !a.wasClosed()) { a.setCloseable(true); a.close(); }
   295	        }
   296	
   297	        // Trim memory pool to release freed memory back to device
   298	        try {
   299	            int numDevices = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getNumberOfDevices();
   300	            for (int d = 0; d < numDevices; d++) {
   301	                nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(d);
   302	            }
   303	            log.info("Trimmed memory pool on {} devices", numDevices);
   304	        } catch (Exception e) {
   305	            log.warn("trimMemoryPool failed: {}", e.getMessage());
   306	        }
   307	        logGpuMemory("After trim before freeze");
   308	
   309	        // Freeze shapes
   310	        visionEncoder.setDspShapesFrozen(true);
   311	
   312	        // Plan introspection: dump slots 290-300 to understand create/shape_of ops
   313	        {
   314	            InferenceSession session = visionEncoder.getSessions().get(Thread.currentThread().getId());
   315	            if (session != null && session.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor() != null) {
   316	                var plan = session.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor().getCurrentPlan();
   317	                if (plan != null) {
   318	                    var slots = plan.getSlots();
   319	                    log.info("=== PLAN INTROSPECTION: slots 288-304 ===");
   320	                    for (int si = 288; si <= Math.min(304, slots.length - 1); si++) {
   321	                        log.info(org.nd4j.autodiff.samediff.execution.PlanIntrospection.formatSlot(plan, si));
   322	                    }
   323	                }
   324	            }
   325	        }
   326	
   327	        // Call 2-4: frozen execution with buffer reuse.
   328	        // CRITICAL: Frozen replay requires reusing the SAME input arrays across calls.
   329	        // Allocating new arrays would change DataBuffer pointers, breaking CUDA graph
   330	        // replay which has those pointers baked in. Overwrite data in-place instead.
   331	        INDArray frozenPv = Nd4j.rand(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 3, targetSize, targetSize);
   332	        INDArray frozenMask = Nd4j.ones(DataType.BOOL, 1, targetSize, targetSize);
   333	        Map<String, INDArray> frozenFeed = Map.of("pixel_values", frozenPv,
   334	                "pixel_attention_mask", frozenMask);
   335	        for (int i = 2; i <= 4; i++) {
   336	            logGpuMemory("Before frozen Call " + i);
   337	            // Overwrite pixel data in-place — same DataBuffer, new random values
   338	            frozenPv.assign(Nd4j.rand(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 3, targetSize, targetSize));
   339	            Map<String, INDArray> out;
   340	            try {
   341	                out = visionEncoder.output(frozenFeed, outputNames);
   342	            } catch (Exception e) {
   343	                logGpuMemory("FAILED frozen Call " + i);
   344	                fail("Call " + i + " with frozen shapes failed: " + e.getMessage(), e);
   345	                return;
   346	            }
   347	            INDArray features = out.get("image_features");
   348	            assertNotNull(features, "Call " + i + ": image_features is null");
   349	            assertFalse(Double.isNaN(features.sumNumber().doubleValue()),
   350	                    "Call " + i + ": NaN in output");
   351	            log.info("Call {} (frozen): shape={}, sum={:.4f}", i,
   352	                    Arrays.toString(features.shape()), features.sumNumber().floatValue());
   353	            logGpuMemory("After frozen Call " + i);
   354	        }
   355	        frozenPv.close();
   356	        frozenMask.close();
   357	
   358	        // Unfreeze for other tests
   359	        visionEncoder.setDspShapesFrozen(false);
   360	        log.info("Frozen shapes test passed");
   361	    }

   113	        downloadMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0;

   119	        embedTokens = OnnxModelCache.importWithCache(embedDir.getAbsolutePath());
   120	        visionEncoder = OnnxModelCache.importWithCache(visionDir.getAbsolutePath());
   121	        importMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - t1;

   156	            log.warn("Error during teardown: {}", e.getMessage());
   157	        }
   158	    }
   159	
   160	    // ─── Image processing ───────────────────────────────────────────────
   161	
   162	    private INDArray processImageThroughVision(BufferedImage image) throws Exception {
   163	        PreprocessorConfig ppConfig = PreprocessorConfig.forSmolDocling();
   164	        VLMImagePreprocessor preprocessor = VLMImagePreprocessor.fromConfig(ppConfig);
   165	        int targetSize = ppConfig.getTargetHeight();
   166	
   167	        // Tile the image
   168	        ImageTiler.SplitImageResult tileResult = ImageTiler.splitImageForVLM(image, targetSize);
   169	        List<INDArray> frames = new ArrayList<>();
   170	        List<INDArray> masks = new ArrayList<>();
   171	        for (int i = 0; i < tileResult.frames.size(); i++) {
   172	            INDArray tensor = preprocessor.preprocess(tileResult.frames.get(i));
   173	            // Reshape to 5D [1, 1, 3, H, W] as expected by the vision encoder
   174	            frames.add(tensor.reshape(1, 1, 3, targetSize, targetSize));
   175	            ImageTiler.ContentRegion region = tileResult.contentRegions.get(i);
   176	            masks.add(ImageTiler.createPixelAttentionMask(region.width, region.height, targetSize));
   177	        }
   178	        log.info("Preprocessed {} frames", frames.size());
   179	
   180	        // Check if vision encoder has pixel_attention_mask input
   181	        boolean hasMaskInput = visionEncoder.getVariable("pixel_attention_mask") != null;
   182	
   183	        // Vision encode each frame
   184	        String visionOutput = visionEncoder.outputs().get(0);
   185	        List<INDArray> encodedFrames = new ArrayList<>();
   186	        for (int i = 0; i < frames.size(); i++) {
   187	            Map<String, INDArray> inputs = new java.util.HashMap<>();
   188	            inputs.put("pixel_values", frames.get(i));
   189	            if (hasMaskInput) {
   190	                inputs.put("pixel_attention_mask", masks.get(i));
   191	            }
   192	            Map<String, INDArray> visionResult = visionEncoder.output(inputs, visionOutput);
   193	            // Dup to detach from SameDiff session
   194	            encodedFrames.add(visionResult.get(visionOutput).dup());
   195	        }
   196	
   197	        // Close frame and mask arrays after encoding
   198	        for (INDArray frame : frames) {
   199	            SameDiffMemoryUtils.safeClose(frame);
   200	        }
   201	        for (INDArray mask : masks) {
   202	            SameDiffMemoryUtils.safeClose(mask);
   203	        }
   204	
   205	        INDArray visionEmbeddings = Nd4j.concat(1, encodedFrames.toArray(new INDArray[0]));
   206	        // Close individual encoded frames after concat
   207	        for (INDArray encoded : encodedFrames) {
   208	            SameDiffMemoryUtils.safeClose(encoded);
   209	        }
   210	        log.info("Vision embeddings shape: {}", java.util.Arrays.toString(visionEmbeddings.shape()));
   211	
   212	        return visionEmbeddings;
   213	    }
   214	
   215	    private MergedEmbeddings mergeEmbeddings(BufferedImage image) throws Exception {
   216	        PreprocessorConfig ppConfig = PreprocessorConfig.forSmolDocling();
   217	        ImageTiler.SplitImageResult tileResult = ImageTiler.splitImageForVLM(image, ppConfig.getTargetHeight());
   218	
   219	        INDArray visionEmbeddings = processImageThroughVision(image);
   220	
   221	        // Build prompt and text embeddings
   222	        String prompt = ImagePromptBuilder.buildImagePromptString(
   223	                tileResult.numRows, tileResult.numCols, (int) visionEmbeddings.shape()[1]);
   224	        int[] promptTokenIds = tokenizer.encode(prompt, false).getIds();
   225	
   226	        INDArray inputIds = Nd4j.createFromArray(promptTokenIds)
   227	                .reshape(1, promptTokenIds.length).castTo(DataType.INT64);
   228	        String embedInput = embedTokens.inputs().get(0);
   229	        String embedOutput = embedTokens.outputs().get(0);
   230	        Map<String, INDArray> embedResult = embedTokens.output(
   231	                Map.of(embedInput, inputIds), embedOutput);
   232	        // Dup to detach from SameDiff session
   233	        INDArray textEmbeddings = embedResult.get(embedOutput).dup();
   234	        SameDiffMemoryUtils.safeClose(inputIds);
   235	
   236	        // Merge vision + text
   237	        int imageTokenId = tokenizer.getTokenId("<image>");
   238	        INDArray merged = EmbeddingMerger.mergeEmbeddings(
   239	                textEmbeddings, visionEmbeddings, promptTokenIds, imageTokenId);
   240	        log.info("Merged embeddings shape: {}", java.util.Arrays.toString(merged.shape()));
   241	
   242	        // Close intermediates after merge
   243	        SameDiffMemoryUtils.safeClose(textEmbeddings);
   244	        SameDiffMemoryUtils.safeClose(visionEmbeddings);
   245	
   246	        return new MergedEmbeddings(merged, promptTokenIds, merged.shape()[2]);
   247	    }
   248	
   249	    private static class MergedEmbeddings {
   250	        final INDArray embeddings;
   251	        final int[] promptTokenIds;
   252	        final long hiddenSize;
   253	
   254	        MergedEmbeddings(INDArray embeddings, int[] promptTokenIds, long hiddenSize) {
   255	            this.embeddings = embeddings;
   256	            this.promptTokenIds = promptTokenIds;
   257	            this.hiddenSize = hiddenSize;
   258	        }
   259	    }

   473	    private static String getPropertyOrDefault(String key, String defaultValue) {
   474	        String value = System.getProperty(key);
   475	        return (value == null || value.isEmpty()) ? defaultValue : value;
   476	    }
   477	
   478	    private void validateResult(GenerationResult result, int maxTokens) {
   479	        assertNotNull(result, "GenerationResult must not be null");
   480	        assertNotNull(result.getText(), "Generated text must not be null");
   481	        assertTrue(result.getGeneratedTokenCount() > 0,
   482	                "Should generate at least 1 token, got: " + result.getGeneratedTokenCount());
   483	        assertNotNull(result.getTokenIds(), "Token IDs must not be null");
   484	        assertEquals(result.getGeneratedTokenCount(), result.getTokenIds().length,
   485	                "Token count must match tokenIds length");
   486	        assertTrue(result.getGenerationTimeMs() > 0, "Generation time must be positive");
   487	        assertTrue(result.getTokensPerSecond() > 0, "Tokens/sec must be positive");
   488	        assertNotNull(result.getFinishReason(), "Finish reason must not be null");
   489	    }
   490	
   491	    private void logResult(GenerationResult result) {
   492	        log.info("Text: {}", result.getText().substring(0, Math.min(200, result.getText().length())));
   493	        log.info("Tokens: {}, Time: {}ms, Speed: {} tok/s",
   494	                result.getGeneratedTokenCount(), result.getGenerationTimeMs(),
   495	                String.format("%.1f", result.getTokensPerSecond()));
   496	        log.info("First token latency: {}ms", result.getFirstTokenLatencyMs());
   497	        log.info("Finish reason: {}", result.getFinishReason());
   498	        log.info("Pipeline setup: download={}ms import={}ms", downloadMs, importMs);
   499	    }

   505	        g.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
   506	        g.setColor(Color.BLACK);
   507	        g.setFont(new Font("Serif", Font.PLAIN, 24));
   508	        g.drawString("Test Document", 50, 50);
   509	        g.drawString("This is a test page for the VLM GenerationPipeline.", 50, 100);
   510	        g.drawString("Section 1: Introduction", 50, 160);
   511	        g.drawString("Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.", 50, 200);
   512	        g.drawString("Section 2: Methods", 50, 260);
   513	        g.drawString("The method involves processing images through a vision encoder.", 50, 300);
   514	        g.dispose();
   515	        return img;
   516	    }

   519	        try (PDDocument doc = PDDocument.load(pdfFile)) {

   521	            int renderDpi = 150;
   522	            return renderer.renderImageWithDPI(pageIndex, renderDpi, ImageType.RGB);
   523	        }
   524	    }

   132	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Cast_4_output_0",
   133	                "/vision_model/embeddings/ReduceSum_output_0",
   134	                // Div_2 inputs: Cast_8 / Cast_9
   135	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Cast_9_output_0",
   136	                // Row index computation: Div_2 → Less(Div_2, Expand_2) → Not → Cast_12 → ReduceSum_2 → Unsqueeze_7 → Mul_5
   137	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Div_2_output_0",
   138	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Expand_2_output_0",
   139	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Less_output_0",
   140	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Not_output_0",
   141	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Cast_12_output_0",
   142	                "/vision_model/embeddings/ReduceSum_2_output_0",
   143	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Unsqueeze_7_output_0",
   144	                // Add path (broadcast position grid): Mul_5 + Unsqueeze_8 → Add → Flatten
   145	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Mul_5_output_0",
   146	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Unsqueeze_8_output_0",
   147	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Add_output_0",
   148	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Flatten_output_0",
   149	                // ScatterND path: Reshape_6, Concat_8 → ScatterND → Cast_14
   150	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Reshape_6_output_0",
   151	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Concat_8_output_0",
   152	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Cast_14_output_0",
   153	                // Position embeddings and final embedding output
   154	                "/vision_model/embeddings/position_embedding/Gather_output_0",
   155	                "/vision_model/embeddings/Add_3_output_0",
   156	                // Layer 0 layer_norm1 - just check input and output
   157	                "/vision_model/encoder/layers.0/layer_norm1/Sub_output_0",
   158	                "/vision_model/encoder/layers.0/layer_norm1/Add_1_output_0",
   159	        };
   160	
   161	        // Collect outputs: final + intermediates that exist in the graph
   162	        java.util.List<String> outputNames = new java.util.ArrayList<>(model.outputs());
   163	        for (String node : intermediateNodes) {
   164	            if (model.hasVariable(node)) {
   165	                outputNames.add(node);
   166	            } else {
   167	                log.warn("Intermediate node not found: {}", node);
   168	            }
   169	        }
   170	
   171	        Map<String, INDArray> result = model.output(inputs, outputNames.toArray(new String[0]));
   172	
   173	        // Compare intermediates against Python references
   174	        for (String node : intermediateNodes) {
   175	            INDArray sdOut = result.get(node);
   176	            if (sdOut == null) continue;
   177	            String safeName = node.replace('/', '_').replace('.', '_');
   178	            // Try ref_intermediate_, ref_early_, and ref_emb_ prefixes
   179	            File refFile = new File("/tmp/ref_intermediate_" + safeName + ".npy");
   180	            if (!refFile.exists()) {
   181	                refFile = new File("/tmp/ref_early_" + safeName + ".npy");
   182	            }
   183	            if (!refFile.exists()) {
   184	                refFile = new File("/tmp/ref_emb_" + safeName + ".npy");
   185	            }
   186	            if (refFile.exists()) {
   187	                INDArray pyOut = Nd4j.createFromNpyFile(refFile);
   188	                compareOutputs(node, pyOut, sdOut);
   189	            } else {
   190	                log.info("  {} (no ref): shape={}, min={}, max={}, mean={}",
   191	                        node, Arrays.toString(sdOut.shape()),
   192	                        sdOut.minNumber(), sdOut.maxNumber(), sdOut.meanNumber());
   193	            }
   194	        }
   195	
   196	        INDArray actual = null;
   197	        for (String outName : model.outputs()) {
   198	            actual = result.get(outName);
   199	            if (actual != null) {
   200	                log.info("SameDiff output '{}': shape={}, min={}, max={}, mean={}",
   201	                        outName, Arrays.toString(actual.shape()),
   202	                        actual.minNumber(), actual.maxNumber(), actual.meanNumber());
   203	            }
   204	        }
   205	
   206	        assertNotNull(actual);
   207	        compareOutputs("vision_encoder", expectedOutput, actual);
   208	    }

   252	            } else if (name.equals("position_ids")) {
