   277	    @Test
   278	    @DisplayName("direct conv2d: nd4j op vs ONNX Runtime")
   279	    public void testDirectConv() throws Exception {
   280	        log.info("=== direct conv2d via nd4j op ===");
   281	
   282	        INDArray input = Nd4j.createFromNpyFile(new File("/tmp/ref_intermediate__GatherND_output_0.npy")); // [1,3,512,512] NCHW
   283	        INDArray weight = Nd4j.createFromNpyFile(new File("/tmp/ref_conv_weight.npy")); // [768,3,16,16] OIHW
   284	        INDArray bias = Nd4j.createFromNpyFile(new File("/tmp/ref_conv_bias.npy"));     // [768]
   285	        INDArray expected = Nd4j.createFromNpyFile(new File("/tmp/ref_conv_output.npy")); // [1,768,32,32] NCHW
   286	
   287	        log.info("Input NCHW: {}", Arrays.toString(input.shape()));
   288	        log.info("Weight OIHW: {}", Arrays.toString(weight.shape()));
   289	
   290	        // Approach 1: Use conv2d with NCHW format and OIYX weights (no permutation)
   291	        {
   292	            log.info("--- Approach 1: NCHW input, OIYX weight ---");
   293	            SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
   294	            SDVariable sdInput = sd.var("input", input);
   295	            SDVariable sdWeight = sd.var("weight", weight);
   296	            SDVariable sdBias = sd.var("bias", bias);
   297	
   298	            Conv2DConfig config = Conv2DConfig.builder()
   299	                    .kH(16).kW(16).sH(16).sW(16)
   300	                    .pH(0).pW(0).dH(1).dW(1)
   301	                    .dataFormat("NCHW")
   302	                    .weightsFormat(WeightsFormat.OIYX)
   303	                    .paddingMode(PaddingMode.VALID)
   304	                    .build();
   305	            SDVariable conv = sd.cnn().conv2d(sdInput, sdWeight, sdBias, config);
   306	
   307	            Map<String, INDArray> result = sd.output(Map.of(), conv.name());
   308	            INDArray actual = result.get(conv.name());
   309	            log.info("Output: shape={}, min={}, max={}", Arrays.toString(actual.shape()),
   310	                    actual.minNumber(), actual.maxNumber());
   311	            compareOutputs("direct_conv_NCHW_OIYX", expected, actual);
   312	        }
   313	
   314	        // Approach 2: Reproduce what the ONNX import does (permute to NHWC+YXIO)
   315	        {
   316	            log.info("--- Approach 2: NHWC input, YXIO weight (ONNX import style) ---");
   317	            // Permute input NCHW [0,1,2,3] -> NHWC [0,2,3,1]
   318	            INDArray inputNHWC = input.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).dup();
   319	            // Permute weight OIHW [0,1,2,3] -> YXIO [2,3,1,0]
   320	            INDArray weightYXIO = weight.permute(2, 3, 1, 0).dup();
   321	
   322	            log.info("Input NHWC: {}", Arrays.toString(inputNHWC.shape()));
   323	            log.info("Weight YXIO: {}", Arrays.toString(weightYXIO.shape()));
   324	
   325	            SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
   326	            SDVariable sdInput = sd.var("input", inputNHWC);
   327	            SDVariable sdWeight = sd.var("weight", weightYXIO);
   328	
   329	            Conv2DConfig config2 = Conv2DConfig.builder()
   330	                    .kH(16).kW(16).sH(16).sW(16)
   331	                    .pH(0).pW(0).dH(1).dW(1)
   332	                    .dataFormat("NHWC")
   333	                    .weightsFormat(WeightsFormat.YXIO)
   334	                    .paddingMode(PaddingMode.VALID)
   335	                    .build();
   336	            SDVariable conv = sd.cnn().conv2d(sdInput, sdWeight, config2);
   337	            // Add bias in NHWC (last dim = channels)
   338	            SDVariable sdBias = sd.var("bias", bias);
   339	            SDVariable withBias = conv.add(sdBias);
   340	            // Permute back NHWC -> NCHW [0,3,1,2]
   341	            SDVariable outNCHW = sd.permute(withBias, 0, 3, 1, 2);
   342	
   343	            Map<String, INDArray> result = sd.output(Map.of(), outNCHW.name());
   344	            INDArray actual = result.get(outNCHW.name());
   345	            log.info("Output: shape={}, min={}, max={}", Arrays.toString(actual.shape()),
   346	                    actual.minNumber(), actual.maxNumber());
   347	            compareOutputs("direct_conv_NHWC_YXIO", expected, actual);
   348	        }
   349	    }

   415	    @DisplayName("conv2d diagnostic: small known input + manual verification")
   416	    public void testConv2dDiagnostic() throws Exception {
   417	        log.info("=== conv2d diagnostic ===");
   418	
   419	        INDArray input = Nd4j.create(new float[]{
   420	                1, 2, 3, 4,
   421	                5, 6, 7, 8,
   422	                9, 10, 11, 12,
   423	                13, 14, 15, 16
   424	        }, new int[]{1, 1, 4, 4});  // NCHW
   425	        INDArray weight = Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 2, 2);
   426	
   427	        log.info("Input ordering: {}, shape: {}, stride: {}", input.ordering(),
   428	                Arrays.toString(input.shape()), Arrays.toString(input.stride()));
   429	        log.info("Input data: {}", Arrays.toString(input.dup().reshape(-1).toFloatVector()));
   430	
   431	        Conv2DConfig config = Conv2DConfig.builder()
   432	                .kH(2).kW(2).sH(2).sW(2)
   433	                .pH(0).pW(0).dH(1).dW(1)
   434	                .dataFormat("NCHW")
   435	                .weightsFormat(WeightsFormat.OIYX)
   436	                .paddingMode(PaddingMode.VALID)
   437	                .build();
   438	
   439	        // A: SameDiff
   440	        {
   441	            SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
   442	            SDVariable sdIn = sd.var("in", input);
   443	            SDVariable sdW = sd.var("w", weight);
   444	            SDVariable out = sd.cnn().conv2d(sdIn, sdW, config);
   445	            Map<String, INDArray> result = sd.output(Map.of(), out.name());
   446	            INDArray actual = result.get(out.name());
   447	            log.info("SameDiff output: {}", Arrays.toString(actual.dup().reshape(-1).toFloatVector()));
   448	        }
   449	
   450	        // B: Direct op (bypass SameDiff)
   451	        {
   452	            INDArray output = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 2, 2);
   453	            org.nd4j.linalg.api.ops.impl.layers.convolution.Conv2D op =
   454	                    new org.nd4j.linalg.api.ops.impl.layers.convolution.Conv2D(
   455	                            input, weight, null, output, config);
   456	            Nd4j.exec(op);
   457	            log.info("Direct op output: {}", Arrays.toString(output.dup().reshape(-1).toFloatVector()));
   458	        }
   459	
   460	        // C: Manual im2col + matmul
   461	        {
   462	            INDArray col = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, 4, 4);
   463	            for (int oh = 0; oh < 2; oh++) {
   464	                for (int ow = 0; ow < 2; ow++) {
   465	                    int patchIdx = oh * 2 + ow;
   466	                    int colIdx = 0;
   467	                    for (int kh = 0; kh < 2; kh++) {
   468	                        for (int kw = 0; kw < 2; kw++) {
   469	                            col.putScalar(patchIdx, colIdx, input.getDouble(0, 0, oh * 2 + kh, ow * 2 + kw));
   470	                            colIdx++;
   471	                        }
   472	                    }
   473	                }
   474	            }
   475	            INDArray wFlat = weight.reshape(1, 4).transpose();
   476	            INDArray mmResult = col.mmul(wFlat);
   477	            log.info("Manual matmul output: {}", Arrays.toString(mmResult.dup().reshape(-1).toFloatVector()));
   478	        }
   479	
   480	        log.info("Expected: [14.0, 22.0, 46.0, 54.0]");
   481	
   482	        // Test 2: stride 1 (overlapping) to see if stride is the issue
   483	        {
   484	            log.info("--- Test 2: same input, stride 1, kernel 2 ---");
   485	            Conv2DConfig cfg2 = Conv2DConfig.builder()
   486	                    .kH(2).kW(2).sH(1).sW(1)
   487	                    .pH(0).pW(0).dH(1).dW(1)
   488	                    .dataFormat("NCHW")
   489	                    .weightsFormat(WeightsFormat.OIYX)
   490	                    .paddingMode(PaddingMode.VALID)
   491	                    .build();
   492	            INDArray out2 = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 3, 3);
   493	            org.nd4j.linalg.api.ops.impl.layers.convolution.Conv2D op2 =
   494	                    new org.nd4j.linalg.api.ops.impl.layers.convolution.Conv2D(
   495	                            input, weight, null, out2, cfg2);
   496	            Nd4j.exec(op2);
   497	            log.info("Stride-1 output: {}", Arrays.toString(out2.dup().reshape(-1).toFloatVector()));
   498	            // Expected: [14, 18, 22, 30, 34, 38, 46, 50, 54]
   499	            log.info("Expected stride-1: [14, 18, 22, 30, 34, 38, 46, 50, 54]");
   500	        }
   501	
   502	        // Test 3: multi-channel
   503	        {
   504	            log.info("--- Test 3: 3ch->2ch, 4x4 kernel, stride 4, 8x8 input ---");
   505	            INDArray input3 = Nd4j.linspace(0, 191, 192, DataType.FLOAT).reshape(1, 3, 8, 8);
   506	            INDArray weight3 = Nd4j.linspace(-0.1, 0.086, 96, DataType.FLOAT).reshape(2, 3, 4, 4);
   507	
   508	            Conv2DConfig cfg3 = Conv2DConfig.builder()
   509	                    .kH(4).kW(4).sH(4).sW(4)
   510	                    .pH(0).pW(0).dH(1).dW(1)
   511	                    .dataFormat("NCHW")
   512	                    .weightsFormat(WeightsFormat.OIYX)
   513	                    .paddingMode(PaddingMode.VALID)
   514	                    .build();
   515	
   516	            INDArray out3 = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 2, 2, 2);
   517	            org.nd4j.linalg.api.ops.impl.layers.convolution.Conv2D op3 =
   518	                    new org.nd4j.linalg.api.ops.impl.layers.convolution.Conv2D(
   519	                            input3, weight3, null, out3, cfg3);
   520	            Nd4j.exec(op3);
   521	            log.info("Multi-ch output: {}", Arrays.toString(out3.dup().reshape(-1).toFloatVector()));
   522	
   523	            double manual00 = 0;
   524	            for (int ic = 0; ic < 3; ic++) {
   525	                for (int kh = 0; kh < 4; kh++) {
   526	                    for (int kw = 0; kw < 4; kw++) {
   527	                        manual00 += input3.getDouble(0, ic, kh, kw) * weight3.getDouble(0, ic, kh, kw);
   528	                    }
   529	                }
   530	            }
   531	            log.info("Manual [0,0,0,0]={}, op={}", manual00, out3.getDouble(0, 0, 0, 0));
   532	        }
   533	    }

   535	    private void compareOutputs(String name, INDArray expected, INDArray actual) {
   536	        log.info("--- {} comparison ---", name);
   537	        log.info("Expected: shape={}, dtype={}", Arrays.toString(expected.shape()), expected.dataType());
   538	        log.info("Actual:   shape={}, dtype={}", Arrays.toString(actual.shape()), actual.dataType());
   539	
   540	        // Cast to same type for comparison
   541	        INDArray exp = expected.castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   542	        INDArray act = actual.castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   543	
   544	        INDArray diff = exp.sub(act);
   545	        double maxAbsDiff = Nd4j.math().abs(diff).maxNumber().doubleValue();
   546	        double meanAbsDiff = Nd4j.math().abs(diff).meanNumber().doubleValue();
   547	        double l2 = diff.norm2Number().doubleValue();
   548	        double relErr = l2 / (exp.norm2Number().doubleValue() + 1e-8);
   549	
   550	        log.info("maxAbsDiff={}, meanAbsDiff={}, L2={}, relativeL2={}", maxAbsDiff, meanAbsDiff, l2, relErr);
   551	
   552	        // Check first 10 values
   553	        float[] expFirst = exp.dup().reshape(-1).get(NDArrayIndex.interval(0, Math.min(10, exp.length()))).toFloatVector();
   554	        float[] actFirst = act.dup().reshape(-1).get(NDArrayIndex.interval(0, Math.min(10, act.length()))).toFloatVector();
   555	        log.info("First 10 expected: {}", Arrays.toString(expFirst));
   556	        log.info("First 10 actual:   {}", Arrays.toString(actFirst));
   557	    }
   558	}

  1051	    @BeforeAll
  1052	    public static void setup() {
  1053	        // Maven surefire sets undefined ${...} properties to empty string, not null.
  1054	        // Check for both null and empty to ensure defaults apply.
  1055	        String optEnabled = System.getProperty("nd4j.optimizer.enabled");
  1056	        if (optEnabled == null || optEnabled.isEmpty()) {
  1057	            System.setProperty("nd4j.optimizer.enabled", "true");
  1058	        }
  1059	        // Pre-cast FP32 weight constants to FP16 at model load time via optimizer.
  1060	        // This halves weight memory bandwidth and avoids the runtime per-matmul double-cast
  1061	        // that dspFp16Compute uses. MmulHelper's mixed-type path handles HALF×FLOAT
  1062	        // automatically, casting only the FP32 activation (1 cast vs 2).
  1063	        String fp16Prop = System.getProperty("nd4j.optimizer.fp16");
  1064	        if (fp16Prop == null || fp16Prop.isEmpty()) {
  1065	            System.setProperty("nd4j.optimizer.fp16", "true");
  1066	        }
  1067	        System.setProperty("nd4j.optimizer.logApplied", "true");
  1068	
  1069	        // Debug flags passed via run-benchmark.sh or -D Maven properties
  1070	
  1071	        pdfPath = System.getProperty("vlm.test.pdf.path");
  1072	        String pageStr = System.getProperty("vlm.test.pdf.page");
  1073	        if (pageStr != null && !pageStr.isEmpty()) {
  1074	            specificPage = Integer.parseInt(pageStr);
  1075	        }
  1076	        String dpiStr = System.getProperty("vlm.test.pdf.dpi");
  1077	        if (dpiStr != null && !dpiStr.isEmpty()) {
  1078	            renderDpi = Integer.parseInt(dpiStr);

  1244	
  1245	    private double effectiveThroughput(GenerationResult result) {
  1246	        if (result.getLateSteadyStateTokensPerSecond() > 0) {
  1247	            return result.getLateSteadyStateTokensPerSecond();
  1248	        }
  1249	        if (result.getSteadyStateTokensPerSecond() > 0) {
  1250	            return result.getSteadyStateTokensPerSecond();
  1251	        }
  1252	        if (result.getDecodeTokensPerSecond() > 0) {
  1253	            return result.getDecodeTokensPerSecond();
  1254	        }
  1255	        return result.getTokensPerSecond();
  1256	    }
  1257	
  1258	    private String effectiveThroughputLabel(GenerationResult result) {
  1259	        if (result.getLateSteadyStateTokensPerSecond() > 0) {
  1260	            return "late steady-state";
  1261	        }
  1262	        if (result.getSteadyStateTokensPerSecond() > 0) {
  1263	            return "steady-state";
  1264	        }
  1265	        if (result.getDecodeTokensPerSecond() > 0) {
  1266	            return "decode-only";
  1267	        }
  1268	        return "overall";
  1269	    }

  1271	    private void validateResult(BenchmarkConfig config, GenerationResult result) {
  1272	        String name = config.getName();
  1273	
  1274	        // Basic generation assertions
  1275	        assertNotNull(result.getText(), name + ": generated text is null");
  1276	        assertTrue(result.getGeneratedTokenCount() > 0,
  1277	                name + ": should have generated at least one token");
  1278	        assertNotNull(result.getTokenIds(), name + ": token IDs array is null");
  1279	        assertEquals(result.getGeneratedTokenCount(), result.getTokenIds().length,
  1280	                name + ": token count mismatch with tokenIds array length");
  1281	        assertTrue(result.getGenerationTimeMs() > 0,
  1282	                name + ": generation time must be positive");
  1283	        assertTrue(result.getTokensPerSecond() > 0,
  1284	                name + ": tokens/sec must be positive");
  1285	        assertNotNull(result.getFinishReason(),
  1286	                name + ": finish reason is null");
  1287	
  1288	        String trimmed = result.getText().trim();
  1289	
  1290	        // Structural tag check
  1291	        if (config.isExpectStructuralTags() && result.getGeneratedTokenCount() >= 10) {
  1292	            boolean hasDocTags = trimmed.contains("<") && trimmed.contains(">");
  1293	            if (hasDocTags) {
  1294	                Set<String> tagTypes = extractTagTypes(trimmed);
  1295	                assertFalse(tagTypes.isEmpty(),
  1296	                        name + ": found angle brackets but extracted no tag types");
  1297	                boolean hasStructuralTags = tagTypes.stream().anyMatch(t ->
  1298	                        t.equals("doctag") || t.equals("page") || t.equals("text") ||
  1299	                                t.equals("section_header") || t.equals("otsl") || t.equals("table"));
  1300	                assertTrue(hasStructuralTags,
  1301	                        name + ": expected structural DocTags in " + result.getGeneratedTokenCount() +
  1302	                                " tokens. Tags found: " + tagTypes +
  1303	                                ". Text: " + trimmed.substring(0, Math.min(200, trimmed.length())));
  1304	            }
  1305	        }
  1306	
  1307	        // Degeneracy check
  1308	        if (result.getGeneratedTokenCount() >= 10) {
  1309	            int[] tokenIds = result.getTokenIds();
  1310	            Set<Integer> uniqueTokens = new HashSet<>();
  1311	            for (int id : tokenIds) uniqueTokens.add(id);
  1312	            double uniqueRatio = (double) uniqueTokens.size() / tokenIds.length;
  1313	            log.info("  Token diversity: {}/{} unique ({}%)",
  1314	                    uniqueTokens.size(), tokenIds.length, String.format("%.1f", uniqueRatio * 100));
  1315	            assertTrue(uniqueRatio > config.getMinDiversityPct() / 100.0,
  1316	                    name + ": degenerate output: " + uniqueTokens.size() + "/" + tokenIds.length +
  1317	                            " unique (min " + config.getMinDiversityPct() + "%)");
  1318	        }
  1319	
  1320	        // Throughput check
  1321	        if (result.getGeneratedTokenCount() >= 5) {
  1322	            assertTrue(result.getTokensPerSecond() > 0.1,
  1323	                    name + ": throughput too low: " +
  1324	                            String.format("%.2f", result.getTokensPerSecond()) + " tok/s");
  1325	        }
  1326	        if ("OPTIMAL".equals(name) && result.getGeneratedTokenCount() >= 20) {
  1327	            double effectiveThroughput = effectiveThroughput(result);
  1328	            String throughputLabel = effectiveThroughputLabel(result);
  1329	            assertTrue(effectiveThroughput >= 100.0,
  1330	                    name + ": native benchmark target missed: "
  1331	                            + throughputLabel + "=" + String.format("%.2f", effectiveThroughput)
  1332	                            + " tok/s (target 100.00 tok/s)");
  1333	        }
  1334	    }

  1700	    private String summarizeTensor(String label, INDArray arr) {
  1701	        if (arr == null) {
  1702	            return label + "{null}";
  1703	        }
  1704	
  1705	        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(label).append("{shape=");
  1706	        try {
  1707	            sb.append(Arrays.toString(arr.shape()))
  1708	                    .append(",dtype=").append(arr.dataType())
  1709	                    .append(",length=").append(arr.length())
  1710	                    .append(",closed=").append(arr.wasClosed());
  1711	
  1712	            if (isTensorFingerprintLoggingEnabled() && !arr.wasClosed() && arr.length() > 0) {
  1713	                INDArray flat = arr.reshape(arr.length());
  1714	                long len = flat.length();
  1715	                long stride = Math.max(1L, len / Math.max(1, tensorFingerprintSamples()));
  1716	                int sampled = 0;
  1717	                double sampleMin = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  1718	                double sampleMax = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  1719	                double sampleSum = 0.0;
  1720	                double checksum = 0.0;
  1721	                boolean sampleHasNaN = false;
  1722	                for (long idx = 0; idx < len && sampled < tensorFingerprintSamples(); idx += stride) {
  1723	                    double value = flat.getDouble(idx);
  1724	                    sampleMin = Math.min(sampleMin, value);
  1725	                    sampleMax = Math.max(sampleMax, value);
  1726	                    sampleSum += value;
  1727	                    checksum += value * (idx + 1);
  1728	                    sampleHasNaN |= Double.isNaN(value);
  1729	                    sampled++;
  1730	                }
  1731	                if (sampled == 0) {
  1732	                    double value = flat.getDouble(0);
  1733	                    sampleMin = value;
  1734	                    sampleMax = value;
  1735	                    sampleSum = value;
  1736	                    checksum = value;
  1737	                    sampleHasNaN = Double.isNaN(value);
  1738	                    sampled = 1;
  1739	                }
  1740	                sb.append(",sampled=").append(sampled)
  1741	                        .append(",stride=").append(stride)
  1742	                        .append(",sampleMin=").append(String.format("%.6f", sampleMin))
  1743	                        .append(",sampleMax=").append(String.format("%.6f", sampleMax))
  1744	                        .append(",sampleMean=").append(String.format("%.6f", sampleSum / sampled))
  1745	                        .append(",sampleChecksum=").append(String.format("%.6f", checksum))
  1746	                        .append(",sampleHasNaN=").append(sampleHasNaN);
  1747	            }
  1748	        } catch (Throwable t) {
  1749	            sb.append("?,fingerprintError=").append(t.getClass().getSimpleName())
  1750	                    .append(":").append(t.getMessage());
  1751	        }
  1752	
  1753	        return sb.append("}").toString();
  1754	    }

  1756	    private String summarizeTokens(String label, int[] tokens) {
  1757	        if (tokens == null) {
  1758	            return label + "{null}";
  1759	        }
  1760	
  1761	        int preview = Math.min(tokens.length, 8);
  1762	        int tailStart = Math.max(0, tokens.length - 8);
  1763	        return label + "{count=" + tokens.length
  1764	                + ",head=" + Arrays.toString(Arrays.copyOfRange(tokens, 0, preview))
  1765	                + ",tail=" + Arrays.toString(Arrays.copyOfRange(tokens, tailStart, tokens.length))
  1766	                + "}";
  1767	    }

  1776	                + ",throughputLabel=" + effectiveThroughputLabel(result)
  1777	                + ",throughput=" + String.format("%.2f", effectiveThroughput(result))
  1778	                + ",text='" + safeSnippet(result.getText(), 160) + "'"
  1779	                + "," + summarizeTokens("tokenIds", result.getTokenIds())
  1780	                + "}";

  1783	    private String safeSnippet(String text, int maxChars) {
  1784	        if (text == null) {
  1785	            return "<null>";
  1786	        }
  1787	
  1788	        String normalized = text.replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ').trim();
  1789	        if (normalized.length() <= maxChars) {
  1790	            return normalized;
  1791	        }
  1792	        return normalized.substring(0, maxChars) + "...";
  1793	    }

  1832	    private Set<String> extractTagTypes(String text) {
  1833	        Set<String> tagTypes = new HashSet<>();
  1834	        int idx = 0;
  1835	        while (idx < text.length()) {
  1836	            int open = text.indexOf('<', idx);
  1837	            if (open < 0) break;
  1838	            int close = text.indexOf('>', open);
  1839	            if (close < 0) break;
  1840	            String tag = text.substring(open + 1, close);
  1841	            if (tag.startsWith("/")) tag = tag.substring(1);
  1842	            int space = tag.indexOf(' ');
  1843	            if (space > 0) tag = tag.substring(0, space);
  1844	            if (!tag.isEmpty()) tagTypes.add(tag);
  1845	            idx = close + 1;
  1846	        }
  1847	        return tagTypes;
  1848	    }

   244	        inputsEmbeds = EmbeddingMerger.mergeEmbeddings(textEmbeddings, visionEmbeddings, encoded, imageTokenId);
   245	
   246	        log.info("Models loaded: decoder={} ops, embed={} ops, hiddenSize={}, promptTokens={}",
   247	                decoder.getOps().size(), embedTokens.getOps().size(), hiddenSize, promptTokenIds.length);
   248	        modelsLoaded = true;
   249	    }

   253	    static Stream<BenchmarkConfig> outputAccuracyConfigs() {
   254	        int tokens = getTokens(5);
   255	        List<BenchmarkConfig> allConfigs = new ArrayList<>();
   256	        allConfigs.add(BenchmarkConfig.create("SLOT_BY_SLOT")
   257	                .executionMode(GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT)
   258	                .maxTokens(tokens));
   259	
   260	        if (Nd4j.getNativeOps().isTritonAvailable()) {
   261	            allConfigs.add(BenchmarkConfig.create("TRITON_NO_GC")
   262	                    .tritonIncludeTypes("CONST_GEN,GATHER,CONCAT,SPLIT,STACK,NORMALIZATION,ATTENTION")
   263	                    .tritonSectionFusion(true).tritonCompileAll(true)
   264	                    .maxTokens(tokens));
   265	
   266	            allConfigs.add(BenchmarkConfig.optimal().maxTokens(tokens));
   267	        }
   268	
   269	        // Filter by vlm.validation.configs if specified
   270	        if (configFilter != null && !configFilter.isEmpty()) {
   271	            Set<String> allowed = new LinkedHashSet<>();
   272	            for (String s : configFilter.split(",")) {
   273	                allowed.add(s.trim().toUpperCase());
   274	            }
   275	            allConfigs.removeIf(c -> !allowed.contains(c.getName().toUpperCase()));
   276	            log.info("Filtered to {} configs via vlm.validation.configs={}", allConfigs.size(), configFilter);
   277	        }
   278	
   279	        return allConfigs.stream();
   280	    }

   282	    // ─── Test: Output accuracy across configs ──────────────────────────────
   283	
   284	    @ParameterizedTest(name = "outputAccuracy[{0}]")
   285	    @MethodSource("outputAccuracyConfigs")
   286	    @DisplayName("DSP output accuracy vs SLOT_BY_SLOT baseline")
   287	    public void testOutputAccuracy(BenchmarkConfig config) throws Exception {
   288	        ensureModelsLoaded();
   289	        log.info("Testing output accuracy for config: {}", config.getName());
   290	
   291	        int maxTokens = config.getMaxTokens();
   292	
   293	        // Reference: SLOT_BY_SLOT decode
   294	        GenerationResult refResult = runDecode(
   295	                BenchmarkConfig.create("REF_SLOT_BY_SLOT")
   296	                        .executionMode(GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT)
   297	                        .maxTokens(maxTokens),
   298	                maxTokens);
   299	
   300	        // Test: config under test
   301	        GenerationResult testResult = runDecode(config, maxTokens);
   302	
   303	        // Compare generated tokens
   304	        int[] refTokens = refResult.getTokenIds();
   305	        int[] testTokens = testResult.getTokenIds();
   306	        int minLen = Math.min(refTokens.length, testTokens.length);
   307	
   308	        int matches = 0;
   309	        int firstDivergent = -1;
   310	        for (int i = 0; i < minLen; i++) {
   311	            if (refTokens[i] == testTokens[i]) {
   312	                matches++;
   313	            } else if (firstDivergent < 0) {
   314	                firstDivergent = i;
   315	            }
   316	        }
   317	
   318	        double matchRate = minLen > 0 ? (double) matches / minLen : 1.0;
   319	        log.info("[{}] Token match rate: {}/{} ({}%)", config.getName(),
   320	                matches, minLen, String.format("%.1f", matchRate * 100));
   321	        log.info("[{}] Reference text: {}", config.getName(), refResult.getText());
   322	        log.info("[{}] Test text:      {}", config.getName(), testResult.getText());
   323	        if (firstDivergent >= 0) {
   324	            log.info("[{}] First divergent token at step {}: ref={} test={}",
   325	                    config.getName(), firstDivergent,
   326	                    refTokens[firstDivergent], testTokens[firstDivergent]);
   327	        }
   328	        if (verbose) {
   329	            for (int i = 0; i < minLen; i++) {
   330	                String match = refTokens[i] == testTokens[i] ? "OK" : "DIVERGE";
   331	                log.info("[{}] Step {}: ref={} test={} [{}]", config.getName(),
   332	                        i, refTokens[i], testTokens[i], match);
   333	            }
   334	        }
   335	
   336	        double requiredRate;
   337	        if (config.getExecutionMode() == GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT) {
   338	            requiredRate = 1.0;
   339	        } else if (config.isCublasTf32() || config.isTritonTf32()) {
   340	            // TF32 reduces mantissa from 23 to 10 bits. For autoregressive decode,
   341	            // small numerical differences accumulate across steps, causing token
   342	            // divergence within 2-3 steps. Token-level match is not meaningful —
   343	            // verify that the model produces non-degenerate output instead.
   344	            requiredRate = Math.min(configuredMatchRate / 100.0, 0.15);
   345	        } else {
   346	            requiredRate = configuredMatchRate / 100.0;
   347	        }
   348	        assertTrue(matchRate >= requiredRate,
   349	                config.getName() + ": token match rate too low: "
   350	                        + String.format("%.1f%% (required %.1f%%)",
   351	                        matchRate * 100, requiredRate * 100));
   352	    }

   367	    @Test
   368	    @DisplayName("Decode step comparison: SLOT_BY_SLOT vs OPTIMAL generated text")
   369	    public void testDecodeStepValidation() throws Exception {
   370	        if (!Nd4j.getNativeOps().isTritonAvailable()) {
   371	            log.info("Triton not available, skipping decode step validation");
   372	            return;
   373	        }
   374	        ensureModelsLoaded();
   375	        log.info("Running decode step validation...");
   376	
   377	        int maxTokens = getTokens(10);
   378	
   379	        // Run SLOT_BY_SLOT decode
   380	        GenerationResult refResult = runDecode(
   381	                BenchmarkConfig.create("REF_SLOT_BY_SLOT")
   382	                        .executionMode(GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT)
   383	                        .maxTokens(maxTokens),
   384	                maxTokens);
   385	
   386	        // Run OPTIMAL decode
   387	        GenerationResult testResult = runDecode(
   388	                BenchmarkConfig.optimal().maxTokens(maxTokens),
   389	                maxTokens);
   390	
   391	        // Compare generated token IDs
   392	        int[] refTokens = refResult.getTokenIds();
   393	        int[] testTokens = testResult.getTokenIds();
   394	        int minLen = Math.min(refTokens.length, testTokens.length);
   395	
   396	        int matches = 0;
   397	        int firstDivergent = -1;
   398	        for (int i = 0; i < minLen; i++) {
   399	            if (refTokens[i] == testTokens[i]) {
   400	                matches++;
   401	            } else if (firstDivergent < 0) {
   402	                firstDivergent = i;
   403	            }
   404	        }
   405	
   406	        double matchRate = minLen > 0 ? (double) matches / minLen : 1.0;
   407	        log.info("Token match rate: {}/{} ({}%)", matches, minLen, String.format("%.1f", matchRate * 100));
   408	        log.info("Reference text: {}", refResult.getText());
   409	        log.info("Test text:      {}", testResult.getText());
   410	        if (firstDivergent >= 0) {
   411	            log.info("First divergent token at step {}: ref={} test={}",
   412	                    firstDivergent, refTokens[firstDivergent], testTokens[firstDivergent]);
   413	        }
   414	        if (verbose) {
   415	            for (int i = 0; i < minLen; i++) {
   416	                String match = refTokens[i] == testTokens[i] ? "OK" : "DIVERGE";
   417	                log.info("Step {}: ref={} test={} [{}]", i, refTokens[i], testTokens[i], match);
   418	            }
   419	        }
   420	
   421	        // OPTIMAL uses TF32 by default — token-level match with FP32 slot-by-slot
   422	        // will be low due to mantissa truncation (23→10 bits). For TF32, verify
   423	        // the model produces non-degenerate output rather than exact token match.
   424	        BenchmarkConfig optimalCfg = BenchmarkConfig.optimal();
   425	        double requiredRate = (optimalCfg.isCublasTf32() || optimalCfg.isTritonTf32())
   426	                ? Math.min(configuredMatchRate / 100.0, 0.15)
   427	                : configuredMatchRate / 100.0;
   428	        assertTrue(matchRate >= requiredRate,
   429	                "Token match rate too low: " + String.format("%.1f%% (required %.1f%%)",
   430	                        matchRate * 100, requiredRate * 100));
   431	    }

   451	                        .tritonSectionFusion(true).tritonCompileAll(true)

   456

   470	        int minLen = Math.min(noTf32Tokens.length, tf32Tokens.length);
   471	        int matches = 0;
   472	        for (int i = 0; i < minLen; i++) {
   473	            if (noTf32Tokens[i] == tf32Tokens[i]) matches++;
   474	        }
   475	        double matchRate = minLen > 0 ? (double) matches / minLen : 1.0;
   476	
   477	        log.info("TF32 token match rate: {}/{} ({}%)", matches, minLen,
   478	                String.format("%.1f", matchRate * 100));
   479	        log.info("NO_TF32 text: {}", noTf32Result.getText());
   480	        log.info("TF32 text:    {}", tf32Result.getText());
   481	    }

   834	    // ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

   836	    private GenerationResult runDecode(BenchmarkConfig config, int maxTokens) throws Exception {
   837	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.resetModelState(decoder);
   838	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.resetModelState(embedTokens);
   839	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.apply(config);
   840	
   841	        ModelIOConfig ioConfig = ModelIOConfig.discover(decoder);
   842	
   843	        if (config.isTriton()) {
   844	            decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   845	            decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   846	            List<String> outputs = new ArrayList<>(decoder.outputs());
   847	            BenchmarkConfigApplier.compileModel(decoder, "decoder", outputs, config);
   848	
   849	            embedTokens.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   850	            embedTokens.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   851	            List<String> embedOutputs = new ArrayList<>(embedTokens.outputs());
   852	            BenchmarkConfigApplier.compileModel(embedTokens, "embed_tokens", embedOutputs, config);
   853	        } else if (config.getExecutionMode() != null) {
   854	            decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   855	            decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   856	            List<String> outputs = new ArrayList<>(decoder.outputs());
   857	            decoder.compileNativeDynamicShapePlan(outputs, config.getExecutionMode(), true);
   858	        }
   859	
   860	        StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop loop = StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.builder()
   861	                .decoder(decoder)
   862	                .embedTokens(embedTokens)
   863	                .tokenizer(tokenizer)
   864	                .ioConfig(ioConfig)
   865	                .samplingConfig(SamplingConfig.greedy())
   866	                .maxNewTokens(maxTokens)
   867	                .hiddenSize(hiddenSize)
   868	                .build();
   869	
   870	        return loop.decode(inputsEmbeds.dup(), promptTokenIds);
   871	    }

   873	    // ─── Memory diagnostics ──────────────────────────────────────────────
   874	
   875	    /**
   876	     * Measures per-step GPU memory in the real SmolDocling decode loop.
   877	     * Runs 20 steps SLOT_BY_SLOT, then checks:
   878	     *   1. How much memory was consumed (before any manual trim)
   879	     *   2. How much trim recovers
   880	     *   3. What's left (true leak vs reclaimable pool hold)
   881	     */
   882	    @Test
   883	    @DisplayName("Trim impact on per-step GPU memory in real decode loop")
   884	    public void testTrimImpactOnDecodeMemory() throws Exception {
   885	        ensureModelsLoaded();
   886	        var nativeOps = org.nd4j.nativeblas.NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
   887	        int device = org.nd4j.linalg.factory.Nd4j.getAffinityManager()
   888	                .getDeviceForCurrentThread().intValue();
   889	        int steps = 20;
   890	
   891	        log.info("=== TRIM IMPACT TEST: {} steps on device {} ===", steps, device);
   892	        log.info("TRIM_INTERVAL=50 (static final in InferenceSession, cannot change at runtime)");
   893	
   894	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.resetModelState(decoder);
   895	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.resetModelState(embedTokens);
   896	        BenchmarkConfig slotConfig = BenchmarkConfig.create("MEMORY_TEST")
   897	                .executionMode(GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT)
   898	                .maxTokens(steps);
   899	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.apply(slotConfig);
   900	        decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   901	        decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   902	        decoder.compileNativeDynamicShapePlan(
   903	                new ArrayList<>(decoder.outputs()), GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT, true);
   904	
   905	        // Trim + commit to establish clean baseline
   906	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   907	        nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(device);
   908	        long baselineFree = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemory(device);
   909	        long totalMem = nativeOps.getDeviceTotalMemory(device);
   910	        log.info("[BASELINE] device={} total={}MB free={}MB used={}MB",
   911	                device, totalMem / (1024*1024), baselineFree / (1024*1024),
   912	                (totalMem - baselineFree) / (1024*1024));
   913	
   914	        ModelIOConfig ioConfig = ModelIOConfig.discover(decoder);
   915	        StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop loop = StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.builder()
   916	                .decoder(decoder).embedTokens(embedTokens).tokenizer(tokenizer)
   917	                .ioConfig(ioConfig).samplingConfig(SamplingConfig.greedy())
   918	                .maxNewTokens(steps).hiddenSize(hiddenSize)
   919	                .build();
   920	
   921	        GenerationResult result = loop.decode(inputsEmbeds.dup(), promptTokenIds);
   922	        log.info("[DECODE] generated {} tokens: {}", result.getTokenIds().length,
   923	                result.getText().substring(0, Math.min(80, result.getText().length())));
   924	
   925	        // Measurement 1: memory consumed after decode (no manual trim)
   926	        long afterDecodeFree = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemory(device);
   927	        long consumedBeforeTrim = baselineFree - afterDecodeFree;
   928	        log.info("[AFTER-DECODE] free={}MB consumed={}MB ({}MB/step before trim)",
   929	                afterDecodeFree / (1024*1024), consumedBeforeTrim / (1024*1024),
   930	                consumedBeforeTrim / (1024*1024) / steps);
   931	
   932	        // Measurement 2: commit all pending async ops
   933	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   934	        long afterCommitFree = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemory(device);
   935	        long commitRecovered = afterCommitFree - afterDecodeFree;
   936	        log.info("[AFTER-COMMIT] free={}MB recovered={}MB",
   937	                afterCommitFree / (1024*1024), commitRecovered / (1024*1024));
   938	
   939	        // Measurement 3: trim the pool
   940	        nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(device);

    67	    @Test
    68	    @DisplayName("GenerationPipeline: VLM generation with SmolDocling")
    69	    public void testVLMGenerationPipeline() throws Exception {
    70	        // --- 1. Download and load models ---
    71	        log.info("Downloading SmolDocling models...");
    72	        long t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();
    73	        File decoderDir = VLMModelDownloader.download(
    74	                VLMModelDownloader.VLMModel.SMOLDOCLING_DECODER).getModelFile();
    75	        File embedDir = VLMModelDownloader.download(
    76	                VLMModelDownloader.VLMModel.SMOLDOCLING_EMBED_TOKENS).getModelFile();
    77	        File visionDir = VLMModelDownloader.download(
    78	                VLMModelDownloader.VLMModel.SMOLDOCLING_VISION_ENCODER).getModelFile();
    79	        File tokenizerDir = VLMModelDownloader.download(
    80	                VLMModelDownloader.VLMModel.SMOLDOCLING_TOKENIZER).getModelFile();
    81	        long downloadMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0;
    82	        log.info("Download complete: {}ms", downloadMs);
    83	
    84	        // Import ONNX models
    85	        long t1 = System.currentTimeMillis();
    86	        SameDiff decoder = OnnxModelCache.importWithCache(decoderDir.getAbsolutePath());
    87	        SameDiff embedTokens = OnnxModelCache.importWithCache(embedDir.getAbsolutePath());
    88	        SameDiff visionEncoder = OnnxModelCache.importWithCache(visionDir.getAbsolutePath());
    89	        long importMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - t1;
    90	        log.info("Import complete: {}ms (decoder={} ops, embed={} ops, vision={} ops)",
    91	                importMs, decoder.ops().length, embedTokens.ops().length, visionEncoder.ops().length);
    92	
    93	        Tokenizer tokenizer = HuggingFaceTokenizer.fromDirectory(tokenizerDir);
    94	
    95	        // --- 2. Process a synthetic test image ---
    96	        long t2 = System.currentTimeMillis();
    97	        BufferedImage testImage = createTestImage();
    98	        PreprocessorConfig ppConfig = PreprocessorConfig.forSmolDocling();
    99	        VLMImagePreprocessor preprocessor = VLMImagePreprocessor.fromConfig(ppConfig);
   100	
   101	        ImageTiler.SplitImageResult tileResult = ImageTiler.splitImageForVLM(testImage, ppConfig.getTargetHeight());
   102	        List<INDArray> frames = new ArrayList<>();
   103	        for (BufferedImage frame : tileResult.frames) {
   104	            frames.add(preprocessor.preprocess(frame));
   105	        }
   106	        log.info("Preprocessed {} frames from test image", frames.size());
   107	
   108	        // Vision encode - run each frame through the vision encoder
   109	        String visionInput = visionEncoder.inputs().get(0);
   110	        String visionOutput = visionEncoder.outputs().get(0);
   111	        List<INDArray> encodedFrames = new ArrayList<>();
   112	        for (INDArray frame : frames) {
   113	            Map<String, INDArray> visionResult = visionEncoder.output(
   114	                    Map.of(visionInput, frame), visionOutput);
   115	            encodedFrames.add(visionResult.get(visionOutput));
   116	        }
   117	        INDArray visionEmbeddings = Nd4j.concat(1, encodedFrames.toArray(new INDArray[0]));
   118	        long visionMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - t2;
   119	        log.info("Vision encoding: {}ms, embeddings shape={}", visionMs,
   120	                java.util.Arrays.toString(visionEmbeddings.shape()));
   121	
   122	        // --- 3. Build merged embeddings ---
   123	        long t3 = System.currentTimeMillis();
   124	        String prompt = ImagePromptBuilder.buildImagePromptString(
   125	                tileResult.numRows, tileResult.numCols, (int) visionEmbeddings.shape()[1]);
   126	        int[] promptTokenIds = tokenizer.encode(prompt, false).getIds();
   127	
   128	        // Text embedding lookup
   129	        INDArray inputIds = Nd4j.createFromArray(promptTokenIds)
   130	                .reshape(1, promptTokenIds.length).castTo(DataType.INT64);
   131	        String embedInput = embedTokens.inputs().get(0);
   132	        String embedOutput = embedTokens.outputs().get(0);
   133	        Map<String, INDArray> embedResult = embedTokens.output(
   134	                Map.of(embedInput, inputIds), embedOutput);
   135	        INDArray textEmbeddings = embedResult.get(embedOutput);
   136	
   137	        // Merge vision + text
   138	        int imageTokenId = tokenizer.getTokenId("<image>");
   139	        INDArray mergedEmbeddings = EmbeddingMerger.mergeEmbeddings(
   140	                textEmbeddings, visionEmbeddings, promptTokenIds, imageTokenId);
   141	        long embedMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - t3;
   142	        log.info("Embedding merge: {}ms, merged shape={}", embedMs,
   143	                java.util.Arrays.toString(mergedEmbeddings.shape()));
   144	
   145	        long hiddenSize = mergedEmbeddings.shape()[2];
   146	
   147	        // --- 4. Use GenerationPipeline ---
   148	        GenerationPipelineConfig pipelineConfig = GenerationPipelineConfig.builder()
   149	                .decoder(decoder)
   150	                .embedTokens(embedTokens)
   151	                .tokenizer(tokenizer)
   152	                .samplingConfig(SamplingConfig.greedy())
   153	                .maxNewTokens(20)
   154	                .hiddenSize(hiddenSize)
   155	                .kvCacheStrategy(KvCacheStrategy.STATIC)
   156	                .build();
   157	
   158	        GenerationResult result;
   159	        try (GenerationPipeline pipeline = GenerationPipeline.create(pipelineConfig)) {
   160	            assertNotNull(pipeline.getIoConfig(), "ModelIOConfig should be auto-discovered");
   161	            log.info("Pipeline created with auto-discovered I/O config");
   162	
   163	            result = pipeline.generate(mergedEmbeddings, promptTokenIds);
   164	        }
   165	
   166	        // --- 5. Validate result ---
   167	        assertNotNull(result, "GenerationResult must not be null");
   168	        assertNotNull(result.getText(), "Generated text must not be null");
   169	        assertTrue(result.getGeneratedTokenCount() > 0,
   170	                "Should have generated at least one token, got: " + result.getGeneratedTokenCount());
   171	        assertNotNull(result.getTokenIds(), "Token IDs must not be null");
   172	        assertEquals(result.getGeneratedTokenCount(), result.getTokenIds().length,
   173	                "Token count must match tokenIds length");
   174	        assertTrue(result.getGenerationTimeMs() > 0, "Generation time must be positive");
   175	        assertTrue(result.getTokensPerSecond() > 0, "Tokens/sec must be positive");
   176	        assertNotNull(result.getFinishReason(), "Finish reason must not be null");
   177	
   178	        log.info("=== GenerationPipeline Result ===");
   179	        log.info("Text: {}", result.getText().substring(0, Math.min(200, result.getText().length())));
   180	        log.info("Tokens: {}, Time: {}ms, Speed: {} tok/s",
   181	                result.getGeneratedTokenCount(), result.getGenerationTimeMs(),
   182	                String.format("%.1f", result.getTokensPerSecond()));
   183	        log.info("Finish reason: {}", result.getFinishReason());
   184	
   185	        // Cleanup
   186	        tokenizer.close();
   187	    }

    38	/**
    39	 * Smoke tests for the DecodeValidationFramework.
    40	 *
    41	 * <p>These tests prove that the framework's core components work correctly:
    42	 * multi-level comparison, replay metadata tracking, input evolution, and
    43	 * validation result reporting. They use small synthetic SameDiff graphs
    44	 * rather than full SmolDocling models to keep execution fast.</p>
    45	 *
    46	 * <h3>What these tests validate</h3>
    47	 * <ul>
    48	 *   <li>MultiLevelComparator: token prefix, logits, top-K comparison logic</li>
    49	 *   <li>ReplayMetadataTracker: phase tracking, signature stability, violation detection</li>
    50	 *   <li>DecodeInputEvolutor: evolving position_ids, attention_mask, KV buffers</li>
    51	 *   <li>ValidationResult: proper failure/success reporting, diagnostic output</li>
    52	 *   <li>DecodeValidationFramework: end-to-end orchestration with oracle vs test</li>
    53	 * </ul>
    54	 *
    55	 * <h3>What these tests do NOT validate</h3>
    56	 * <ul>
    57	 *   <li>SmolDocling benchmark correctness — that's for TestDspValidation and
    58	 *       TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation</li>
    59	 *   <li>Triton section fusion — covered by benchmark-subgraph correctness tests
    60	 *       (Workstream B)</li>
    61	 *   <li>CUDA graph replay — covered by TestCudaGraphReplayRegression</li>
    62	 * </ul>
    63	 *
    64	 * <h3>Running these tests</h3>
    65	 * <pre>
    66	 *   cd platform-tests && mvn test \
    67	 *     -Dtest=TestDecodeValidationFrameworkSmoke \
    68	 *     -Dbackend.artifactId=nd4j-cuda-12.9
    69	 * </pre>
    70	 */

   342	
   343	        List<INDArray> refLogits = new ArrayList<>();
   344	        List<Integer> refTokens = new ArrayList<>();

   353	            testLogits.add(testL);

   356	        }

   359	                refLogits, refTokens, testLogits, testTokens, "REF", "TEST");

   959	    // ─── Per-phase memory tracking: output() vs outputDirect() ─────────────
   960	
   961	    /**
   962	     * Per-phase GPU memory tracking to pinpoint exactly where memory is consumed
   963	     * during each decode step. Runs 5 decode steps with BOTH output() and
   964	     * outputDirect() to compare per-step memory consumption.
   965	     *
   966	     * For each step, measures GPU free memory at 4 phases:
   967	     *   1. BEFORE calling decoder.output/outputDirect
   968	     *   2. AFTER the output call returns (delta_output = consumption)
   969	     *   3. AFTER closing all returned outputs (recovered_close = freed memory)
   970	     *   4. AFTER Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit() + trimMemoryPool (recovered_trim)
   971	     *
   972	     * Reports delta at each phase to identify the exact culprit of 241 MB/step leak.
   973	     */
   974	    @Test
   975	    @DisplayName("Per-phase memory tracking: output() vs outputDirect() decode")
   976	    public void testPerPhaseMemoryTracking() throws Exception {
   977	        ensureModelsLoaded();
   978	        var nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
   979	        int device = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getDeviceForCurrentThread().intValue();
   980	
   981	        // Model config for SmolDocling: 30 layers, 9 heads, headDim=64, FLOAT16 KV
   982	        final int numLayers = 30;
   983	        final int numHeads = 9;
   984	        final int headDim = 64;
   985	        final DataType kvType = DataType.HALF;
   986	        final int seqLen = 10; // initial prompt length
   987	
   988	        // Discover decoder I/O
   989	        ModelIOConfig ioConfig = ModelIOConfig.discover(decoder);
   990	        List<String> decoderInputNames = decoder.inputs();
   991	        String logitsOutputName = DecoderUtils.findLogitsOutputName(decoder);
   992	        DecoderUtils.KVCacheNames kvNames = DecoderUtils.findKVCacheOutputNames(decoder);
   993	        List<String> presentKeyNames = kvNames.keyNames;
   994	        List<String> presentValueNames = kvNames.valueNames;
   995	
   996	        // Collect ALL output names (logits + present KV)
   997	        List<String> allOutputNames = new ArrayList<>();
   998	        allOutputNames.add(logitsOutputName);
   999	        allOutputNames.addAll(presentKeyNames);
  1000	        allOutputNames.addAll(presentValueNames);
  1001	        String[] fullOutputArray = allOutputNames.toArray(new String[0]);
  1002	
  1003	        log.info("=== PER-PHASE MEMORY TRACKING ===");
  1004	        log.info("Device={}, logitsOutput={}, presentKeys={}, presentValues={}",
  1005	                device, logitsOutputName, presentKeyNames.size(), presentValueNames.size());
  1006	
  1007	        // Run with output() first
  1008	        long[][] outputPhases = runPerPhaseDecodeSteps(nativeOps, device, decoder,
  1009	                decoderInputNames, fullOutputArray, logitsOutputName,
  1010	                presentKeyNames, presentValueNames, ioConfig,
  1011	                numLayers, numHeads, headDim, kvType, seqLen,
  1012	                false /* use output() */);
  1013	
  1014	        // Reset decoder state
  1015	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.resetModelState(decoder);
  1016	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
  1017	        nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(device);
  1018	
  1019	        // Run with outputDirect()
  1020	        long[][] directPhases = runPerPhaseDecodeSteps(nativeOps, device, decoder,
  1021	                decoderInputNames, fullOutputArray, logitsOutputName,
  1022	                presentKeyNames, presentValueNames, ioConfig,
  1023	                numLayers, numHeads, headDim, kvType, seqLen,
  1024	                true /* use outputDirect() */);
  1025	
  1026	        // Print summary comparison table
  1027	        int steps = 5;
  1028	        log.info("");
  1029	        log.info("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
  1030	        log.info("  SUMMARY: output() vs outputDirect() per-step memory (MB)");
  1031	        log.info("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
  1032	        log.info(String.format("%-8s %12s %12s %12s | %12s %12s %12s",
  1033	                "Step",
  1034	                "out_delta", "out_recvCls", "out_recvTrm",
  1035	                "dir_delta", "dir_recvCls", "dir_recvTrm"));
  1036	        log.info(String.format("%-8s %12s %12s %12s | %12s %12s %12s",
  1037	                "────────", "────────────", "────────────", "────────────",
  1038	                "────────────", "────────────", "────────────"));
  1039	
  1040	        long oTotalDelta = 0, oTotalRecvClose = 0, oTotalRecvTrim = 0;
  1041	        long dTotalDelta = 0, dTotalRecvClose = 0, dTotalRecvTrim = 0;
  1042	
  1043	        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
  1044	            // outputPhases[i]: [deltaOutput, recoveredClose, recoveredTrim]
  1045	            long oD = outputPhases[i][0], oC = outputPhases[i][1], oT = outputPhases[i][2];
  1046	            long dD = directPhases[i][0], dC = directPhases[i][1], dT = directPhases[i][2];
  1047	            oTotalDelta += oD; oTotalRecvClose += oC; oTotalRecvTrim += oT;

  1056	                "────────────", "────────────", "────────────"));
  1057	        log.info(String.format("%-8s %12d %12d %12d | %12d %12d %12d",
  1058	                "TOTAL",
  1059	                mb(oTotalDelta), mb(oTotalRecvClose), mb(oTotalRecvTrim),

  1061	
  1062	        long oNetLeak = oTotalDelta - oTotalRecvClose - oTotalRecvTrim;
  1063	        long dNetLeak = dTotalDelta - dTotalRecvClose - dTotalRecvTrim;
  1064	        log.info("Net leak (delta - recovered): output()={}MB  outputDirect()={}MB",
  1065	                mb(oNetLeak), mb(dNetLeak));
  1066	        log.info("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
  1067	    }
  1068	
  1069	    /**
  1070	     * Run 5 decode steps, measuring GPU memory at 4 phases per step.
  1071	     * Returns long[5][3] where each row is [deltaOutput, recoveredClose, recoveredTrim]:
  1072	     *   deltaOutput   = beforeFree - afterOutputFree  (positive = consumed)
  1073	     *   recoveredClose = afterCloseFree - afterOutputFree  (positive = freed)
  1074	     *   recoveredTrim  = afterTrimFree - afterCloseFree  (positive = freed)
  1075	     */
  1076	    private long[][] runPerPhaseDecodeSteps(
  1077	            org.nd4j.nativeblas.NativeOps nativeOps,
  1078	            int device,
  1079	            SameDiff decoder,
  1080	            List<String> decoderInputNames,
  1081	            String[] fullOutputArray,
  1082	            String logitsOutputName,
  1083	            List<String> presentKeyNames,
  1084	            List<String> presentValueNames,
  1085	            ModelIOConfig ioConfig,
  1086	            int numLayers,
  1087	            int numHeads,
  1088	            int headDim,
  1089	            DataType kvType,
  1090	            int seqLen,
  1091	            boolean useDirect) throws Exception {
  1092	
  1093	        int steps = 5;
  1094	        long[][] phases = new long[steps][3];
  1095	
  1096	        // Apply optimal config for consistent execution
  1097	        BenchmarkConfig config = BenchmarkConfig.optimal().maxTokens(steps);
  1098	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.resetModelState(decoder);
  1099	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.apply(config);
  1100	        decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
  1101	        decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
  1102	        List<String> outputs = new ArrayList<>(decoder.outputs());
  1103	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.compileModel(decoder, "decoder", outputs, config);
  1104	
  1105	        // Build initial KV cache: empty [1, numHeads, 0, headDim]
  1106	        Map<String, INDArray> kvCaches = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  1107	        for (int i = 0; i < numLayers; i++) {
  1108	            kvCaches.put("past_key_values." + i + ".key", Nd4j.zeros(kvType, 1, numHeads, 0, headDim));
  1109	            kvCaches.put("past_key_values." + i + ".value", Nd4j.zeros(kvType, 1, numHeads, 0, headDim));
  1110	        }
  1111	
  1112	        // Establish a clean baseline
  1113	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
  1114	        nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(device);
  1115	
  1116	        int currentSeqLen = seqLen;
  1117	        String modeName = useDirect ? "outputDirect" : "output";
  1118	
  1119	        log.info("");
  1120	        log.info("--- {} decode steps (mode={}) ---", steps, modeName);
  1121	
  1122	        for (int step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
  1123	            // ── Phase 1: Record GPU free memory BEFORE the step ──
  1124	            long beforeFree = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
  1125	
  1126	            // Build decoder inputs for this step
  1127	            Map<String, INDArray> inputMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  1128	
  1129	            // input_ids: [1, 1] INT64
  1130	            long nextTokenId = 100L + step;
  1131	            INDArray inputIds = Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[][]{{nextTokenId}});
  1132	            if (decoderInputNames.contains("input_ids")) {
  1133	                inputMap.put("input_ids", inputIds);
  1134	            }
  1135	
  1136	            // attention_mask: [1, currentSeqLen] INT64, all 1s
  1137	            long[] maskData = new long[currentSeqLen];
  1138	            Arrays.fill(maskData, 1L);
  1139	            INDArray attentionMask = Nd4j.createFromArray(maskData).reshape(1, currentSeqLen);
  1140	            for (String inputName : decoderInputNames) {
  1141	                if (inputName.contains("attention_mask")) {
  1142	                    inputMap.put(inputName, attentionMask);
  1143	                    break;
  1144	                }
  1145	            }
  1146	
  1147	            // position_ids: [1, 1] INT64
  1148	            INDArray positionIds = Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[][]{{currentSeqLen - 1}});
  1149	            if (decoderInputNames.contains("position_ids")) {
  1150	                inputMap.put("position_ids", positionIds);
  1151	            }
  1152	
  1153	            // inputs_embeds: [1, 1, hiddenSize] FLOAT16 if needed
  1154	            if (decoderInputNames.contains("inputs_embeds")) {
  1155	                long hiddenSizeVal = 576; // SmolDocling hidden size
  1156	                INDArray embeds = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.HALF, 1, 1, hiddenSizeVal);
  1157	                inputMap.put("inputs_embeds", embeds);
  1158	            }
  1159	
  1160	            // KV cache inputs
  1161	            for (Map.Entry<String, INDArray> entry : kvCaches.entrySet()) {
  1162	                if (decoderInputNames.contains(entry.getKey())) {
  1163	                    inputMap.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
  1164	                }
  1165	            }
  1166	
  1167	            // ── Phase 2: Call decoder output ──
  1168	            Map<String, INDArray> decoderOutputs;
  1169	            try {
  1170	                if (useDirect) {
  1171	                    decoderOutputs = decoder.outputDirect(inputMap, fullOutputArray);
  1172	                } else {
  1173	                    decoderOutputs = decoder.output(inputMap, fullOutputArray);
  1174	                }
  1175	            } catch (Exception e) {
  1176	                log.warn("Step {} decoder {} failed: {}", step + 1, modeName, e.getMessage());
  1177	                phases[step] = new long[]{-1, -1, -1};
  1178	                for (INDArray arr : inputMap.values()) {
  1179	                    if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) arr.close();
  1180	                }
  1181	                continue;
  1182	            }
  1183	
  1184	            long afterOutputFree = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
  1185	            long deltaOutput = beforeFree - afterOutputFree; // positive = consumed
  1186	
  1187	            // ── Extract KV caches BEFORE closing outputs ──
  1188	            // Close old KV cache arrays first
  1189	            for (INDArray oldKv : kvCaches.values()) {
  1190	                if (oldKv != null && oldKv.closeable() && !oldKv.wasClosed()) {
  1191	                    oldKv.close();
  1192	                }
  1193	            }
  1194	            kvCaches.clear();
  1195	
  1196	            for (int i = 0; i < numLayers; i++) {
  1197	                String presentKeyName = findLayerOutput(presentKeyNames, i);
  1198	                String presentValueName = findLayerOutput(presentValueNames, i);
  1199	
  1200	                if (presentKeyName != null && decoderOutputs.containsKey(presentKeyName)) {
  1201	                    kvCaches.put("past_key_values." + i + ".key",
  1202	                            decoderOutputs.get(presentKeyName).dup());
  1203	                } else {
  1204	                    kvCaches.put("past_key_values." + i + ".key",
  1205	                            Nd4j.zeros(kvType, 1, numHeads, currentSeqLen + 1, headDim));
  1206	                }
  1207	
  1208	                if (presentValueName != null && decoderOutputs.containsKey(presentValueName)) {
  1209	                    kvCaches.put("past_key_values." + i + ".value",
  1210	                            decoderOutputs.get(presentValueName).dup());
  1211	                } else {
  1212	                    kvCaches.put("past_key_values." + i + ".value",
  1213	                            Nd4j.zeros(kvType, 1, numHeads, currentSeqLen + 1, headDim));
  1214	                }
  1215	            }
  1216	
  1217	            // ── Phase 3: Close all returned outputs (logits + present KV) ──
  1218	            for (Map.Entry<String, INDArray> entry : decoderOutputs.entrySet()) {
  1219	                INDArray arr = entry.getValue();
  1220	                if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) {
  1221	                    arr.close();
  1222	                }
  1223	            }
  1224	
  1225	            long afterCloseFree = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
  1226	            long recoveredClose = afterCloseFree - afterOutputFree; // positive = freed
  1227	
  1228	            // ── Phase 4: Commit and trim pool ──
  1229	            Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
  1230	            nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(device);
  1231	
  1232	            long afterTrimFree = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
  1233	            long recoveredTrim = afterTrimFree - afterCloseFree; // positive = freed
  1234	
  1235	            phases[step] = new long[]{deltaOutput, recoveredClose, recoveredTrim};
  1236	
  1237	            // Close input arrays (except KV cache entries which are reused)
  1238	            for (Map.Entry<String, INDArray> entry : inputMap.entrySet()) {
  1239	                if (kvCaches.containsKey(entry.getKey())) continue; // don't close reused KV
  1240	                INDArray arr = entry.getValue();
  1241	                if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) {
  1242	                    arr.close();
  1243	                }
  1244	            }
  1245	
  1246	            currentSeqLen++;
  1247	
  1248	            log.info("step={} before={}MB after_output={}MB delta_output={}MB " +
  1249	                            "after_close={}MB recovered_close={}MB after_trim={}MB recovered_trim={}MB [{}]",
  1250	                    step + 1,
  1251	                    mb(beforeFree), mb(afterOutputFree), mb(deltaOutput),
  1252	                    mb(afterCloseFree), mb(recoveredClose),
  1253	                    mb(afterTrimFree), mb(recoveredTrim),
  1254	                    modeName.toUpperCase());
  1255	        }
  1256	
  1257	        // Clean up remaining KV caches
  1258	        for (INDArray arr : kvCaches.values()) {
  1259	            if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) {
  1260	                arr.close();
  1261	            }
  1262	        }
  1263	
  1264	        return phases;
  1265	    }
  1266	
  1267	    /** Find the present KV output name matching layer index. */
  1268	    private static String findLayerOutput(List<String> names, int layerIdx) {
  1269	        for (String name : names) {
  1270	            if (name.contains("." + layerIdx + ".") || name.endsWith("." + layerIdx)) {
  1271	                return name;
  1272	            }
  1273	        }
  1274	        return null;
  1275	    }
  1276	
  1277	    private static long mb(long bytes) {
  1278	        return bytes / (1024 * 1024);
  1279	    }
  1280	
  1281	    // ─── Exact decode loop memory isolation ──────────────────────────────────
  1282	
  1283	    /**
  1284	     * Isolates which specific decode-loop operation triggers the ~256MB/step GPU leak.
  1285	     *
  1286	     * Runs 5 variants, each changing ONE thing compared to a stable baseline:
  1287	     *   A. New HashMap each step (same arrays)
  1288	     *   B. clearPlaceholders(false) between steps
  1289	     *   C. associateArrayWithVariable for position_ids between steps
  1290	     *   D. New attention_mask array each step (growing shape)
  1291	     *   E. Full DecoderUtils.buildDecoderInputMap path
  1292	     *
  1293	     * The baseline (3 warmup steps with identical inputs) should show 0 MB/step growth.
  1294	     * Whichever variant shows ~256MB/step growth is the culprit.
  1295	     */
  1296	    @Test
  1297	    @DisplayName("Exact decode loop memory isolation: which operation leaks 256MB/step?")
  1298	    public void testExactDecodeLoopMemoryIsolation() throws Exception {
  1299	        ensureModelsLoaded();
  1300	        var nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
  1301	        int device = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getDeviceForCurrentThread().intValue();
  1302	
  1303	        // SmolDocling model constants
  1304	        final int numLayers = 30;
  1305	        final int numHeads = 9;
  1306	        final int headDim = 64;
  1307	        final long hiddenSizeVal = 576;
  1308	        final DataType kvType = DataType.HALF;
  1309	        final int maxKvLen = 20;
  1310	
  1311	        // ── Setup: reset decoder, enable DSP, compile ──
  1312	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.resetModelState(decoder);
  1313	        decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
  1314	        decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
  1315	        List<String> outputs = new ArrayList<>(decoder.outputs());
  1316	        decoder.compileNativeDynamicShapePlan(outputs, GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT, true);
  1317	
  1318	        List<String> decoderInputNames = decoder.inputs();
  1319	        ModelIOConfig ioConfig = ModelIOConfig.discover(decoder);
  1320	        String logitsOutputName = DecoderUtils.findLogitsOutputName(decoder);
  1321	        DecoderUtils.KVCacheNames kvNames = DecoderUtils.findKVCacheOutputNames(decoder);
  1322	
  1323	        // Collect all output names
  1324	        List<String> allOutputNames = new ArrayList<>();
  1325	        allOutputNames.add(logitsOutputName);
  1326	        allOutputNames.addAll(kvNames.keyNames);
  1327	        allOutputNames.addAll(kvNames.valueNames);
  1328	        String[] fullOutputArray = allOutputNames.toArray(new String[0]);
  1329	
  1330	        // ── Build FIXED inputs (reused across warmup and variants A/B/C) ──
  1331	        INDArray inputIds = Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[][]{{42L}});
  1332	        INDArray attentionMask = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, maxKvLen + 1);
  1333	        attentionMask.putScalar(0, 0, 1); // one attended position
  1334	        attentionMask.putScalar(0, maxKvLen, 1); // current token
  1335	        INDArray positionIds = Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[][]{{0L}});
  1336	        INDArray inputsEmbeds = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.HALF, 1, 1, hiddenSizeVal);
  1337	
  1338	        // Build static KV buffers (fixed shape, reused)
  1339	        Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  1340	        for (int i = 0; i < numLayers; i++) {
  1341	            staticKvBuffers.put("past_key_values." + i + ".key",
  1342	                    Nd4j.zeros(kvType, 1, numHeads, maxKvLen, headDim));
  1343	            staticKvBuffers.put("past_key_values." + i + ".value",
  1344	                    Nd4j.zeros(kvType, 1, numHeads, maxKvLen, headDim));
  1345	        }
  1346	
  1347	        // Build the fixed input map
  1348	        Map<String, INDArray> fixedInputMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  1349	        if (decoderInputNames.contains("input_ids")) fixedInputMap.put("input_ids", inputIds);
  1350	        for (String name : decoderInputNames) {
  1351	            if (name.contains("attention_mask")) { fixedInputMap.put(name, attentionMask); break; }
  1352	        }
  1353	        if (decoderInputNames.contains("position_ids")) fixedInputMap.put("position_ids", positionIds);
  1354	        if (decoderInputNames.contains("inputs_embeds")) fixedInputMap.put("inputs_embeds", inputsEmbeds);
  1355	        for (Map.Entry<String, INDArray> kv : staticKvBuffers.entrySet()) {
  1356	            if (decoderInputNames.contains(kv.getKey())) fixedInputMap.put(kv.getKey(), kv.getValue());
  1357	        }
  1358	
  1359	        log.info("=== EXACT DECODE LOOP MEMORY ISOLATION ===");
  1360	        log.info("Device={}, maxKvLen={}, inputs={}, outputs={}",
  1361	                device, maxKvLen, fixedInputMap.size(), fullOutputArray.length);
  1362	
  1363	        // ── Warmup: 3 steps with FIXED identical inputs (expect ~0 MB/step) ──
  1364	        log.info("--- WARMUP: 3 steps with identical inputs ---");
  1365	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
  1366	        nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(device);
  1367	
  1368	        for (int step = 0; step < 3; step++) {
  1369	            long before = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
  1370	            Map<String, INDArray> out = decoder.output(fixedInputMap, fullOutputArray);
  1371	            for (INDArray arr : out.values()) {
  1372	                if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) arr.close();
  1373	            }
  1374	            Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
  1375	            nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(device);
  1376	            long after = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
  1377	            log.info("[WARMUP] step={} gpuFree={}MB delta={}MB", step, mb(after), mb(before - after));
  1378	        }
  1379	
  1380	        // ── VARIANT A: New HashMap each step, same arrays ──
  1381	        runVariant("A_NEW_HASHMAP", nativeOps, device, 5, step -> {
  1382	            Map<String, INDArray> newMap = new HashMap<>(fixedInputMap);
  1383	            Map<String, INDArray> out = decoder.output(newMap, fullOutputArray);
  1384	            for (INDArray arr : out.values()) {
  1385	                if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) arr.close();
  1386	            }
  1387	        });
  1388	
  1389	        // ── VARIANT B: clearPlaceholders(false) between steps ──
  1390	        runVariant("B_CLEAR_PLACEHOLDERS", nativeOps, device, 5, step -> {
  1391	            decoder.clearPlaceholders(false);
  1392	            Map<String, INDArray> out = decoder.output(fixedInputMap, fullOutputArray);
  1393	            for (INDArray arr : out.values()) {
  1394	                if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) arr.close();
  1395	            }
  1396	        });
  1397	
  1398	        // ── VARIANT C: associateArrayWithVariable for position_ids ──
  1399	        runVariant("C_ASSOCIATE_POSITION_IDS", nativeOps, device, 5, step -> {
  1400	            INDArray newPos = Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[][]{{(long) step}});
  1401	            decoder.associateArrayWithVariable(newPos, "position_ids");
  1402	            Map<String, INDArray> out = decoder.output(fixedInputMap, fullOutputArray);
  1403	            for (INDArray arr : out.values()) {
  1404	                if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) arr.close();
  1405	            }
  1406	            newPos.close();
  1407	        });
  1408	
  1409	        // ── VARIANT D: New attention_mask each step (growing by 1 element) ──
  1410	        runVariant("D_GROWING_ATTN_MASK", nativeOps, device, 5, step -> {
  1411	            int maskLen = maxKvLen + 1 + step; // grows each step
  1412	            INDArray newMask = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, maskLen);
  1413	            newMask.putScalar(0, 0, 1);
  1414	            newMask.putScalar(0, maskLen - 1, 1);
  1415	            Map<String, INDArray> variantMap = new LinkedHashMap<>(fixedInputMap);
  1416	            // Replace attention_mask
  1417	            for (String name : decoderInputNames) {
  1418	                if (name.contains("attention_mask")) { variantMap.put(name, newMask); break; }
  1419	            }
  1420	            Map<String, INDArray> out = decoder.output(variantMap, fullOutputArray);
  1421	            for (INDArray arr : out.values()) {
  1422	                if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) arr.close();
  1423	            }
  1424	            newMask.close();
  1425	        });
  1426	
  1427	        // ── VARIANT E: Full DecoderUtils.buildDecoderInputMap ──
  1428	        runVariant("E_FULL_BUILD_INPUT_MAP", nativeOps, device, 5, step -> {
  1429	            long cachePos = step + 1;
  1430	            Map<String, INDArray> builtMap = DecoderUtils.buildDecoderInputMap(
  1431	                    ioConfig, decoderInputNames, decoder,
  1432	                    inputsEmbeds, inputIds,
  1433	                    /*pastSeqLen=*/ cachePos, /*currentSeqLen=*/ 1L,
  1434	                    staticKvBuffers, maxKvLen, cachePos,
  1435	                    /*usingStaticKv=*/ true, hiddenSizeVal,
  1436	                    /*reusableInputs=*/ null,
  1437	                    /*dspActive=*/ true);
  1438	            Map<String, INDArray> out = decoder.output(builtMap, fullOutputArray);
  1439	            for (INDArray arr : out.values()) {
  1440	                if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) arr.close();
  1441	            }
  1442	            // Close any newly allocated arrays in builtMap that aren't our fixed buffers
  1443	            for (Map.Entry<String, INDArray> e : builtMap.entrySet()) {
  1444	                INDArray arr = e.getValue();
  1445	                if (arr != null && arr != inputsEmbeds && arr != inputIds
  1446	                        && !staticKvBuffers.containsValue(arr)
  1447	                        && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) {
  1448	                    arr.close();
  1449	                }
  1450	            }
  1451	        });
  1452	
  1453	        // ── Cleanup ──
  1454	        for (INDArray arr : staticKvBuffers.values()) {
  1455	            if (arr != null && arr.closeable() && !arr.wasClosed()) arr.close();
  1456	        }
  1457	        inputIds.close();
  1458	        attentionMask.close();
  1459	        positionIds.close();
  1460	        inputsEmbeds.close();
  1461	
  1462	        log.info("=== DONE: Check per-variant deltas above to identify the leak source ===");
  1463	    }
  1464	
  1465	    // ─── Changing inputs memory leak test ─────────────────────────────────
  1466	
  1467	    /**
  1468	     * Tests whether changing placeholder values between decode calls causes a
  1469	     * memory leak (expected ~256MB/step) while fixed inputs (padded static KV
  1470	     * cache mode) do NOT leak.
  1471	     *
  1472	     * Runs TWO full decode sessions:
  1473	     *   1. PADDED mode (default): all external inputs have FIXED shapes, NDArray
  1474	     *      objects are reused across steps — shapes never change.
  1475	     *   2. NON-PADDED mode (nd4j.dsp.noPadded=true): attention mask grows each
  1476	     *      step, forcing new NDArray allocations and shape changes.
  1477	     *
  1478	     * Compares GPU memory consumption between the two modes to determine whether
  1479	     * the leak is caused by changing input shapes/objects.
  1480	     */
  1481	    @Test
  1482	    @DisplayName("Changing inputs memory leak: padded (fixed shapes) vs non-padded (growing shapes)")
  1483	    public void testChangingInputsMemoryLeak() throws Exception {
  1484	        ensureModelsLoaded();
  1485	        var nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
  1486	        int device = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getDeviceForCurrentThread().intValue();
  1487	        int prefillTokens = 9;
  1488	        int decodeSteps = 10;
  1489	
  1490	        log.info("=== CHANGING INPUTS MEMORY LEAK TEST ===");
  1491	        log.info("prefillTokens={} decodeSteps={} device={}", prefillTokens, decodeSteps, device);
  1492	
  1493	        // ── Phase 1: PADDED mode (default — fixed shapes, no leak expected) ──
  1494	        log.info("[CHANGING_INPUTS] phase=PADDED_SETUP");
  1495	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.resetModelState(decoder);
  1496	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.resetModelState(embedTokens);
  1497	        BenchmarkConfig paddedConfig = BenchmarkConfig.create("PADDED_MEMORY_TEST")
  1498	                .executionMode(GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT)
  1499	                .maxTokens(decodeSteps);
  1500	        BenchmarkConfigApplier.apply(paddedConfig);
  1501	        decoder.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
  1502	        decoder.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
  1503	        decoder.compileNativeDynamicShapePlan(
  1504	                new ArrayList<>(decoder.outputs()), GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT, true);
  1505	
  1506	        ModelIOConfig ioConfig = ModelIOConfig.discover(decoder);
  1507	        StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop paddedLoop = StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.builder()
  1508	                .decoder(decoder).embedTokens(embedTokens).tokenizer(tokenizer)
  1509	                .ioConfig(ioConfig).samplingConfig(SamplingConfig.greedy())
  1510	                .maxNewTokens(decodeSteps).hiddenSize(hiddenSize)
  1511	                .build();
  1512	
  1513	        // Establish clean baseline
  1514	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
  1515	        nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(device);
  1516	        long paddedBeforeFree = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
