  1683	    @FunctionalInterface
  1684	    private interface VariantStep {
  1685	        void run(int step) throws Exception;
  1686	    }
  1687	
  1688	    private void runVariant(String name, org.nd4j.nativeblas.NativeOps nativeOps,
  1689	                            int device, int steps, VariantStep action) throws Exception {
  1690	        log.info("--- VARIANT {} ({} steps) ---", name, steps);
  1691	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
  1692	        nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(device);
  1693	        long baselineFree = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
  1694	
  1695	        for (int step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
  1696	            long before = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
  1697	            action.run(step);
  1698	            Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
  1699	            nativeOps.trimMemoryPool(device);
  1700	            long after = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
  1701	            long delta = before - after;
  1702	            log.info("[VARIANT] name={} step={} gpuFree={}MB delta={}MB", name, step, mb(after), mb(delta));
  1703	        }
  1704	
  1705	        long finalFree = nativeOps.getDeviceFreeMemoryDefault();
  1706	        long totalLeak = baselineFree - finalFree;
  1707	        log.info("[VARIANT] name={} TOTAL: baseline={}MB final={}MB totalLeak={}MB avgPerStep={}MB",
  1708	                name, mb(baselineFree), mb(finalFree), mb(totalLeak), mb(totalLeak) / steps);
  1709	    }
  1710	}

    33	/**
    34	 * Tests for StaticKvCacheManager — verifies initialization, scatter, and

    37	public class TestStaticKvCacheManager {
    38	
    39	    private static final int NUM_HEADS = 4;
    40	    private static final int HEAD_DIM = 16;
    41	    private static final int NUM_LAYERS = 2;
    42	
    43	    private DecoderUtils.KVCacheNames createKvNames() {
    44	        List<String> keyNames = new ArrayList<>();
    45	        List<String> valueNames = new ArrayList<>();
    46	        for (int i = 0; i < NUM_LAYERS; i++) {
    47	            keyNames.add("present." + i + ".key");
    48	            valueNames.add("present." + i + ".value");
    49	        }
    50	        return new DecoderUtils.KVCacheNames(keyNames, valueNames);
    51	    }
    52	
    53	    private Map<String, INDArray> createPrefillOutputs(int prefillLen) {
    54	        Map<String, INDArray> outputs = new HashMap<>();
    55	        for (int i = 0; i < NUM_LAYERS; i++) {
    56	            outputs.put("present." + i + ".key",
    57	                    Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, prefillLen, HEAD_DIM));
    58	            outputs.put("present." + i + ".value",
    59	                    Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, prefillLen, HEAD_DIM));
    60	        }
    61	        return outputs;
    62	    }
    63	
    64	    @Test
    65	    public void testInitializeFromPrefill() {
    66	        StaticKvCacheManager manager = new StaticKvCacheManager();
    67	        DecoderUtils.KVCacheNames kvNames = createKvNames();
    68	        int prefillLen = 10;
    69	        int maxNewTokens = 50;
    70	
    71	        Map<String, INDArray> prefillOutputs = createPrefillOutputs(prefillLen);
    72	
    73	        manager.initializeFromPrefill(prefillOutputs, kvNames, maxNewTokens, prefillLen);
    74	
    75	        assertTrue(manager.isInitialized());
    76	        assertEquals(prefillLen + maxNewTokens, manager.getMaxKvLen());
    77	        assertEquals(prefillLen, manager.getCachePosition());
    78	        assertTrue(manager.supportsCudaGraphReplay());
    79	        assertEquals(KvCacheStrategy.STATIC, manager.getStrategy());
    80	
    81	        // Verify buffers exist for all KV inputs
    82	        Map<String, INDArray> buffers = manager.getStaticKvBuffers();
    83	        assertNotNull(buffers);
    84	        assertEquals(NUM_LAYERS * 2, buffers.size());
    85	
    86	        // Verify buffer shapes
    87	        for (INDArray buf : buffers.values()) {
    88	            assertArrayEquals(new long[]{1, NUM_HEADS, prefillLen + maxNewTokens, HEAD_DIM},
    89	                    buf.shape());
    90	        }
    91	
    92	        // Verify prefill data was copied into buffers
    93	        INDArray firstKey = buffers.get("past_key_values.0.key");
    94	        assertNotNull(firstKey);
    95	        INDArray prefillSlice = firstKey.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
    96	                NDArrayIndex.interval(0, prefillLen), NDArrayIndex.all());
    97	        // Prefill data should be non-zero
    98	        assertTrue(prefillSlice.amaxNumber().doubleValue() > 0.01);
    99	
   100	        // Padding should be zeros
   101	        INDArray padSlice = firstKey.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   102	                NDArrayIndex.interval(prefillLen, prefillLen + maxNewTokens), NDArrayIndex.all());
   103	        assertEquals(0.0, padSlice.amaxNumber().doubleValue(), 1e-6,
   104	                "Padding region should be zeros");
   105	
   106	        manager.close();
   107	    }

   109	    @Test
   110	    public void testScatterNewEntries() {
   111	        StaticKvCacheManager manager = new StaticKvCacheManager();
   112	        DecoderUtils.KVCacheNames kvNames = createKvNames();
   113	        int prefillLen = 5;
   114	        int maxNewTokens = 10;
   115	
   116	        Map<String, INDArray> prefillOutputs = createPrefillOutputs(prefillLen);
   117	        manager.initializeFromPrefill(prefillOutputs, kvNames, maxNewTokens, prefillLen);
   118	
   119	        long initialPos = manager.getCachePosition();
   120	        assertEquals(prefillLen, initialPos);
   121	
   122	        // Create decode outputs (present KV from the MHA op)
   123	        // Present shape is [1, numHeads, cachePos+1, headDim] (concat of past + new)
   124	        long presentLen = initialPos + 1;
   125	        Map<String, INDArray> decodeOutputs = new HashMap<>();
   126	        for (int i = 0; i < NUM_LAYERS; i++) {
   127	            INDArray presentKey = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, presentLen, HEAD_DIM);
   128	            INDArray presentValue = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, presentLen, HEAD_DIM);
   129	            // Set last position to known value
   130	            presentKey.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   131	                    NDArrayIndex.point(presentLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(42.0);
   132	            presentValue.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   133	                    NDArrayIndex.point(presentLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(-42.0);
   134	            decodeOutputs.put("present." + i + ".key", presentKey);
   135	            decodeOutputs.put("present." + i + ".value", presentValue);
   136	        }
   137	
   138	        manager.scatterNewEntries(decodeOutputs, kvNames);
   139	
   140	        // Position should advance
   141	        assertEquals(initialPos + 1, manager.getCachePosition());
   142	
   143	        // Verify the value was written at the correct position
   144	        Map<String, INDArray> buffers = manager.getStaticKvBuffers();
   145	        INDArray firstKey = buffers.get("past_key_values.0.key");
   146	        INDArray scatteredPos = firstKey.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   147	                NDArrayIndex.point(initialPos), NDArrayIndex.all());
   148	        assertEquals(42.0, scatteredPos.getDouble(0), 0.01,
   149	                "Scattered value should be 42.0 at position " + initialPos);
   150	
   151	        manager.close();
   152	    }

   189	            Map<String, INDArray> decodeOutputs = new HashMap<>();
   190	            for (int i = 0; i < NUM_LAYERS; i++) {
   191	                INDArray presentKey = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, presentLen, HEAD_DIM);
   192	                INDArray presentValue = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, presentLen, HEAD_DIM);
   193	                // Fill last position with step-specific value
   194	                float stepVal = (step + 1) * 10.0f;
   195	                presentKey.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   196	                        NDArrayIndex.point(presentLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(stepVal);
   197	                presentValue.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   198	                        NDArrayIndex.point(presentLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(-stepVal);
   199	                decodeOutputs.put("present." + i + ".key", presentKey);
   200	                decodeOutputs.put("present." + i + ".value", presentValue);
   201	            }
   202	
   203	            manager.scatterNewEntries(decodeOutputs, kvNames);
   204	        }
   205	
   206	        assertEquals(prefillLen + 10, manager.getCachePosition());

   208	        // Verify each step wrote correctly

   211	
   212	        for (int step = 0; step < 10; step++) {

   215	                    NDArrayIndex.point(pos), NDArrayIndex.all()).getDouble(0);

   217	            assertEquals(expected, val, 0.01,

   246	        Map<String, INDArray> prefillOutputs = createPrefillOutputs(5);
   247	        manager.initializeFromPrefill(prefillOutputs, kvNames, 10, 5);
   248	
   249	        assertTrue(manager.isInitialized());
   250	        assertNotNull(manager.getStaticKvBuffers());
   251	
   252	        manager.close();
   253	
   254	        assertFalse(manager.isInitialized());
   255	        assertNull(manager.getStaticKvBuffers());
   256	    }

    20	package org.eclipse.deeplearning4j.llm.generation;
    21	
    22	import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
    23	import org.nd4j.linalg.api.buffer.DataType;
    24	import org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray;
    25	import org.nd4j.linalg.factory.Nd4j;
    26	
    27	import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
    28	
    29	/**
    30	 * Regression tests for the nativeDecodeInputs feature.
    31	 *
    32	 * Root cause: C++ updateDecodeInputs() wrote to external input arrays, but the
    33	 * frozen CUDA graph replay path reads from separate capture buffers. When Java
    34	 * skipped feedDict updates (because C++ was "handling it"), the D2D copies
    35	 * pushed stale values to capture buffers → model saw the same position every
    36	 * step → repeating tokens.
    37	 *
    38	 * Fix: platformTryFrozenFastPath now writes pending decode values directly to
    39	 * capture buffers after the D2D copy loop, before graph launch.
    40	 */
    41	public class TestNativeDecodeInputsRegression {
    42	
    43	    /**
    44	     * Validates that position_ids must increment each step for correct output.
    45	     * When position_ids is frozen (same value every step), the model produces
    46	     * identical logits → repeating tokens.
    47	     */
    48	    @Test
    49	    public void testPositionIdsMustIncrement() {
    50	        // Simulate 5 decode steps with position_ids
    51	        INDArray posIds = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, 1);
    52	
    53	        long[] positions = new long[5];
    54	        for (int step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
    55	            long pos = 679 + step;
    56	            posIds.putScalar(0, 0, pos);
    57	            positions[step] = posIds.getLong(0, 0);
    58	        }
    59	
    60	        // All positions must be different
    61	        for (int i = 0; i < positions.length - 1; i++) {
    62	            assertNotEquals(positions[i], positions[i + 1],
    63	                    "position_ids must increment: step " + i + " and " + (i + 1) + " are both " + positions[i]);
    64	        }
    65	
    66	        // Positions must be sequential
    67	        for (int i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
    68	            assertEquals(679 + i, positions[i],
    69	                    "position_ids[" + i + "] should be " + (679 + i) + " but was " + positions[i]);
    70	        }
    71	    }
    72	
    73	    /**
    74	     * Validates that attention_mask accumulates 1s at each step.
    75	     * When the mask is frozen (same pattern every step), the model only
    76	     * attends to the same positions → no new context → repeating tokens.
    77	     */
    78	    @Test
    79	    public void testAttentionMaskAccumulates() {
    80	        int totalSeqLen = 930;
    81	        int initialFilled = 680; // positions 0..679
    82	
    83	        INDArray mask = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, totalSeqLen);
    84	        // Initial fill
    85	        mask.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(0),
    86	                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, initialFilled)).assign(1);
    87	        // Last position (current token)
    88	        mask.putScalar(0, totalSeqLen - 1, 1);
    89	
    90	        long initialSum = mask.sumNumber().longValue();
    91	        assertEquals(initialFilled + 1, initialSum, "Initial mask sum");
    92	
    93	        // Simulate 5 decode steps — each step marks one more position
    94	        for (int step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
    95	            int cachePos = initialFilled + step;
    96	            mask.putScalar(0, cachePos, 1);
    97	            long sum = mask.sumNumber().longValue();
    98	            assertEquals(initialFilled + 1 + step + 1, sum,
    99	                    "After step " + step + " mask sum should increase");
   100	        }
   101	
   102	        // Verify first few and last few positions
   103	        assertEquals(1, mask.getLong(0, 0), "Position 0 should be 1");
   104	        assertEquals(1, mask.getLong(0, initialFilled - 1), "Last initial position should be 1");
   105	        assertEquals(1, mask.getLong(0, initialFilled), "First new position should be 1");
   106	        assertEquals(1, mask.getLong(0, initialFilled + 4), "Last new position should be 1");
   107	        assertEquals(0, mask.getLong(0, initialFilled + 5), "Beyond updates should be 0");
   108	    }
   109	
   110	    /**
   111	     * Validates that putScalar on a reusable CUDA buffer correctly updates
   112	     * the device memory for subsequent reads.
   113	     */
   114	    @Test
   115	    public void testReusableBufferUpdatesVisible() {
   116	        // Simulate reusable position_ids buffer (like the decode loop uses)
   117	        INDArray reusablePos = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, 1);
   118	
   119	        for (int step = 0; step < 10; step++) {
   120	            long expectedPos = 679 + step;
   121	            reusablePos.putScalar(0, 0, expectedPos);
   122	
   123	            // Force a device sync round-trip to verify the value is accessible
   124	            INDArray copy = reusablePos.dup();
   125	            long actual = copy.getLong(0, 0);
   126	            assertEquals(expectedPos, actual,
   127	                    "Step " + step + ": reusable buffer should have " + expectedPos + " but had " + actual);
   128	            copy.close();
   129	        }
   130	        reusablePos.close();
   131	    }
   132	
   133	    /**
   134	     * Validates that the 4D attn_mask_reformat incremental updates accumulate
   135	     * correctly across steps and don't interfere with each other.
   136	     */
   137	    @Test
   138	    public void testAttnMaskReformat4DAccumulation() {
   139	        int numQHeads = 24;
   140	        int maxKvLen = 929;
   141	        int currentSeqLen = 1;
   142	        long totalSeqLen = maxKvLen + currentSeqLen;
   143	        float MASK_FILL = -3.4028235e+38f;
   144	
   145	        // Initial: all masked except positions 0..679 and last position
   146	        int initialCachePos = 679;
   147	        INDArray attnBias = Nd4j.valueArrayOf(
   148	                new long[]{1, numQHeads, currentSeqLen, totalSeqLen}, MASK_FILL, DataType.FLOAT);
   149	        attnBias.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.all(),
   150	                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.all(),
   151	                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.all(),
   152	                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, initialCachePos + 1)).assign(0.0f);
   153	        attnBias.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.all(),
   154	                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.all(),
   155	                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.all(),
   156	                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(totalSeqLen - 1)).assign(0.0f);
   157	
   158	        // Simulate 5 incremental steps
   159	        for (int step = 0; step < 5; step++) {
   160	            int cachePos = initialCachePos + 1 + step;
   161	            for (int h = 0; h < numQHeads; h++) {
   162	                attnBias.putScalar(new long[]{0, h, 0, cachePos}, 0.0f);
   163	            }
   164	
   165	            // Verify this position is now unmasked for all heads
   166	            for (int h = 0; h < numQHeads; h++) {
   167	                float val = attnBias.getFloat(0, h, 0, cachePos);
   168	                assertEquals(0.0f, val, 1e-6f,
   169	                        "Step " + step + " head " + h + " at pos " + cachePos + " should be unmasked");
   170	            }
   171	
   172	            // Verify next position is still masked
   173	            if (cachePos + 1 < totalSeqLen - 1) {
   174	                float nextVal = attnBias.getFloat(0, 0, 0, cachePos + 1);
   175	                assertEquals(MASK_FILL, nextVal, 1e30f,
   176	                        "Position " + (cachePos + 1) + " should still be masked");
   177	            }
   178	        }
   179	
   180	        attnBias.close();
   181	    }
   182	}

    87	        LLMModel llmModel = LLMModel.fromSizeLabel(sizeLabel);

    90	        // --- 1. Download model ---

    96	
    97	        assertTrue(downloadResult.getModelFile().exists(), "Model file must exist");
    98	
    99	        // --- 1b. Inspect GGUF metadata ---
   100	        org.nd4j.ggml.format.GGMLMetadata meta = GGMLModelImport.inspectModel(downloadResult.getModelFile());
   101	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] architecture=" + meta.getArchitecture());
   102	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] numLayers=" + meta.getNumLayers());
   103	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] hiddenSize=" + meta.getHiddenSize());
   104	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] numAttentionHeads=" + meta.getNumAttentionHeads());
   105	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] numKVHeads=" + meta.getNumKVHeads());
   106	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] attentionKeyLength=" + meta.getAttentionKeyLength());
   107	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] fullAttentionInterval=" + meta.getFullAttentionInterval());
   108	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] layerTypes=" + meta.getLayerTypes());
   109	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] ropeFreqBase=" + meta.getRopeFreqBase());
   110	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] ropeDimensionCount=" + meta.getRopeDimensionCount());
   111	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] vocabSize=" + meta.getVocabSize());
   112	        System.out.println("[META-DIAG] contextLength=" + meta.getContextLength());
   113	        // Show some raw metadata keys to check for architecture prefix issues
   114	        java.util.Map<String, Object> rawMeta = meta.getRawMetadata();
   115	        for (String key : rawMeta.keySet()) {
   116	            if (key.contains("full_attention") || key.contains("layer_type") || key.contains("architecture")
   117	                || key.contains("block_count") || key.contains("ssm") || key.contains("key_length")) {
   118	                System.out.println("[RAW-META] " + key + "=" + rawMeta.get(key));
   119	            }
   120	        }
   121	        // Show tensor names for layer 0 and layer 3 (full attention)
   122	        for (org.nd4j.ggml.format.GGMLTensorInfo ti : meta.getTensors()) {
   123	            String tn = ti.getName();
   124	            if (tn.startsWith("blk.0.") || tn.startsWith("blk.3.") || tn.equals("token_embd.weight") || tn.equals("output.weight")) {
   125	                System.out.println("[TENSOR] " + tn + " type=" + ti.getDataType() + " shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(ti.getShape()));
   126	            }
   127	        }
   128	
   129	        // --- 2. Import GGUF -> SameDiff ---
   130	        log.info("Importing GGUF model...");
   131	        t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();
   132	        SameDiff model = GGMLModelImport.importModel(downloadResult.getModelFile().getAbsolutePath(),
   133	                org.nd4j.ggml.convert.ConversionOptions.builder()
   134	                        .quantizationMode(org.nd4j.ggml.convert.ConversionOptions.QuantizationMode.DEQUANTIZE_TO_FLOAT32)
   135	                        .targetDataType(DataType.FLOAT)
   136	                        .build());
   137	        long importMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0;
   138	        int opCount = model.ops() != null ? model.ops().length : 0;
   139	        log.info("Import: {}ms, {} ops", importMs, opCount);
   140	
   141	        assertTrue(opCount > 0, "Model should have ops after import");
   142	
   143	        // --- 2b. Diagnostic: check weight values ---
   144	        for (SDVariable sdVar : model.variables()) {
   145	            String varName = sdVar.name();
   146	            if (varName.contains("embed") || varName.contains("layers.0.")) {
   147	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray arr = model.getVariable(varName).getArr();
   148	                if (arr != null) {
   149	                    // Use System.out so surefire captures it
   150	                    System.out.println("[WEIGHT-DIAG] " + varName
   151	                        + " dtype=" + arr.dataType()
   152	                        + " shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(arr.shape())
   153	                        + " isView=" + arr.isView()
   154	                        + " length=" + arr.length()
   155	                        + " amean=" + arr.castTo(DataType.FLOAT).ameanNumber().floatValue()
   156	                        + " min=" + arr.castTo(DataType.FLOAT).minNumber().floatValue()
   157	                        + " max=" + arr.castTo(DataType.FLOAT).maxNumber().floatValue()
   158	                    );
   159	                }
   160	            }
   161	        }
   162	
   163	        // --- 3. Load tokenizer ---
   164	        t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();
   165	        String tokenizerUrl = "https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-" + sizeLabel + "/resolve/main/tokenizer.json";
   166	        File tokenizerFile = LLMModelDownloader.downloadCustom(tokenizerUrl, "qwen35-" + sizeLabel + "-tokenizer.json");
   167	        Tokenizer tokenizer = HuggingFaceTokenizer.fromFile(tokenizerFile.getAbsolutePath());
   168	        long tokMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0;
   169	        log.info("Tokenizer: {}ms, vocab={}", tokMs, tokenizer.getVocabSize());
   170	
   171	        assertTrue(tokenizer.getVocabSize() > 0, "Tokenizer must have vocabulary");
   172	
   173	        // --- 4. Configure model ---
   174	        model.setGraphExecutionMode(GraphExecutionMode.SLOT_BY_SLOT);
   175	        model.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(false);
   176	        model.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(false);
   177	
   178	        // Debug+verbose disabled for clean generation test
   179	        // Nd4j.getEnvironment().setDebug(true);
   180	        // Nd4j.getEnvironment().setVerbose(true);
   181	
   182	        // --- 4b. Diagnostic: trace intermediate values through first forward pass ---
   183	        boolean runDiagnostics = Boolean.parseBoolean(System.getProperty("text.diagnostics", "false"));
   184	        if (runDiagnostics) {
   185	            // Simple 3-token input: just BOS + "Hello"
   186	            org.eclipse.deeplearning4j.llm.tokenizer.Encoding enc = tokenizer.encode("Hello", true);
   187	            int[] ids = enc.getIds();
   188	            System.out.println("[TRACE] Input token IDs: " + java.util.Arrays.toString(ids));
   189	            org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray testInput = Nd4j.createFromArray(ids).castTo(DataType.INT64).reshape(1, ids.length);
   190	            System.out.println("[TRACE] input_ids shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(testInput.shape()) + " dtype=" + testInput.dataType());
   191	
   192	            // Find interesting intermediate variable names
   193	            for (SDVariable v : model.variables()) {
   194	                String n = v.name();
   195	                if (n.equals("embedded") || n.equals("logits")
   196	                    || n.startsWith("post_attn_0") || n.startsWith("layer_out_0")
   197	                    || n.startsWith("gdn_conv_0") || n.startsWith("gdn_qkv_0")
   198	                    || n.startsWith("post_attn_3") || n.startsWith("layer_out_3")
   199	                    || n.startsWith("attn_out_0") || n.startsWith("attn_out_3")
   200	                    || n.startsWith("q_rope_") || n.startsWith("gdn_flat_0")
   201	                    || n.equals("model.norm")) {
   202	                    System.out.println("[TRACE] Found var: " + n);
   203	                }
   204	            }
   205	
   206	            // Run model and get logits + key intermediate outputs
   207	            java.util.List<String> evalVars = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
   208	            evalVars.add("logits");
   209	            // Trace ALL layer outputs to find where corruption starts
   210	            java.util.List<String> traceNameList = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
   211	            traceNameList.add("embedded");
   212	            // GDN layer 0 internals
   213	            traceNameList.addAll(java.util.Arrays.asList(
   214	                "gdn_qkv_0", "gdn_conv_0",
   215	                "gdn_q_0", "gdn_k_0", "gdn_v_0",
   216	                "gdn_q_l2norm_0", "gdn_k_l2norm_0",
   217	                "gdn_beta_0", "gdn_gate_decay_0",
   218	                "gdn_out_0", "gdn_gated_0",
   219	                "gdn_flat_0", "gdn_proj_0"
   220	            ));
   221	            // ALL layer outputs (post_attn and layer_out for each layer)
   222	            for (int li = 0; li < 24; li++) {
   223	                traceNameList.add("post_attn_" + li);
   224	                traceNameList.add("layer_out_" + li);
   225	                // FFN outputs
   226	                traceNameList.add("gate_" + li);
   227	                traceNameList.add("down_" + li);
   228	                // GDN-specific for all GDN layers
   229	                traceNameList.add("gdn_out_" + li);
   230	                traceNameList.add("gdn_proj_" + li);
   231	                // Full attention outputs for attn layers
   232	                traceNameList.add("attn_out_" + li);
   233	                traceNameList.add("attn_proj_" + li);
   234	            }
   235	            String[] traceNames = traceNameList.toArray(new String[0]);
   236	            for (SDVariable v : model.variables()) {
   237	                String n = v.name();
   238	                for (String tn : traceNames) {
   239	                    if (n.equals(tn)) {
   240	                        evalVars.add(n);
   241	                        break;
   242	                    }
   243	                }
   244	            }
   245	
   246	            java.util.Map<String, org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray> placeholders = new java.util.HashMap<>();
   247	            placeholders.put("input_ids", testInput);
   248	            java.util.Map<String, org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray> outputs =
   249	                model.output(placeholders, evalVars.toArray(new String[0]));
   250	
   251	            for (java.util.Map.Entry<String, org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray> entry : outputs.entrySet()) {
   252	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray arr = entry.getValue();
   253	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray f32 = arr.castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   254	                System.out.println("[TRACE-OUT] " + entry.getKey()
   255	                    + " shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(arr.shape())
   256	                    + " dtype=" + arr.dataType()
   257	                    + " amean=" + f32.ameanNumber().floatValue()
   258	                    + " min=" + f32.minNumber().floatValue()
   259	                    + " max=" + f32.maxNumber().floatValue()
   260	                    + " std=" + f32.stdNumber().floatValue());
   261	            }
   262	
   263	            // Check logits distribution — top 10 tokens
   264	            org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray logitsArr = outputs.get("logits");
   265	            if (logitsArr != null && logitsArr.rank() == 3) {
   266	                // Get last position logits
   267	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray lastLogits = logitsArr.get(
   268	                    org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   269	                    org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(logitsArr.size(1) - 1),
   270	                    org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.all()).dup().castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   271	                // Top 10 tokens
   272	                for (int rank = 0; rank < 10; rank++) {
   273	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray topIdx = Nd4j.argMax(lastLogits.reshape(1, -1), 1);
   274	                    int topToken = topIdx.getInt(0);
   275	                    float topLogit = lastLogits.getFloat(topToken);
   276	                    String decoded = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{topToken}, true);
   277	                    System.out.println("[TOP-" + rank + "] token=" + topToken + " logit=" + topLogit
   278	                        + " decoded='" + decoded + "'");
   279	                    // Zero out this position for next iteration
   280	                    lastLogits.putScalar(topToken, Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
   281	                }
   282	            }
   283	
   284	            // --- MANUAL VERIFICATION: Verify QKV projection of layer 0 ---
   285	            System.out.println("\n=== MANUAL VERIFICATION: Layer 0 QKV projection ===");
   286	            {
   287	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray embOut = outputs.get("embedded").dup().castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   288	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray attnNormW = model.getVariable("model.layers.0.input_layernorm.weight").getArr().dup().castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   289	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray qkvW = model.getVariable("model.layers.0.gdn.qkv.weight").getArr().dup().castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   290	
   291	                System.out.println("[MANUAL] embedded shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(embOut.shape()) + " first 5: " + embOut.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(0), org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(0), org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 5)));
   292	                System.out.println("[MANUAL] attnNormW shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(attnNormW.shape()) + " first 5: " + attnNormW.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 5)));
   293	                System.out.println("[MANUAL] qkvW shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(qkvW.shape()) + " amean=" + qkvW.ameanNumber().floatValue());
   294	
   295	                // Manual RMSNorm: x / sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) * gamma
   296	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray x = embOut.reshape(1024);
   297	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray sq = x.mul(x);
   298	                float meanSqr = sq.meanNumber().floatValue();
   299	                float rmsVal = (float) Math.sqrt(meanSqr + 1e-6);
   300	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray normed = x.div(rmsVal).mul(attnNormW);
   301	                System.out.println("[MANUAL] RMS normed first 5: " + normed.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 5))
   302	                    + " amean=" + normed.ameanNumber().floatValue());
   303	
   304	                // Manual QKV projection: normed @ W_qkv^T
   305	                // qkvW shape [6144, 1024], so W^T shape [1024, 6144]
   306	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray manualQkv = normed.reshape(1, 1024).mmul(qkvW.transpose());
   307	                manualQkv = manualQkv.reshape(6144);
   308	                System.out.println("[MANUAL] qkv first 5: " + manualQkv.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 5))
   309	                    + " amean=" + manualQkv.ameanNumber().floatValue()
   310	                    + " min=" + manualQkv.minNumber().floatValue()
   311	                    + " max=" + manualQkv.maxNumber().floatValue());
   312	
   313	                // Compare with model's gdn_qkv_0
   314	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray modelQkv = outputs.get("gdn_qkv_0");
   315	                if (modelQkv != null) {
   316	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray modelFlat = modelQkv.dup().castTo(DataType.FLOAT).reshape(6144);
   317	                    System.out.println("[MANUAL] model gdn_qkv_0 first 5: " + modelFlat.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 5)));
   318	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray diff = manualQkv.sub(modelFlat);
   319	                    System.out.println("[MANUAL] diff amean=" + diff.ameanNumber().floatValue()
   320	                        + " max_abs=" + diff.castTo(DataType.FLOAT).ameanNumber().floatValue());
   321	                    // Check if they're close
   322	                    float maxDiff = Nd4j.math().abs(diff).maxNumber().floatValue();
   323	                    System.out.println("[MANUAL] max_abs_diff=" + maxDiff + " (should be < 0.01 for correct computation)");
   324	                }
   325	
   326	                // Manual CausalConv1d for L=1: output = SiLU(weight[:, K-1] * input[:])
   327	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray convW = model.getVariable("model.layers.0.gdn.conv.weight").getArr().dup().castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   328	                System.out.println("[MANUAL] conv weight shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(convW.shape())
   329	                    + " col 0 amean=" + convW.getColumn(0).ameanNumber().floatValue()
   330	                    + " col 3 amean=" + convW.getColumn(3).ameanNumber().floatValue());
   331	
   332	                // For L=1, only last kernel position (col 3 for kernel_size=4) contributes
   333	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray lastKernelCol = convW.getColumn(3).dup().reshape(6144);
   334	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray convInput = manualQkv.dup(); // use manual QKV output
   335	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray preActivation = lastKernelCol.mul(convInput);

   337	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray sigmoidVal = Nd4j.nn().sigmoid(preActivation);
   338	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray manualConv = preActivation.mul(sigmoidVal);
   339	                System.out.println("[MANUAL] conv output (col 3) first 5: " + manualConv.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 5))
   340	                    + " amean=" + manualConv.ameanNumber().floatValue());
   341	
   342	                // Compare with model's gdn_conv_0
   343	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray modelConv = outputs.get("gdn_conv_0");
   344	                if (modelConv != null) {
   345	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray modelConvFlat = modelConv.dup().castTo(DataType.FLOAT).reshape(6144);
   346	                    System.out.println("[MANUAL] model gdn_conv_0 first 5: " + modelConvFlat.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 5)));
   347	                    float convMaxDiff = Nd4j.math().abs(manualConv.sub(modelConvFlat)).maxNumber().floatValue();
   348	                    System.out.println("[MANUAL] conv max_abs_diff (col 3)=" + convMaxDiff);
   349	
   350	                    // Also try with col 0 to see if kernel orientation is reversed
   351	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray firstKernelCol = convW.getColumn(0).dup().reshape(6144);
   352	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray preAct0 = firstKernelCol.mul(convInput);
   353	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray sig0 = Nd4j.nn().sigmoid(preAct0);
   354	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray manualConv0 = preAct0.mul(sig0);
   355	                    float convMaxDiff0 = Nd4j.math().abs(manualConv0.sub(modelConvFlat)).maxNumber().floatValue();
   356	                    System.out.println("[MANUAL] conv max_abs_diff (col 0)=" + convMaxDiff0);
   357	                }
   358	            }
   359	
   360	            // --- BYPASS TEST: embedding -> final_norm -> lm_head (no transformer layers) ---
   361	            System.out.println("\n=== BYPASS TEST: embedding -> norm -> lm_head (no layers) ===");
   362	            {
   363	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray embedWeight = model.getVariable("model.embed_tokens.weight").getArr();
   364	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray lmHeadWeight = model.getVariable("lm_head.weight").getArr();
   365	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray normWeight = null;
   366	                // Find the final norm weight

   368	                    if (sv.name().equals("model.norm.weight")) {
   369	                        normWeight = model.getVariable(sv.name()).getArr();
   370	                        break;
   371	                    }
   372	                }
   373	
   374	                System.out.println("[BYPASS] embed shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(embedWeight.shape()));
   375	                System.out.println("[BYPASS] lm_head shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(lmHeadWeight.shape()));
   376	                System.out.println("[BYPASS] normWeight=" + (normWeight != null ? java.util.Arrays.toString(normWeight.shape()) : "NULL"));
   377	                System.out.println("[BYPASS] embed == lm_head? " + (embedWeight == lmHeadWeight));
   378	
   379	                // Get embedding for token 9419 ("Hello")
   380	                int tokenId = ids[ids.length - 1]; // Last token (Hello without BOS)
   381	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray emb = embedWeight.getRow(tokenId).dup().castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   382	                System.out.println("[BYPASS] token " + tokenId + " emb first 10: " + emb.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 10)));
   383	
   384	                // Apply RMSNorm manually: x / sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) * gamma
   385	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray embF = emb.castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   386	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray squared = embF.mul(embF);
   387	                float meanSq = squared.meanNumber().floatValue();
   388	                float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(meanSq + 1e-6);
   389	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray normalized = embF.div(rms);
   390	                if (normWeight != null) {

   393	                System.out.println("[BYPASS] after norm first 10: " + normalized.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, 10)));
   394	
   395	                // Compute logits: normalized @ lm_head.T
   396	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray lmF = lmHeadWeight.castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   397	                // lm_head shape is [vocab, hidden] after reverseShape

   399	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray bypassLogits = normalized.reshape(1, -1).mmul(lmF.transpose());
   400	                bypassLogits = bypassLogits.reshape(-1);
   401	                System.out.println("[BYPASS] logits shape=" + java.util.Arrays.toString(bypassLogits.shape())

   403	                    + " min=" + bypassLogits.minNumber().floatValue()
   404	                    + " max=" + bypassLogits.maxNumber().floatValue());
   405	
   406	                // Top 10 bypass tokens

   408	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.ndarray.INDArray topIdx = Nd4j.argMax(bypassLogits.reshape(1, -1), 1);
   409	                    int topToken = topIdx.getInt(0);
   410	                    float topLogit = bypassLogits.getFloat(topToken);
   411	                    String decoded = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{topToken}, true);
   412	                    System.out.println("[BYPASS-TOP-" + rank + "] token=" + topToken + " logit=" + topLogit
   413	                        + " decoded='" + decoded + "'");
   414	                    bypassLogits.putScalar(topToken, Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
   415	                }
   416	            }

   418	            testInput.close();

   420	
   421	        // --- 5. Generate with TextGenerator ---
   422	        // Use Qwen3.5 chat template: <|im_start|>system\n...<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>user\n...<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n
   423	        // This primes the base model to generate assistant-style responses.
   424	        boolean useChatTemplate = Boolean.parseBoolean(System.getProperty("text.chat.template", "true"));
   425	        String formattedPrompt;

    50	/**
    51	 * Tests CUDA graph capture and replay across 50+ steps to detect stale replay.
    52	 *
    53	 * Builds a graph with matmul + activation (mimicking a decoder layer), compiles DSP,
    54	 * freezes shapes, and runs 50 steps with outputDirect(). Each step changes one input
    55	 * (simulating different token embeddings).
    56	 *
    57	 * Key checks:
    58	 * - Verify outputs change when inputs change (not stale replay)
    59	 * - After step 20, check if outputs start repeating
    60	 * - Compare outputDirect() results with output() results at checkpoints
    61	 */
    62	@Slf4j
    63	@Tag(TagNames.SAMEDIFF)
    64	@NativeTag
    65	public class CudaGraphReplayMultiStepTest extends BaseNd4jTestWithBackends {
    66	
    67	    private static final int HIDDEN_SIZE = 64;
    68	    private static final int NUM_LAYERS = 3;
    69	    private static final int TOTAL_STEPS = 50;
    70	
    71	    @Override
    72	    public char ordering() {
    73	        return 'c';
    74	    }

    82	    /**
    83	     * Build a multi-layer MLP: input -> (matmul + bias + tanh) * N -> output
    84	     * Fixed input shape [1, HIDDEN_SIZE] for frozen shape execution.
    85	     */
    86	    private SameDiff buildDecoderLikeGraph() {
    87	        SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
    88	        SDVariable input = sd.placeHolder("input", DataType.FLOAT, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE);
    89	        SDVariable current = input;
    90	
    91	        for (int i = 0; i < NUM_LAYERS; i++) {
    92	            SDVariable w = sd.var("w_" + i, Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, HIDDEN_SIZE, HIDDEN_SIZE).muli(0.02));
    93	            SDVariable b = sd.var("b_" + i, Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, HIDDEN_SIZE));
    94	            current = sd.mmul("matmul_" + i, current, w);
    95	            current = current.add("add_" + i, b);
    96	            if (i < NUM_LAYERS - 1) {
    97	                current = sd.math.tanh("tanh_" + i, current);
    98	            }
    99	        }
   100	        current = sd.identity("output", current);
   101	        sd.setOutputs("output");
   102	        return sd;
   103	    }

   105	    @ParameterizedTest
   106	    @MethodSource("org.nd4j.linalg.BaseNd4jTestWithBackends#configs")
   107	    public void testCudaGraphReplayOutputsChangeWithInputs(Nd4jBackend backend) {
   108	        SameDiff sd = buildDecoderLikeGraph();
   109	        sd.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   110	        sd.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   111	        sd.setGraphExecutionMode(GraphExecutionMode.AUTO);
   112	
   113	        // Fixed-address input buffer (simulates reusable decode buffer)
   114	        INDArray reusableInput = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE);
   115	
   116	        // Step 0: warm up with output()
   117	        Map<String, INDArray> warmupResult = sd.output(
   118	                Collections.singletonMap("input", reusableInput), "output");
   119	        assertNotNull(warmupResult.get("output"));
   120	
   121	        // Step 1: second output() call (DSP auto-compile should trigger)
   122	        reusableInput.assign(Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE));
   123	        sd.output(Collections.singletonMap("input", reusableInput), "output");
   124	
   125	        // Freeze shapes for CUDA graph replay
   126	        InferenceSession session = sd.getOrCreateSession();
   127	        DynamicShapePlanExecutor dspExec = session.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor();
   128	        if (dspExec != null) {
   129	            dspExec.setShapesFrozen(true);
   130	            log.info("Shapes frozen for CUDA graph replay");
   131	        }
   132	
   133	        // Run TOTAL_STEPS with outputDirect, tracking outputs
   134	        float[][] directOutputs = new float[TOTAL_STEPS][];
   135	        Set<Integer> uniqueArgmax = new HashSet<>();
   136	        int firstStaleStep = -1;
   137	
   138	        // Also compute reference outputs at checkpoint steps using a separate SameDiff instance
   139	        SameDiff refSd = buildDecoderLikeGraph();
   140	        // Copy weights from original
   141	        for (String varName : sd.variableMap().keySet()) {
   142	            if (sd.getVariable(varName).getVariableType() == org.nd4j.autodiff.samediff.VariableType.VARIABLE) {
   143	                INDArray arr = sd.getVariable(varName).getArr();
   144	                if (arr != null && refSd.hasVariable(varName)) {
   145	                    refSd.getVariable(varName).getArr().assign(arr);
   146	                }
   147	            }
   148	        }
   149	
   150	        int[] checkpointSteps = {9, 19, 29, 39, 49};
   151	        Map<Integer, float[]> referenceOutputs = new HashMap<>();
   152	
   153	        for (int step = 0; step < TOTAL_STEPS; step++) {
   154	            // Generate deterministic but varying input
   155	            Nd4j.getRandom().setSeed(step * 1000L + 42);
   156	            INDArray stepInput = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE).muli(0.1f);
   157	            reusableInput.assign(stepInput);
   158	            Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   159	
   160	            // outputDirect (frozen path / CUDA graph replay)
   161	            Map<String, INDArray> result = sd.outputDirect(
   162	                    Collections.singletonMap("input", reusableInput), "output");
   163	            Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   164	            INDArray output = result.get("output");
   165	            assertNotNull(output, "Output null at step " + step);
   166	
   167	            float[] data = output.dup().data().asFloat();
   168	            directOutputs[step] = data;
   169	
   170	            // Track argmax
   171	            int argmax = 0;
   172	            for (int i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
   173	                if (data[i] > data[argmax]) argmax = i;
   174	            }
   175	            uniqueArgmax.add(argmax);
   176	
   177	            // Check for stale output (identical to previous)
   178	            if (step > 0 && firstStaleStep < 0) {
   179	                boolean identical = Arrays.equals(directOutputs[step], directOutputs[step - 1]);
   180	                if (identical) {
   181	                    firstStaleStep = step;
   182	                    log.warn("STALE REPLAY DETECTED at step {}: output identical to step {}", step, step - 1);
   183	                }
   184	            }
   185	
   186	            // At checkpoint steps, also compute reference via output()
   187	            boolean isCheckpoint = false;
   188	            for (int cp : checkpointSteps) {
   189	                if (step == cp) { isCheckpoint = true; break; }
   190	            }
   191	            if (isCheckpoint) {
   192	                Nd4j.getRandom().setSeed(step * 1000L + 42);
   193	                INDArray refInput = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE).muli(0.1f);
   194	                Map<String, INDArray> refResult = refSd.output(
   195	                        Collections.singletonMap("input", refInput), "output");
   196	                Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   197	                referenceOutputs.put(step, refResult.get("output").dup().data().asFloat());
   198	            }
   199	
   200	            if (step < 5 || step % 10 == 0) {
   201	                log.info("Step {}: argmax={} first5=[{},{},{},{},{}]",
   202	                        step, argmax,
   203	                        String.format("%.4f", data[0]),
   204	                        String.format("%.4f", data[1]),
   205	                        String.format("%.4f", data[2]),
   206	                        String.format("%.4f", data[3]),
   207	                        String.format("%.4f", data[4]));
   208	            }
   209	        }
   210	
   211	        // Compare direct vs reference at checkpoints
   212	        int divergenceCount = 0;
   213	        for (int cp : checkpointSteps) {
   214	            float[] direct = directOutputs[cp];
   215	            float[] ref = referenceOutputs.get(cp);
   216	            if (ref == null) continue;
   217	
   218	            double maxDiff = 0;
   219	            for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(direct.length, ref.length); i++) {
   220	                maxDiff = Math.max(maxDiff, Math.abs(direct[i] - ref[i]));
   221	            }
   222	
   223	            log.info("Checkpoint step {}: maxDiff={}", cp, String.format("%.6f", maxDiff));
   224	            if (maxDiff > 0.01) {
   225	                divergenceCount++;
   226	                log.warn("DIVERGENCE at step {}: maxDiff={} exceeds tolerance",
   227	                        cp, String.format("%.6f", maxDiff));
   228	            }
   229	        }
   230	
   231	        // Summary
   232	        double diversity = (double) uniqueArgmax.size() / TOTAL_STEPS;
   233	        log.info("=== CUDA GRAPH REPLAY MULTI-STEP RESULTS ===");
   234	        log.info("  Total steps: {}", TOTAL_STEPS);
   235	        log.info("  Unique argmax values: {} / {} ({}%)", uniqueArgmax.size(), TOTAL_STEPS, String.format("%.1f", diversity * 100));
   236	        log.info("  First stale step: {}", firstStaleStep);
   237	        log.info("  Divergence count at checkpoints: {} / {}", divergenceCount, checkpointSteps.length);
   238	
   239	        // Assertions
   240	        if (firstStaleStep >= 0) {
   241	            assertTrue(firstStaleStep > 20,
   242	                    "Stale replay should not occur before step 20 -- started at step " + firstStaleStep);
   243	        }
   244	        assertTrue(uniqueArgmax.size() > 5,
   245	                "Must have >5 unique argmax values across 50 steps, got " + uniqueArgmax.size());
   246	
   247	        sd.close();
   248	        refSd.close();
   249	    }
   250	}

    49	import java.util.List;
    50	import java.util.Map;
    51	
    52	import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
    53	
    54	/**
    55	 * Tests that validate CUDA graph capture is consistent with the SameDiff graph.
    56	 *
    57	 * When CUDA graphs are enabled, ops in the execution plan are captured into a
    58	 * cudaGraph_t during the second execution. On subsequent executions, the captured
    59	 * graph is replayed instead of re-executing ops individually.
    60	 *
    61	 * The critical invariant is: EVERY op in the SameDiff graph must contribute at
    62	 * least one CUDA graph node. Ops that do host-only work (e.g., shape_of which
    63	 * writes to host via memcpy then syncs to device) may produce zero CUDA graph
    64	 * nodes. Their host work runs during capture but is NOT replayed, causing stale
    65	 * outputs on the 2nd+ execution.
    66	 *
    67	 * IMPORTANT: CUDA graph capture requires segments with at least 10 ops (the
    68	 * minimum threshold). Tests build sufficiently large graphs to trigger capture.
    69	 * Smaller graphs fall back to slot-by-slot execution (no capture/replay).
    70	 */
    71	@Slf4j
    72	@Tag(TagNames.SAMEDIFF)
    73	@NativeTag
    74	public class CudaGraphConsistencyTest extends BaseNd4jTestWithBackends {
    75	
    76	    private static final double TOLERANCE = 1e-4;
    77	    // Minimum ops needed to trigger CUDA graph capture
    78	    private static final int MIN_CAPTURE_OPS = 10;
    79	
    80	    // ─── Helper methods ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    81	
    82	    private Pointer compileNativePlan(DynamicShapePlan plan) {
    83	        NativeOps nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
    84	        byte[] serialized = plan.serialize();
    85	        assertNotNull(serialized, "Plan serialization returned null");
    86	        assertTrue(serialized.length > 0, "Plan serialization returned empty");
    87	
    88	        BytePointer planBytes = new BytePointer(serialized);
    89	        try {
    90	            return nativeOps.compileDynamicShapePlan(planBytes, serialized.length);
    91	        } catch (UnsupportedOperationException e) {
    92	            log.info("Backend does not support native executor: {}", e.getMessage());
    93	            return null;
    94	        } finally {
    95	            planBytes.close();
    96	        }
    97	    }
    98	
    99	    private Map<String, INDArray> executeNativePlan(Pointer planHandle, DynamicShapePlan plan,
   100	                                                     INDArray[] extInputs) {
   101	        NativeOps nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
   102	        int numOutputs = plan.getRequestedOutputs().size();
   103	
   104	        OpaqueContext opContext = nativeOps.createGraphContext(1);
   105	        try {
   106	            for (int i = 0; i < extInputs.length; i++) {
   107	                OpaqueNDArray opaqueIn = OpaqueNDArray.fromINDArray(extInputs[i]);
   108	                nativeOps.setGraphContextInputArray(opContext, i, opaqueIn);
   109	            }
   110	
   111	            for (int i = 0; i < numOutputs; i++) {
   112	                INDArray dummy = Nd4j.empty(DataType.FLOAT);
   113	                OpaqueNDArray opaqueOut = OpaqueNDArray.fromINDArray(dummy);
   114	                nativeOps.setGraphContextOutputArray(opContext, i, opaqueOut);
   115	            }
   116	
   117	            Pointer execStream = null;
   118	            try {
   119	                OpaqueLaunchContext lc = nativeOps.defaultLaunchContext();
   120	                if (lc != null) {
   121	                    execStream = nativeOps.lcExecutionStream(lc);
   122	                    if (execStream != null) execStream.retainReference();
   123	                }
   124	            } catch (Exception e) {
   125	                // CPU backend — stream stays null
   126	            }
   127	
   128	            int status = nativeOps.executeDynamicShapePlan(planHandle, opContext, execStream);
   129	
   130	            if (status != 0) {
   131	                String errMsg = nativeOps.lastErrorMessage();
   132	                nativeOps.clearLastError();
   133	                fail("Native plan execution failed with status " + status + ": " + errMsg);
   134	            }
   135	
   136	            Map<String, INDArray> results = new LinkedHashMap<>();
   137	            List<String> requestedOutputs = new java.util.ArrayList<>(plan.getRequestedOutputs());
   138	
   139	            for (int i = 0; i < numOutputs; i++) {
   140	                OpaqueNDArray opaqueOut = nativeOps.getOutputArrayNative(opContext, i);
   141	                assertNotNull(opaqueOut, "Null output at index " + i);
   142	                assertFalse(opaqueOut.isNull(), "Null OpaqueNDArray at index " + i);
   143	
   144	                long[] shapeInfo = OpaqueNDArray.getOpaqueNDArrayShapeInfo(opaqueOut);
   145	                long[] shape = Shape.shape(shapeInfo);
   146	                DataType dtype = ArrayOptionsHelper.dataType(shapeInfo);
   147	                long length = OpaqueNDArray.getOpaqueNDArrayLength(opaqueOut);
   148	
   149	                INDArray result = Nd4j.createUninitialized(dtype, shape);
   150	
   151	                Pointer nativePrimary = nativeOps.getOpaqueNDArrayBuffer(opaqueOut);
   152	                Pointer nativeSpecial = nativeOps.getOpaqueNDArraySpecialBuffer(opaqueOut);
   153	
   154	                OpaqueDataBuffer srcOdb = nativeOps.dbCreateExternalDataBuffer(
   155	                        length, dtype.toInt(), nativePrimary, nativeSpecial);
   156	                if (srcOdb != null) {
   157	                    OpaqueDataBuffer dstOdb = result.data().opaqueBuffer();
   158	                    if (dstOdb != null) {
   159	                        nativeOps.copyBuffer(dstOdb, length, srcOdb, 0, 0);
   160	                    }
   161	                }
   162	
   163	                results.put(requestedOutputs.get(i), result);
   164	            }
   165	
   166	            return results;
   167	        } finally {
   168	            nativeOps.deleteGraphContext(opContext);
   169	        }
   170	    }
   171	
   172	    private INDArray[] resolveExternalInputs(DynamicShapePlan plan, SameDiff sd,
   173	                                              Map<String, INDArray> placeholders) {
   174	        String[] extKeys = plan.getExternalInputKeys();
   175	        INDArray[] extInputs = new INDArray[extKeys.length];
   176	        for (int i = 0; i < extKeys.length; i++) {
   177	            String varName = extKeys[i];
   178	            INDArray arr = placeholders != null ? placeholders.get(varName) : null;
   179	            if (arr == null) {
   180	                SDVariable var = sd.getVariable(varName);
   181	                if (var != null) {
   182	                    arr = var.getArr();
   183	                }
   184	            }
   185	            assertNotNull(arr, "Missing external input: " + varName);
   186	            extInputs[i] = arr;
   187	        }
   188	        return extInputs;
   189	    }
   190	
   191	    /**
   192	     * Run a CUDA graph consistency test for a given SameDiff graph.
   193	     * Verifies:
   194	     * 1. Plan slot count matches SameDiff op count for requested outputs
   195	     * 2. CUDA graph validates (no host-only ops) after capture
   196	     * 3. Output correctness on warmup, capture, and replay executions
   197	     * 4. Replay count increases (proves graph is being reused)
   198	     */
   199	    private void assertCudaGraphConsistency(SameDiff sd, Map<String, INDArray> placeholders,
   200	                                             String... outputs) {
   201	        NativeOps nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
   202	
   203	        // NOTE: Do NOT enable debug/verbose mode here! Debug mode causes
   204	        // DebugHelper::checkErrorCode to call cudaStreamSynchronize after every op,
   205	        // which is ILLEGAL during CUDA graph capture (error 900).
   206	        // The C++ capture audit is always-on and doesn't need debug mode.
   207	
   208	        DynamicShapePlan plan = NativeExecutorTestUtils.compilePlan(sd, outputs);
   209	        Pointer handle = compileNativePlan(plan);
   210	        if (handle == null || handle.isNull()) {
   211	            log.info("Skipping CUDA graph consistency test — native executor not supported");
   212	            plan.close();
   213	            return;
   214	        }
   215	
   216	        try {
   217	            // Log plan structure
   218	            int numSlots = nativeOps.getPlanNumSlots(handle);
   219	            int numSegments = nativeOps.getPlanNumSegments(handle);
   220	            log.info("Plan: {} slots, {} segments, outputs={}", numSlots, numSegments,
   221	                     Arrays.toString(outputs));
   222	
   223	            // Log SameDiff ops for comparison
   224	            DynamicShapeSlot[] slots = plan.getSlots();
   225	            log.info("SameDiff plan has {} slots:", slots.length);
   226	            for (int i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) {
   227	                log.info("  slot[{}]: op={}", i, slots[i].getOpName());
   228	            }
   229	
   230	            // Verify slot count matches
   231	            assertEquals(slots.length, numSlots,
   232	                    "Plan slot count mismatch between Java (" + slots.length +
   233	                    ") and native (" + numSlots + ")");
   234	
   235	            // Enable CUDA Graphs (uses default min segment size of 10)
   236	            nativeOps.setPlanCudaGraphsEnabled(handle, true);
   237	
   238	            // Get Java executor results for correctness baseline
   239	            Map<String, INDArray> javaResults = sd.output(placeholders, outputs);
   240	
   241	            // Execute 4 times: warmup → capture → replay → replay
   242	            for (int iter = 0; iter < 4; iter++) {
   243	                INDArray[] extInputs = resolveExternalInputs(plan, sd, placeholders);
   244	                Map<String, INDArray> nativeResult = executeNativePlan(handle, plan, extInputs);
   245	
   246	                // Verify correctness on EVERY execution
   247	                for (String output : outputs) {
   248	                    INDArray expected = javaResults.get(output);
   249	                    INDArray actual = nativeResult.get(output);
   250	                    assertNotNull(actual, "Missing output '" + output + "' on iter " + iter);
   251	
   252	                    assertArrayEquals(expected.shape(), actual.shape(),
   253	                            "Shape mismatch for '" + output + "' on iter " + iter +
   254	                            ": expected " + Arrays.toString(expected.shape()) +
   255	                            " got " + Arrays.toString(actual.shape()));
   256	
   257	                    if (expected.dataType().isFPType()) {
   258	                        double maxDiff = expected.sub(actual).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   259	                        assertTrue(maxDiff <= TOLERANCE,
   260	                                "Value mismatch for '" + output + "' on iter " + iter +
   261	                                ": maxDiff=" + maxDiff + " (tolerance=" + TOLERANCE + ")");
   262	                    } else {
   263	                        // For integer types, exact match
   264	                        assertEquals(expected, actual,
   265	                                "Value mismatch for '" + output + "' on iter " + iter);
   266	                    }
   267	                }
   268	
   269	                int captured = nativeOps.getPlanNumCapturedGraphSegments(handle);
   270	                int replays = nativeOps.getPlanTotalGraphReplays(handle);
   271	                log.info("  iter {}: captured={}, replays={}", iter, captured, replays);
   272	
   273	                // After iter 1 (capture pass), validate the graph
   274	                if (iter == 1 && captured > 0) {
   275	                    // Print the full CUDA graph debug info
   276	                    nativeOps.printPlanCapturedGraphDebug(handle);
   277	
   278	                    // Validate: every op must have contributed CUDA graph nodes
   279	                    boolean valid = nativeOps.validatePlanCapturedGraph(handle);
   280	                    int hostOnlyCount = nativeOps.getPlanNumHostOnlyOps(handle);
   281	                    String hostOnlyNames = nativeOps.getPlanHostOnlyOpNames(handle);
   282	
   283	                    log.info("CUDA Graph Validation: valid={}, hostOnlyOps={} [{}]",
   284	                             valid, hostOnlyCount, hostOnlyNames);
   285	
   286	                    if (!valid) {
   287	                        fail("CUDA graph capture is INCOMPLETE: " + hostOnlyCount +
   288	                             " ops contributed zero CUDA graph nodes: [" + hostOnlyNames + "]. " +
   289	                             "These ops do host-only work that won't replay on graph re-execution. " +
   290	                             "The CUDA graph is NOT consistent with the SameDiff graph.");
   291	                    }
   292	                }
   293	            }
   294	
   295	            // After 4 executions with a graph large enough for capture:
   296	            // - iter 0: warmup (slot-by-slot)
   297	            // - iter 1: capture (graph recorded + launched)
   298	            // - iter 2: replay
   299	            // - iter 3: replay
   300	            // So we expect at least 2 replays if capture succeeded
   301	            int finalReplays = nativeOps.getPlanTotalGraphReplays(handle);
   302	            log.info("Final: {} graph replays", finalReplays);
   303	            if (numSlots >= MIN_CAPTURE_OPS) {
   304	                assertTrue(finalReplays >= 2,
   305	                        "Expected at least 2 graph replays for a " + numSlots +
   306	                        "-slot plan, got " + finalReplays);
   307	            }
   308	
   309	        } finally {
   310	            nativeOps.freeDynamicShapePlan(handle);
   311	            plan.close();
   312	        }
   313	    }
   314	
   315	    // ─── Graph builders: build large enough graphs (12+ ops) for capture ─────
   316	
   317	    /**
   318	     * Build a chain of 12 element-wise ops: add → sigmoid → mul → tanh → add → ...
   319	     * This produces exactly 12 slots to exceed the 10-slot capture threshold.
   320	     */
   321	    private static SameDiff createLargeChainGraph() {
   322	        SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
   323	        SDVariable x = sd.placeHolder("x", DataType.FLOAT, -1, 4);
   324	        SDVariable scale = sd.constant("scale", Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 4).mul(0.5));
   325	        SDVariable bias = sd.constant("bias", Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 4).mul(0.1));
   326	
   327	        // Chain of 12 ops to exceed the 10-slot capture threshold
   328	        SDVariable t = x.add("op_01_add", bias);
   329	        t = sd.nn().sigmoid("op_02_sigmoid", t);
   330	        t = t.mul("op_03_mul", scale);
   331	        t = sd.nn().tanh("op_04_tanh", t);
   332	        t = t.add("op_05_add2", bias);
   333	        t = sd.nn().sigmoid("op_06_sigmoid2", t);
   334	        t = t.mul("op_07_mul2", scale);
   335	        t = sd.nn().tanh("op_08_tanh2", t);
   336	        t = t.add("op_09_add3", bias);
   337	        t = sd.nn().sigmoid("op_10_sigmoid3", t);
   338	        t = t.mul("op_11_mul3", scale);
   339	        SDVariable output = sd.nn().tanh("result", t);
   340	
   341	        return sd;
   342	    }
   343	
   344	    /**
   345	     * Build a diamond graph with 12+ ops: two parallel paths of 6 ops each, merged.
   346	     */
   347	    private static SameDiff createLargeDiamondGraph() {
   348	        SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
   349	        SDVariable x = sd.placeHolder("x", DataType.FLOAT, -1, 4);
   350	        SDVariable scale = sd.constant("scale", Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 4).mul(0.5));
   351	        SDVariable bias = sd.constant("bias", Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 4).mul(0.1));
   352	
   353	        // Path A: 6 ops
   354	        SDVariable a1 = x.add("a_01_add", bias);
   355	        SDVariable a2 = sd.nn().sigmoid("a_02_sigmoid", a1);
   356	        SDVariable a3 = a2.mul("a_03_mul", scale);
   357	        SDVariable a4 = sd.nn().tanh("a_04_tanh", a3);
   358	        SDVariable a5 = a4.add("a_05_add", bias);
   359	        SDVariable a6 = sd.nn().sigmoid("a_06_sigmoid", a5);
   360	
   361	        // Path B: 6 ops
   362	        SDVariable b1 = x.mul("b_01_mul", scale);
   363	        SDVariable b2 = sd.nn().tanh("b_02_tanh", b1);
   364	        SDVariable b3 = b2.add("b_03_add", bias);
   365	        SDVariable b4 = sd.nn().sigmoid("b_04_sigmoid", b3);
   366	        SDVariable b5 = b4.mul("b_05_mul", scale);
   367	        SDVariable b6 = sd.nn().tanh("b_06_tanh", b5);
   368	
   369	        // Merge: 1 op
   370	        SDVariable result = a6.add("result", b6);
   371	
   372	        return sd;
   373	    }
   374	
   375	    /**
   376	     * Build a graph with shape_of + gather + enough compute ops (12+ total)
   377	     * to trigger capture. The shape_of is the problematic host-only op.
   378	     */
   379	    private static SameDiff createShapeOfPlusComputeGraph() {
   380	        SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
   381	        SDVariable input = sd.placeHolder("input", DataType.FLOAT, -1, -1, -1, -1);
   382	
   383	        // shape_of op (host-only — problematic for CUDA graphs)
   384	        SDVariable shape = sd.shape("shape_out", input);
   385	
   386	        // gather op (reads from shape_of output)
   387	        INDArray scalarIdx = Nd4j.scalar(DataType.INT64, 0);
   388	        SDVariable idx = sd.constant("idx", scalarIdx);
   389	        SDVariable gathered = sd.gather("gather_out", shape, idx, 0);
   390	
   391	        // 10+ element-wise ops on the input to exceed capture threshold
   392	        SDVariable scale = sd.constant("scale", Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 1, 1).mul(0.5));
   393	        SDVariable bias = sd.constant("bias", Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 1, 1).mul(0.1));
   394	
   395	        SDVariable t = input.add("op_01_add", bias);
   396	        t = sd.nn().sigmoid("op_02_sigmoid", t);
   397	        t = t.mul("op_03_mul", scale);
   398	        t = sd.nn().tanh("op_04_tanh", t);
   399	        t = t.add("op_05_add2", bias);
   400	        t = sd.nn().sigmoid("op_06_sigmoid2", t);
   401	        t = t.mul("op_07_mul2", scale);
   402	        t = sd.nn().tanh("op_08_tanh2", t);
   403	        t = t.add("op_09_add3", bias);
   404	        SDVariable compute_result = sd.nn().sigmoid("compute_result", t);
   405	
   406	        return sd;
   407	    }
   408	
   409	    /**
   410	     * Build a graph where reshape output shape is driven by a device-produced
   411	     * shape tensor. This exercises the native calculateOutputShapes2() path for
   412	     * reshape without requiring the large data input itself to be synced back.
   413	     */
   414	    private static SameDiff createShapeDrivenReshapeGraph() {
   415	        SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
   416	        SDVariable input = sd.placeHolder("input", DataType.FLOAT, -1, -1);
   417	
   418	        // Force the reshape data input to be produced by device compute.
   419	        SDVariable shifted = input.add("shifted", 1.0);
   420	
   421	        SDVariable shape = sd.shape("shape_out", input);
   422	        SDVariable swapIdx = sd.constant("swap_idx", Nd4j.createFromArray(1L, 0L));
   423	        SDVariable swappedShape = sd.gather("swapped_shape", shape, swapIdx, 0);
   424	        SDVariable reshaped = sd.reshape("reshaped", shifted, swappedShape);
   425	        reshaped.rename("result");
   426	        return sd;
   427	    }
   428	
   429	    /**
   430	     * Build a multi-output graph with 12+ ops where intermediate results
   431	     * are all requested as outputs.
   432	     */
   433	    private static SameDiff createLargeMultiOutputGraph() {
   434	        SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
   435	        SDVariable x = sd.placeHolder("x", DataType.FLOAT, -1, 4);
   436	        SDVariable w1 = sd.constant("w1", Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 4).mul(0.5));
   437	        SDVariable w2 = sd.constant("w2", Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 4).mul(0.3));
   438	        SDVariable b = sd.constant("b", Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 4).mul(0.1));
   439	
   440	        // Layer 1
   441	        SDVariable h1 = x.mul("h1_mul", w1);
   442	        SDVariable h2 = h1.add("h1_bias", b);
   443	        SDVariable h3 = sd.nn().sigmoid("h1_act", h2);
   444	
   445	        // Layer 2
   446	        SDVariable h4 = h3.mul("h2_mul", w2);
   447	        SDVariable h5 = h4.add("h2_bias", b);
   448	        SDVariable h6 = sd.nn().tanh("h2_act", h5);
   449	
   450	        // Layer 3
   451	        SDVariable h7 = h6.mul("h3_mul", w1);
   452	        SDVariable h8 = h7.add("h3_bias", b);
   453	        SDVariable h9 = sd.nn().sigmoid("h3_act", h8);
   454	
   455	        // Layer 4
   456	        SDVariable h10 = h9.mul("h4_mul", w2);
   457	        SDVariable h11 = h10.add("h4_bias", b);
   458	        SDVariable result = sd.nn().tanh("result", h11);
   459	
   460	        return sd;
   461	    }

   463	    // ─── Test: long chain graph (12 ops → triggers capture) ──────────────────
   464	
   465	    @Test
   466	    public void testCudaGraphConsistency_LargeChain() {
   467	        SameDiff sd = createLargeChainGraph();
   468	        INDArray x = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 2, 4);
   469	        Map<String, INDArray> ph = Map.of("x", x);
   470	
   471	        assertCudaGraphConsistency(sd, ph, "result");
   472	    }

   474	    // ─── Test: diamond graph (12+ ops → triggers capture) ────────────────────
   475	
   476	    @Test
   477	    public void testCudaGraphConsistency_LargeDiamond() {
   478	        SameDiff sd = createLargeDiamondGraph();
   479	        INDArray x = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 2, 4);
   480	        Map<String, INDArray> ph = Map.of("x", x);
   481	
   482	        assertCudaGraphConsistency(sd, ph, "result");
   483	    }

   485	    // ─── Test: shape_of + gather + compute (the problematic pattern) ─────────
   486	
   487	    @Test
   488	    public void testCudaGraphConsistency_ShapeOfGather() {
   489	        SameDiff sd = createShapeOfPlusComputeGraph();
   490	        INDArray input4d = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 2, 3, 4, 4);
   491	        Map<String, INDArray> ph = Map.of("input", input4d);
   492	
   493	        // This tests the exact pattern that fails with CUDA graphs:
   494	        // shape_of does host memcpy → syncToDevice, which produces zero CUDA
   495	        // graph nodes. On graph replay, shape_of's host work doesn't re-execute,
   496	        // so gather reads stale device zeros.
   497	        // The graph has enough ops (12+) to trigger capture.
   498	        assertCudaGraphConsistency(sd, ph, "gather_out", "shape_out", "compute_result");
   499	    }

   501	    @Test
   502	    public void testNativePlanShapeDrivenReshapeRemainsCorrect() {
   503	        SameDiff sd = createShapeDrivenReshapeGraph();
   504	        DynamicShapePlan plan = NativeExecutorTestUtils.compilePlan(sd, "result", "swapped_shape");
   505	        Pointer handle = compileNativePlan(plan);
   506	        if (handle == null || handle.isNull()) {
   507	            plan.close();
   508	            return;
   509	        }
   510	
   511	        try {
   512	            DynamicShapeSlot reshapeSlot = Arrays.stream(plan.getSlots())
   513	                    .filter(slot -> "reshape".equals(slot.getOpName()) || "reshape_no_copy".equals(slot.getOpName()))
   514	                    .findFirst()
   515	                    .orElseThrow(() -> new AssertionError("Missing reshape slot in dynamic plan"));
   516	            assertTrue(reshapeSlot.isOutputShapeDependsOnInputValues(),
   517	                    "reshape slot must use calculateOutputShapes2() for dynamic shape inputs");
   518	
   519	            INDArray first = Nd4j.linspace(1.0, 64L * 128L, 64L * 128L, DataType.FLOAT).reshape(64, 128);
   520	            INDArray second = Nd4j.linspace(1.0, 32L * 256L, 32L * 256L, DataType.FLOAT).reshape(32, 256);
   521	
   522	            for (INDArray input : List.of(first, second)) {
   523	                Map<String, INDArray> placeholders = Map.of("input", input);
   524	                Map<String, INDArray> expected = sd.output(placeholders, "result", "swapped_shape");
   525	                Map<String, INDArray> actual = executeNativePlan(handle, plan, resolveExternalInputs(plan, sd, placeholders));
   526	
   527	                NativeExecutorTestUtils.assertArrayEquals(expected.get("swapped_shape"), actual.get("swapped_shape"),
   528	                        TOLERANCE, "Dynamic reshape shape tensor mismatch for input " + Arrays.toString(input.shape()));
   529	                NativeExecutorTestUtils.assertArrayEquals(expected.get("result"), actual.get("result"),
   530	                        TOLERANCE, "Dynamic reshape result mismatch for input " + Arrays.toString(input.shape()));
   531	            }
   532	        } finally {
   533	            NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps().freeDynamicShapePlan(handle);
   534	            plan.close();
   535	        }
   536	    }

    48	 * input_ids, position_ids, and attention_mask external inputs (because C++ manages

    50	 * data from a previous step.

    53	 * through InferenceSession and does NOT use the DSP decode input skip path. This

    68	    @Test
    69	    @DisplayName("Changing placeholder values produce different outputs each step (standard path)")
    70	    public void testChangingPlaceholdersStandardPath() {

    78	        SDVariable attentionMask = sd.placeHolder("attention_mask", DataType.FLOAT, 1, dim);
    79	        // output = input_ids + position_ids * attention_mask
    80	        SDVariable posTimesAttn = positionIds.mul("pos_attn", attentionMask);
    81	        SDVariable out = inputIds.add("output", posTimesAttn);
    82	
    83	        INDArray previousOutput = null;

    85	        for (int step = 0; step < 10; step++) {
    86	            float inputVal = (float)(step + 1);
    87	            float posVal = (float)(step * 0.1);
    88	            float maskVal = (step < 5) ? 1.0f : 0.0f; // mask changes mid-sequence
    89	
    90	            INDArray inputArr = Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, dim).mul(inputVal);
    91	            INDArray posArr = Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, dim).mul(posVal);
    92	            INDArray maskArr = Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, dim).mul(maskVal);
    93	
    94	            Map<String, INDArray> ph = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    95	            ph.put("input_ids", inputArr);
    96	            ph.put("position_ids", posArr);
    97	            ph.put("attention_mask", maskArr);
    98	
    99	            Map<String, INDArray> result;
   100	            if (step < 2) {
   101	                result = sd.output(ph, "output");
   102	            } else {
   103	                result = sd.outputDirect(ph, "output");
   104	            }
   105	            INDArray output = result.get("output");
   106	
   107	            float expected = inputVal + posVal * maskVal;
   108	            double diff = Math.abs(output.getFloat(0) - expected);
   109	            log.info("Step {}: inputVal={}, posVal={}, maskVal={}, expected={}, got={}, diff={}",
   110	                    step, inputVal, posVal, maskVal, expected, output.getFloat(0), diff);
   111	            assertTrue(diff < TOL,
   112	                    "Step " + step + ": expected " + expected + " but got " + output.getFloat(0));
   113	
   114	            // Verify output actually changes from previous step (not stale)

    43	 * Root causes identified from commit analysis (last 2 days):

    48	 * 5. Attention mask off-by-one (cachePos vs cachePos-1)
    49	 * 6. FrozenDecodeStep device context not restored after buffer allocation
