    75	
    76	    /**
    77	     * Regression: Cast cache pointer-identity reuse (sameLogicalA/B shortcut) caused
    78	     * stale FP16 data during CUDA graph replay. When capture buffer addresses are
    79	     * stable but contents change each step, pointer-identity match skipped assign()
    80	     * → stale cast → identical logits → degenerate output loop.
    81	     *
    82	     * This test verifies that repeated mixed-precision matmuls with the SAME weight
    83	     * array but DIFFERENT activation data produce DIFFERENT results. If the cast
    84	     * cache incorrectly reuses stale FP16 data, all outputs would be identical.
    85	     */
    86	    @Test
    87	    @DisplayName("Mixed-precision matmul with same weights but changing activations produces different outputs")
    88	    public void testCastCacheNotStaleAcrossSteps() {
    89	        SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
    90	
    91	        // Simulate decode: fixed FP16 weights, changing FP32 activations each step
    92	        INDArray weights = Nd4j.randn(DataType.HALF, SMALL_K, SMALL_N);
    93	        SDVariable a = sd.placeHolder("a", DataType.FLOAT, 1, SMALL_K);
    94	        SDVariable b = sd.constant("weights", weights);
    95	        SDVariable result = sd.mmul("logits", a, b);
    96	
    97	        int numSteps = 10;
    98	        INDArray[] activations = new INDArray[numSteps];
    99	        INDArray[] outputs = new INDArray[numSteps];
   100	
   101	        // Simulate decode loop: each step has different activation (like different hidden states)
   102	        for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; step++) {
   103	            activations[step] = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, SMALL_K);
   104	            Map<String, INDArray> out = sd.output(Map.of("a", activations[step]), "logits");
   105	            outputs[step] = out.get("logits").castTo(DataType.FLOAT).dup();
   106	        }
   107	
   108	        // Core assertion: each output must differ (not stale cache reuse)
   109	        int identicalPairs = 0;
   110	        for (int i = 0; i < numSteps; i++) {
   111	            for (int j = i + 1; j < numSteps; j++) {
   112	                double maxDiff = maxAbsError(outputs[i], outputs[j]);
   113	                if (maxDiff < 1e-6) {
   114	                    identicalPairs++;
   115	                    log.warn("Steps {} and {} produced identical output (stale cache?)", i, j);
   116	                }
   117	            }
   118	        }
   119	
   120	        assertEquals(0, identicalPairs,
   121	                identicalPairs + " pairs of outputs were identical — cast cache is stale");
   122	
   123	        // Also verify each output matches its FP32 reference
   124	        INDArray weightsFp32 = weights.castTo(DataType.FLOAT);
   125	        for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; step++) {
   126	            INDArray expected = activations[step].mmul(weightsFp32);
   127	            double maxErr = maxAbsError(expected, outputs[step]);
   128	            assertTrue(maxErr < 0.1,
   129	                    "Step " + step + " max error " + maxErr + " exceeds tolerance");
   130	        }
   131	
   132	        sd.close();
   133	        log.info("Cast cache staleness test passed: {} steps all produced unique, correct outputs", numSteps);
   134	    }

   200	
   201	    @Test
   202	    @DisplayName("4: Reusable embeddings buffer allocated once, reused via assign across steps")
   203	    public void testReusableEmbeddingsLifecycle() {
   204	        // Simulates lines 636-644: reusableEmbeddings created once, data copied each step
   205	        INDArray reusableEmbeddings = null;
   206	        INDArray reusableInputIds = null;
   207	        INDArray prevEmbeddings;
   208	
   209	        // Simulate embedding table row lookup
   210	        INDArray embeddingTable = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1000, HIDDEN_SIZE);
   211	
   212	        // Step 0: non-static KV, creates regular embedding (line 644)
   213	        int tokenId = 42;
   214	        INDArray rowEmbed0 = embeddingTable.getRow(tokenId).reshape(1, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE);
   215	        INDArray currentEmbeddings = rowEmbed0;
   216	        assertNull(reusableEmbeddings, "Step 0: reusable not yet allocated");
   217	
   218	        // Step 1: static KV now active, first allocation of reusable (line 637-638)
   219	        prevEmbeddings = currentEmbeddings;
   220	        tokenId = 99;
   221	        INDArray rowEmbed1 = embeddingTable.getRow(tokenId).reshape(1, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE);
   222	        // First time: allocate reusable via dup
   223	        reusableEmbeddings = rowEmbed1.dup();
   224	        currentEmbeddings = reusableEmbeddings;
   225	
   226	        // prevEmbeddings != currentEmbeddings — safe to close prev (line 689-693)
   227	        assertNotSame(prevEmbeddings, currentEmbeddings,
   228	                "Step 1: prev and current should be different objects");
   229	
   230	        // Store the address of reusable for identity tracking
   231	        long reusableAddr = reusableEmbeddings.data().address();
   232	
   233	        // Step 2+: reuse via assign — same object, just data changes
   234	        prevEmbeddings = currentEmbeddings;
   235	        tokenId = 77;
   236	        INDArray rowEmbed2 = embeddingTable.getRow(tokenId).reshape(1, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE);
   237	        reusableEmbeddings.assign(rowEmbed2);
   238	        currentEmbeddings = reusableEmbeddings;
   239	
   240	        // CRITICAL: prevEmbeddings == currentEmbeddings — must NOT close (line 689)
   241	        assertSame(prevEmbeddings, currentEmbeddings,
   242	                "Step 2+: prev and current should be SAME object (reusable)");
   243	        assertEquals(reusableAddr, reusableEmbeddings.data().address(),
   244	                "Step 2+: reusable buffer address should not change");
   245	
   246	        // Verify data was actually updated
   247	        float expected = rowEmbed2.getFloat(0);
   248	        assertEquals(expected, reusableEmbeddings.getFloat(0, 0, 0), 1e-6,
   249	                "Reusable should have step 2's embedding data");
   250	
   251	        // Same logic for input_ids (lines 646-652)
   252	        reusableInputIds = Nd4j.createFromArray(new int[]{42}).reshape(1, 1).castTo(DataType.LONG);
   253	        long idsAddr = reusableInputIds.data().address();
   254	        reusableInputIds.putScalar(0, 0, 99);
   255	        assertEquals(99, reusableInputIds.getLong(0, 0), "putScalar should update input_ids");
   256	        assertEquals(idsAddr, reusableInputIds.data().address(),
   257	                "Input IDs buffer address should not change after putScalar");
   258	
   259	        // 10 more steps — verify address stability
   260	        for (int step = 3; step < 13; step++) {
   261	            INDArray rowEmbed = embeddingTable.getRow(step).reshape(1, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE);
   262	            reusableEmbeddings.assign(rowEmbed);
   263	            assertEquals(reusableAddr, reusableEmbeddings.data().address(),
   264	                    "Step " + step + ": buffer address must be stable for CUDA graph replay");
   265	
   266	            reusableInputIds.putScalar(0, 0, step);
   267	            assertEquals(idsAddr, reusableInputIds.data().address(),
   268	                    "Step " + step + ": input_ids address must be stable");
   269	        }
   270	    }

   106	            for (int p = 0; p < numPositions; p++) {
   107	                presentKey.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   108	                        NDArrayIndex.point(maxKvLen + p), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(100.0f + p);
   109	            }

   111

   138	            }

   140	            // Verify: positions outside the scatter range are still zero

   183	                    NDArrayIndex.point(maxKvLen), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(42.0f);
   184	
   185	            Map<String, INDArray> outputs = new HashMap<>();
   186	            outputs.put("present.0.key", presentKey);
   187	
   188	            DecoderUtils.scatterNewKvEntries(staticKvBuffers, outputs,
   189	                    presentKeyNames, presentValueNames, maxKvLen, cachePos, ioConfig);
   190	
   191	            // Position cachePos should have 42.0 (from maxKvLen), NOT -999
   192	            float val = staticBuf.getFloat(0, 0, cachePos, 0);
   193	            assertEquals(42.0f, val, 0.01f,
   194	                    "Single-token scatter should extract from position maxKvLen=" + maxKvLen);
   195	
   196	            log.info("Single-token scatter source offset test passed");
   197	
   198	            presentKey.close();
   199	            staticBuf.close();
   200	        }
   201	    }

   211	        /**
   212	         * buildCausalMask with seqLen=1 should return all-zeros (attend everything).
   213	         */
   214	        @Test
   215	        @DisplayName("buildCausalMask seqLen=1 returns all-zeros")
   216	        public void testCausalMaskSeqLen1() {
   217	            INDArray mask = DecoderUtils.buildCausalMask(1, 1, 50);
   218	            assertEquals(4, mask.rank(), "Should be 4D: [batch, 1, seqLen, totalSeqLen]");
   219	            assertArrayEquals(new long[]{1, 1, 1, 50}, mask.shape());
   220	            assertEquals(0.0, mask.sumNumber().doubleValue(), 0.01,
   221	                    "seqLen=1 causal mask should be all zeros (attend to everything)");
   222	            mask.close();
   223	        }
   224	
   225	        /**
   226	         * buildCausalMask with seqLen > 1 should produce a proper causal pattern:
   227	         * lower-triangular for current positions, all-attend for past.
   228	         */
   229	        @Test
   230	        @DisplayName("buildCausalMask seqLen>1 has correct causal pattern")
   231	        public void testCausalMaskMultiToken() {
   232	            int currentSeqLen = 4;
   233	            int pastSeqLen = 10;
   234	            int totalSeqLen = pastSeqLen + currentSeqLen;  // 14
   235	
   236	            INDArray mask = DecoderUtils.buildCausalMask(1, currentSeqLen, totalSeqLen);
   237	            assertArrayEquals(new long[]{1, 1, currentSeqLen, totalSeqLen}, mask.shape());
   238	
   239	            // For each query position q:
   240	            // - Past [0..pastSeqLen-1]: all 0 (attend)
   241	            // - Current [pastSeqLen..pastSeqLen+q]: 0 (attend to self and earlier)
   242	            // - Future [pastSeqLen+q+1..totalSeqLen-1]: MASK_FILL (block)
   243	            for (int q = 0; q < currentSeqLen; q++) {
   244	                // Past positions: should all be 0
   245	                for (int k = 0; k < pastSeqLen; k++) {
   246	                    float val = mask.getFloat(0, 0, q, k);
   247	                    assertEquals(0.0f, val, 0.01f,
   248	                            "Query " + q + " should attend to past position " + k);
   249	                }
   250	
   251	                // Current self and earlier: should be 0
   252	                for (int k = pastSeqLen; k <= pastSeqLen + q; k++) {
   253	                    float val = mask.getFloat(0, 0, q, k);
   254	                    assertEquals(0.0f, val, 0.01f,
   255	                            "Query " + q + " should attend to current position " + (k - pastSeqLen));
   256	                }
   257	
   258	                // Future positions: should be MASK_FILL
   259	                for (int k = pastSeqLen + q + 1; k < totalSeqLen; k++) {
   260	                    float val = mask.getFloat(0, 0, q, k);
   261	                    assertEquals(DecoderUtils.MASK_FILL, val, 1.0f,
   262	                            "Query " + q + " should NOT attend to future position " + (k - pastSeqLen));
   263	                }
   264	            }
   265	
   266	            log.info("Multi-token causal mask test passed: seqLen={}, totalSeqLen={}", currentSeqLen, totalSeqLen);
   267	            mask.close();
   268	        }
   269	
   270	        /**
   271	         * buildCausalMask with batchSize > 1 tiles correctly.
   272	         * Each batch should have identical mask patterns.
   273	         */
   274	        @Test
   275	        @DisplayName("buildCausalMask batchSize>1 tiles correctly")
   276	        public void testCausalMaskBatched() {

   283	
   284	            // All batches should be identical
   285	            INDArray batch0 = mask.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   286	                    NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all());
   287	            for (int b = 1; b < batchSize; b++) {
   288	                INDArray batchB = mask.get(NDArrayIndex.point(b), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   289	                        NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all());
   290	                assertEquals(batch0, batchB,
   291	                        "Batch " + b + " should be identical to batch 0");
   292	            }
   293	
   294	            log.info("Batched causal mask test passed: batch={}, shape={}", batchSize, Arrays.toString(mask.shape()));
   295	            mask.close();
   296	        }

    52	/**
    53	 * Multi-step DSP decode test that mimics the real decoder pattern:
    54	 * - Inputs: input_ids [1,1], position_ids [1,1], attention_mask [1,N], past_key_values [1,heads,maxLen,dim]
    55	 * - Ops: matmul + add (bias) + activation, KV concat pattern
    56	 * - Outputs: logits [1,1,vocab], present_key_values [1,heads,maxLen+1,dim]
    57	 *
    58	 * Runs 50 decode steps transitioning from output() to outputDirect() with frozen shapes.
    59	 * Detects progressive degeneration where outputs stop changing despite different inputs.
    60	 */
    61	@Slf4j
    62	@Tag(TagNames.SAMEDIFF)
    63	@NativeTag
    64	public class MultiStepDspDecodeTest extends BaseNd4jTestWithBackends {
    65	
    66	    private static final int NUM_HEADS = 4;
    67	    private static final int HEAD_DIM = 16;
    68	    private static final int HIDDEN_SIZE = NUM_HEADS * HEAD_DIM; // 64
    69	    private static final int VOCAB_SIZE = 128;
    70	    private static final int MAX_NEW_TOKENS = 50;
    71	    private static final int PREFILL_LEN = 5;
    72	
    73	    @Override
    74	    public char ordering() {
    75	        return 'c';
    76	    }
    77	
    78	    @AfterEach
    79	    public void cleanup() {
    80	        Nd4j.getMemoryManager().purgeCaches();
    81	        System.gc();
    82	    }
    83	
    84	    /**
    85	     * Build a synthetic "decoder" SameDiff graph that mimics a transformer decoder layer.
    86	     *
    87	     * Graph pattern:
    88	     *   inputs_embeds [1, seqLen, hidden] --> matmul(Wq) --> reshape to [1, heads, seqLen, headDim]
    89	     *   past_key_values.0.key [1, heads, kvLen, headDim] --> concat with new key --> present.0.key
    90	     *   attention scores = Q * K^T --> add(attention_mask) --> softmax --> matmul(V) --> project --> logits
    91	     *
    92	     * Simplified to: inputs_embeds -> matmul -> add -> tanh -> matmul(vocab_proj) -> logits
    93	     * Plus: past_kv concat with projected input to produce present_kv
    94	     */
    95	    private SameDiff buildSyntheticDecoder(long maxKvLen) {
    96	        SameDiff sd = SameDiff.create();
    97	
    98	        // Placeholders
    99	        SDVariable inputsEmbeds = sd.placeHolder("inputs_embeds", DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE);
   100	        SDVariable inputIds = sd.placeHolder("input_ids", DataType.LONG, 1, 1);
   101	        SDVariable positionIds = sd.placeHolder("position_ids", DataType.LONG, 1, 1);
   102	        SDVariable attentionMask = sd.placeHolder("attention_mask", DataType.LONG, 1, maxKvLen + 1);
   103	        SDVariable pastKey = sd.placeHolder("past_key_values.0.key", DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, maxKvLen, HEAD_DIM);
   104	        SDVariable pastValue = sd.placeHolder("past_key_values.0.value", DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, maxKvLen, HEAD_DIM);
   105	
   106	        // Weights
   107	        SDVariable w1 = sd.var("w1", Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, HIDDEN_SIZE, HIDDEN_SIZE).muli(0.02));
   108	        SDVariable b1 = sd.var("b1", Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, HIDDEN_SIZE));
   109	        SDVariable wVocab = sd.var("w_vocab", Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, HIDDEN_SIZE, VOCAB_SIZE).muli(0.02));
   110	        SDVariable wKey = sd.var("w_key", Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, HIDDEN_SIZE, NUM_HEADS * HEAD_DIM).muli(0.02));
   111	        SDVariable wValue = sd.var("w_value", Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, HIDDEN_SIZE, NUM_HEADS * HEAD_DIM).muli(0.02));
   112	
   113	        // Forward pass: inputs_embeds [1,1,hidden] -> squeeze -> [1, hidden]
   114	        SDVariable squeezed = sd.squeeze("squeeze_embed", inputsEmbeds, 1);  // [1, hidden]
   115	
   116	        // Layer 1: matmul + bias + tanh
   117	        SDVariable h1 = sd.mmul("h1_matmul", squeezed, w1);          // [1, hidden]
   118	        h1 = h1.add("h1_add", b1);                                    // [1, hidden]
   119	        h1 = sd.math.tanh("h1_act", h1);                             // [1, hidden]
   120	
   121	        // Project to new KV entries: [1, hidden] -> [1, heads*headDim] -> reshape [1, heads, 1, headDim]
   122	        SDVariable newKeyFlat = sd.mmul("new_key_proj", h1, wKey);    // [1, heads*headDim]
   123	        SDVariable newKey = sd.reshape("new_key_reshape", newKeyFlat, 1, NUM_HEADS, 1, HEAD_DIM);
   124	        SDVariable newValueFlat = sd.mmul("new_value_proj", h1, wValue);
   125	        SDVariable newValue = sd.reshape("new_value_reshape", newValueFlat, 1, NUM_HEADS, 1, HEAD_DIM);
   126	
   127	        // Concat past KV with new KV: [1, heads, maxLen, dim] concat [1, heads, 1, dim] -> [1, heads, maxLen+1, dim]
   128	        SDVariable presentKey = sd.concat("present.0.key", 2, pastKey, newKey);
   129	        SDVariable presentValue = sd.concat("present.0.value", 2, pastValue, newValue);
   130	
   131	        // Logits projection: [1, hidden] -> [1, vocab] -> reshape [1, 1, vocab]
   132	        SDVariable logitsFlat = sd.mmul("logits_proj", h1, wVocab);   // [1, vocab]
   133	        SDVariable logits = sd.reshape("logits", logitsFlat, 1, 1, VOCAB_SIZE);
   134	
   135	        // Mark outputs
   136	        sd.setOutputs("logits", "present.0.key", "present.0.value");
   137	
   138	        return sd;
   139	    }
   140	
   141	    @ParameterizedTest
   142	    @MethodSource("org.nd4j.linalg.BaseNd4jTestWithBackends#configs")
   143	    public void testMultiStepDecodeWithDsp(Nd4jBackend backend) {
   144	        long maxKvLen = PREFILL_LEN + MAX_NEW_TOKENS;
   145	        SameDiff sd = buildSyntheticDecoder(maxKvLen);
   146	
   147	        // Enable DSP
   148	        sd.setDspAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   149	        sd.setDspNativeAutoCompileEnabled(true);
   150	        sd.setGraphExecutionMode(GraphExecutionMode.AUTO);
   151	
   152	        // Initialize static KV buffers (simulating post-prefill state)
   153	        INDArray staticKeyBuf = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, maxKvLen, HEAD_DIM).muli(0.1f);
   154	        INDArray staticValueBuf = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, maxKvLen, HEAD_DIM).muli(0.1f);
   155	        // Fill first PREFILL_LEN positions with "prefill data"
   156	        for (int p = PREFILL_LEN; p < maxKvLen; p++) {
   157	            staticKeyBuf.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   158	                    NDArrayIndex.point(p), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(0);
   159	            staticValueBuf.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   160	                    NDArrayIndex.point(p), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(0);
   161	        }
   162	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   163	
   164	        // Reusable decode buffers (fixed address for CUDA graph replay)
   165	        INDArray reusableEmbeds = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE);
   166	        INDArray reusableInputIds = Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[][]{{1}});
   167	        INDArray reusablePositionIds = Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[][]{{PREFILL_LEN}});
   168	        INDArray attentionMask = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, maxKvLen + 1);
   169	        // Mark prefill positions as attended
   170	        attentionMask.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.interval(0, PREFILL_LEN)).assign(1);
   171	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   172	
   173	        long cachePos = PREFILL_LEN;
   174	        Set<Integer> uniqueArgmaxTokens = new HashSet<>();
   175	        Map<Integer, float[]> outputsByStep = new LinkedHashMap<>();
   176	        int firstRepeatStep = -1;
   177	        float[] prevLogits = null;
   178	
   179	        String[] allOutputs = {"logits", "present.0.key", "present.0.value"};
   180	
   181	        for (int step = 0; step < MAX_NEW_TOKENS; step++) {
   182	            // Vary input each step: different "token embedding"
   183	            int tokenId = (step * 7 + 13) % VOCAB_SIZE;  // deterministic but varying
   184	            reusableEmbeds.assign(Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, HIDDEN_SIZE).muli(0.1f));
   185	            reusableInputIds.putScalar(0, 0, tokenId);
   186	            reusablePositionIds.putScalar(0, 0, cachePos);
   187	            attentionMask.putScalar(0, cachePos, 1);
   188	            // Also set concat position
   189	            attentionMask.putScalar(0, maxKvLen, 1);
   190	            Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   191	
   192	            Map<String, INDArray> inputs = new HashMap<>();
   193	            inputs.put("inputs_embeds", reusableEmbeds);
   194	            inputs.put("input_ids", reusableInputIds);
   195	            inputs.put("position_ids", reusablePositionIds);
   196	            inputs.put("attention_mask", attentionMask);
   197	            inputs.put("past_key_values.0.key", staticKeyBuf);
   198	            inputs.put("past_key_values.0.value", staticValueBuf);
   199	
   200	            Map<String, INDArray> outputs;
   201	            boolean useDirect = step >= 2;
   202	            if (useDirect) {
   203	                // Freeze shapes on first direct call
   204	                if (step == 2) {
   205	                    InferenceSession session = sd.getOrCreateSession();
   206	                    DynamicShapePlanExecutor dspExec = session.getDynamicShapePlanExecutor();
   207	                    if (dspExec != null) {
   208	                        dspExec.setShapesFrozen(true);
   209	                        log.info("Step {}: Shapes frozen for CUDA graph capture", step);
   210	                    }
   211	                }
   212	                outputs = sd.outputDirect(inputs, allOutputs);
   213	            } else {
   214	                outputs = sd.output(inputs, allOutputs);
   215	            }
   216	            Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
   217	
   218	            // Extract logits
   219	            INDArray logitsArr = outputs.get("logits");
   220	            assertNotNull(logitsArr, "Logits null at step " + step);
   221	            assertEquals(3, logitsArr.rank(), "Logits should be rank 3 at step " + step);
   222	
   223	            // Get argmax token
   224	            float[] logitsData = logitsArr.dup().data().asFloat();
   225	            int argmax = 0;
   226	            float maxVal = logitsData[0];
   227	            for (int i = 1; i < logitsData.length; i++) {
   228	                if (logitsData[i] > maxVal) {
   229	                    maxVal = logitsData[i];
   230	                    argmax = i;
   231	                }
   232	            }
   233	            uniqueArgmaxTokens.add(argmax);

   235

   240	                    if (Math.abs(prevLogits[i] - logitsData[i]) > 1e-6f) {

   243	                    }
   244	                }

   250	            prevLogits = logitsData;

   252	            // Scatter new KV entry into static buffer
   253	            INDArray presentKey = outputs.get("present.0.key");
   254	            INDArray presentValue = outputs.get("present.0.value");
   255	            if (presentKey != null && presentValue != null) {
   256	                // New entry is at position maxKvLen (the concat'd position)
   257	                INDArray newKeyEntry = presentKey.get(
   258	                        NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),

   459	    public void testPerStepInputCleanupSafety() {

   473	        INDArray kvBuf = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, NUM_HEADS, MAX_KV_LEN, HEAD_DIM);
   474	        INDArray reusableBias = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 1, 31);
   475

   477	        decoderInputMap.put("input_ids", ids);
   478	        decoderInputMap.put("position_ids", posIds);
   479	        decoderInputMap.put("attention_mask", mask);
   480	        decoderInputMap.put("past_key_values.0.key", kvBuf);
   481	        decoderInputMap.put("attn_bias", reusableBias);
   482	
   483	        // Reusable inputs cache — protects arrays in this map
   484	        Map<String, INDArray> reusableInputs = new HashMap<>();

   488	        // Simulate the cleanup loop (lines 616-627)

   490	        for (var entry : decoderInputMap.entrySet()) {

   505	        assertEquals("position_ids", closed.get(0), "position_ids should be the only closed input");

   509	        assertFalse(ids.wasClosed(), "Input IDs should NOT be closed");
   510	        assertFalse(mask.wasClosed(), "Mask should NOT be closed (in reusable cache)");
   511	        assertFalse(kvBuf.wasClosed(), "KV buffer should NOT be closed");
   512	        assertFalse(reusableBias.wasClosed(), "Bias should NOT be closed (in reusable cache)");
   513	        assertTrue(posIds.wasClosed(), "Position IDs should be closed");
   514	
   515	        // Clean up

   174	    /**
   175	     * Test 3: KV scatter correctness — verify that scatterNewKvEntries
   176	     * correctly copies the new token's KV from present output into the static buffer.
   177	     */
   178	    @Test
   179	    @DisplayName("testKvScatterCorrectness")
   180	    public void testKvScatterCorrectness() {
   181	        int numHeads = 3;
   182	        int headDim = 64;
   183	        int maxKvLen = 20;
   184	
   185	        // Static buffers with known data at positions 0..4
   186	        INDArray staticKeyBuf = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, numHeads, maxKvLen, headDim);
   187	        INDArray staticValBuf = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, numHeads, maxKvLen, headDim);
   188	
   189	        // Fill positions 0..4 with known values
   190	        for (int pos = 0; pos < 5; pos++) {
   191	            staticKeyBuf.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   192	                    NDArrayIndex.point(pos), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(pos + 1.0f);
   193	            staticValBuf.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   194	                    NDArrayIndex.point(pos), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign((pos + 1.0f) * 10);
   195	        }
   196	
   197	        Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers = new HashMap<>();
   198	        staticKvBuffers.put("past_key_values.0.key", staticKeyBuf);
   199	        staticKvBuffers.put("past_key_values.0.value", staticValBuf);
   200	
   201	        // Simulate decoder output: present_key = past + new entry
   202	        // present shape = [1, numHeads, cachePos+1, headDim] (concat of past view + new)
   203	        int cachePos = 5;
   204	        INDArray presentKey = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, numHeads, cachePos + 1, headDim);
   205	        INDArray presentValue = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, numHeads, cachePos + 1, headDim);
   206	
   207	        // Copy past into present (positions 0..cachePos-1)
   208	        for (int pos = 0; pos < cachePos; pos++) {
   209	            presentKey.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   210	                    NDArrayIndex.point(pos), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(pos + 1.0f);
   211	            presentValue.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   212	                    NDArrayIndex.point(pos), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign((pos + 1.0f) * 10);
   213	        }
   214	        // New entry at last position
   215	        float newKeyVal = 99.0f;
   216	        float newValVal = 990.0f;
   217	        presentKey.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   218	                NDArrayIndex.point(cachePos), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(newKeyVal);
   219	        presentValue.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   220	                NDArrayIndex.point(cachePos), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(newValVal);
   221	
   222	        Map<String, INDArray> decoderOutputs = new HashMap<>();
   223	        decoderOutputs.put("present.0.key", presentKey);
   224	        decoderOutputs.put("present.0.value", presentValue);
   225	
   226	        List<String> keyNames = List.of("present.0.key");
   227	        List<String> valueNames = List.of("present.0.value");
   228	
   229	        // Scatter
   230	        DecoderUtils.scatterNewKvEntries(staticKvBuffers, decoderOutputs,
   231	                keyNames, valueNames, maxKvLen, cachePos);
   232	
   233	        // Verify: position 5 in static buffer should now have newKeyVal
   234	        INDArray scatteredKey = staticKeyBuf.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   235	                NDArrayIndex.point(cachePos), NDArrayIndex.all());
   236	        float actualKeyVal = scatteredKey.getFloat(0, 0, 0);
   237	        assertEquals(newKeyVal, actualKeyVal, 1e-6f,
   238	                "Scattered key value should match new entry");
   239	
   240	        INDArray scatteredVal = staticValBuf.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   241	                NDArrayIndex.point(cachePos), NDArrayIndex.all());
   242	        float actualValVal = scatteredVal.getFloat(0, 0, 0);
   243	        assertEquals(newValVal, actualValVal, 1e-6f,
   244	                "Scattered value should match new entry");
   245	
   246	        // Verify previous positions unchanged
   247	        for (int pos = 0; pos < cachePos; pos++) {
   248	            float keyVal = staticKeyBuf.getFloat(0, 0, pos, 0);
   249	            assertEquals(pos + 1.0f, keyVal, 1e-6f,
   250	                    "Position " + pos + " key should be unchanged after scatter");
   251	        }
   252	
   253	        // Verify positions after cachePos+1 are still zero
   254	        float afterKeyVal = staticKeyBuf.getFloat(0, 0, cachePos + 1, 0);
   255	        assertEquals(0.0f, afterKeyVal, 1e-6f,
   256	                "Position after scatter should still be zero");
   257	
   258	        log.info("KV scatter test passed: new entry at pos {} correctly written", cachePos);
   259	    }

   261	    /**
   262	     * Test 4: View-based KV gives same attention output as full KV.
   263	     * This isolates whether the view [0:cachePos] of a padded static buffer
   264	     * produces the same result as a freshly-created [0:cachePos] tensor.

   266	    @Test
   267	    @DisplayName("testViewVsFullKvEquivalence")
   268	    public void testViewVsFullKvEquivalence() {
   269	        int batch = 1, numHeads = 3, headDim = 64, hidden = numHeads * headDim;
   270	        int cachePos = 5;
   271	        int maxKvLen = 20;
   272	
   273	        INDArray query = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, batch, 1, hidden).mul(0.1);
   274	        INDArray key = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, batch, 1, hidden).mul(0.1);
   275	        INDArray value = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, batch, 1, hidden).mul(0.1);
   276	
   277	        // Create "real" KV data for positions 0..cachePos-1
   278	        INDArray realPastKey = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, batch, numHeads, cachePos, headDim).mul(0.1);
   279	        INDArray realPastValue = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, batch, numHeads, cachePos, headDim).mul(0.1);
   280	
   281	        // Option A: pass realPastKey directly (what testManualMultiStepDecode does)
   282	        int totalSeq = cachePos + 1;
   283	        INDArray biasA = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 1, totalSeq);
   284	        INDArray attnA = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, batch, 1, hidden);
   285	        INDArray pkA = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, batch, numHeads, totalSeq, headDim);
   286	        INDArray pvA = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, batch, numHeads, totalSeq, headDim);
   287	        Nd4j.exec(org.nd4j.linalg.api.ops.DynamicCustomOp.builder("onnx_multi_head_attention")
   288	                .addInputs(query, key, value, biasA, realPastKey, realPastValue)
   289	                .addOutputs(attnA, pkA, pvA)
   290	                .addIntegerArguments(numHeads, 0)
   291	                .addFloatingPointArguments(0.0)
   292	                .build());
   293	
   294	        // Option B: embed in a padded buffer, take view (what StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop does)
   295	        INDArray staticKey = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, batch, numHeads, maxKvLen, headDim);
   296	        INDArray staticValue = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, batch, numHeads, maxKvLen, headDim);
   297	        staticKey.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   298	                NDArrayIndex.interval(0, cachePos), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(realPastKey);
   299	        staticValue.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   300	                NDArrayIndex.interval(0, cachePos), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(realPastValue);
   301	
   302	        INDArray viewKey = staticKey.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   303	                NDArrayIndex.interval(0, cachePos), NDArrayIndex.all());
   304	        INDArray viewValue = staticValue.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   305	                NDArrayIndex.interval(0, cachePos), NDArrayIndex.all());
   306	
   307	        INDArray biasB = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 1, 1, totalSeq);
   308	        INDArray attnB = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, batch, 1, hidden);
   309	        INDArray pkB = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, batch, numHeads, totalSeq, headDim);
   310	        INDArray pvB = Nd4j.create(DataType.FLOAT, batch, numHeads, totalSeq, headDim);
   311	        Nd4j.exec(org.nd4j.linalg.api.ops.DynamicCustomOp.builder("onnx_multi_head_attention")
   312	                .addInputs(query, key, value, biasB, viewKey, viewValue)
   313	                .addOutputs(attnB, pkB, pvB)
   314	                .addIntegerArguments(numHeads, 0)
   315	                .addFloatingPointArguments(0.0)
   316	                .build());
   317	
   318	        // Compare
   319	        double maxDiff = attnA.sub(attnB).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   320	        log.info("Full KV vs view KV attention output max diff: {}", maxDiff);
   321	        assertTrue(maxDiff < 1e-5,
   322	                "View-based KV should produce identical results to full KV. MaxDiff=" + maxDiff);
   323	    }

   185	    /**
   186	     * Run a graph through native DSP plan for multiple iterations, comparing every
   187	     * iteration against the Java reference output. Freezes shapes after iter 0.
   188	     * This is the core replay accuracy test pattern.
   189	     */
   190	    private void runReplayAccuracyTest(String testName, SameDiff sd, Map<String, INDArray> ph,
   191	                                        String outputName, double tolerance) {
   192	        NativeOps nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
   193	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(nativeOps.isTritonAvailable(), testName + ": Triton unavailable");
   194	
   195	        // Use SLOT-BY-SLOT native execution as reference (not sd.output() which has bugs
   196	        // with certain graph patterns returning zeros for multi-op chains with constants).
   197	        // This tests Triton compilation + replay vs native slot-by-slot execution.
   198	        DynamicShapePlan plan = NativeExecutorTestUtils.compilePlan(sd, outputName);
   199	        assertNotNull(plan, testName + ": plan is null");
   200	        Pointer planHandle = compileNativePlan(plan);
   201	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(planHandle != null, testName + ": native executor unavailable");
   202	
   203	        try {
   204	            INDArray[] extInputs = resolveExternalInputs(plan, sd, ph);
   205	
   206	            // First execution (iter 0) is slot-by-slot — use it as reference
   207	            Map<String, INDArray> refResults = executeNativePlan(planHandle, plan, extInputs);
   208	            INDArray refOutput = refResults.get(outputName).dup();
   209	            assertNotNull(refOutput, testName + ": reference output is null");
   210	            log.info("{}: ref shape={} sum={}", testName, refOutput.shape(), refOutput.sumNumber());
   211	
   212	            // Freeze shapes to enable Triton compilation + replay
   213	            nativeOps.setPlanShapesFrozen(planHandle, true);
   214	
   215	            for (int iter = 1; iter < REPLAY_ITERS; iter++) {
   216	                Map<String, INDArray> results = executeNativePlan(planHandle, plan, extInputs);
   217	                INDArray actual = results.get(outputName);
   218	                assertNotNull(actual, testName + ": null output at iter " + iter);
   219	
   220	                double maxDiff = refOutput.sub(actual).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   221	                log.info("{}: iter={} maxDiff={} actSum={}", testName, iter, maxDiff,
   222	                        actual.sumNumber());
   223	
   224	                if (maxDiff > tolerance) {
   225	                    INDArray flatRef = refOutput.reshape(refOutput.length());
   226	                    INDArray flatAct = actual.reshape(actual.length());
   227	                    int printed = 0;
   228	                    for (long j = 0; j < flatRef.length() && printed < 10; j++) {
   229	                        double d = Math.abs(flatRef.getDouble(j) - flatAct.getDouble(j));
   230	                        if (d > tolerance) {
   231	                            log.error("  MISMATCH idx={}: ref={} actual={} diff={}", j,
   232	                                    flatRef.getDouble(j), flatAct.getDouble(j), d);
   233	                            printed++;
   234	                        }
   235	                    }
   236	                }
   237	
   238	                assertTrue(maxDiff < tolerance,
   239	                        testName + ": maxDiff=" + maxDiff + " at iter " + iter +
   240	                                " (tolerance=" + tolerance + ")");
   241	            }
   242	        } finally {
   243	            nativeOps.freeDynamicShapePlan(planHandle);
   244	        }
   245	    }

   247	    /**
   248	     * Same as runReplayAccuracyTest but changes placeholder values between iterations.
   249	     * This catches stale-input bugs where the graph reads from capture-time buffers.
   250	     * Uses TWO native plan executions per iteration: one slot-by-slot (no freeze) as ref,
   251	     * one with the frozen/compiled plan as test.
   252	     */
   253	    private void runReplayWithChangingInputs(String testName, SameDiff sd,
   254	                                              java.util.function.Supplier<Map<String, INDArray>> inputFactory,
   255	                                              String outputName, double tolerance) {
   256	        NativeOps nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
   257	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(nativeOps.isTritonAvailable(), testName + ": Triton unavailable");
   258	
   259	        // Compile two plans: one for reference (slot-by-slot), one for test (frozen/compiled)
   260	        // Use a mutable map so we can update values in-place across iterations
   261	        Map<String, INDArray> ph = new java.util.HashMap<>(inputFactory.get());
   262	        DynamicShapePlan plan = NativeExecutorTestUtils.compilePlan(sd, outputName);
   263	        assertNotNull(plan, testName + ": plan is null");
   264	
   265	        Pointer refPlanHandle = compileNativePlan(plan);
   266	        Assumptions.assumeTrue(refPlanHandle != null, testName + ": native executor unavailable");
   267	
   268	        Pointer testPlanHandle = compileNativePlan(plan);
   269	        assertNotNull(testPlanHandle, testName + ": test plan is null");
   270	
   271	        try {
   272	            // First iter on both plans — warmup
   273	            INDArray[] extInputs = resolveExternalInputs(plan, sd, ph);
   274	            executeNativePlan(refPlanHandle, plan, extInputs);
   275	            executeNativePlan(testPlanHandle, plan, extInputs);
   276	
   277	            // Freeze only the test plan
   278	            nativeOps.setPlanShapesFrozen(testPlanHandle, true);
   279	
   280	            for (int iter = 0; iter < REPLAY_ITERS; iter++) {
   281	                // Generate new values but copy INTO existing buffers to keep GPU addresses stable.
   282	                // In real VLM decode, inputs change value but stay at the same GPU address.
   283	                Map<String, INDArray> newPh = inputFactory.get();
   284	                for (Map.Entry<String, INDArray> entry : newPh.entrySet()) {
   285	                    INDArray existing = ph.get(entry.getKey());
   286	                    if (existing != null && java.util.Arrays.equals(existing.shape(), entry.getValue().shape())) {
   287	                        existing.assign(entry.getValue());
   288	                    } else {
   289	                        ph.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
   290	                    }
   291	                }
   292	                extInputs = resolveExternalInputs(plan, sd, ph);
   293	
   294	                // Reference: unfrozen slot-by-slot execution
   295	                Map<String, INDArray> refResults = executeNativePlan(refPlanHandle, plan, extInputs);
   296	                INDArray refOutput = refResults.get(outputName).dup();
   297	
   298	                // Test: frozen/compiled execution
   299	                Map<String, INDArray> testResults = executeNativePlan(testPlanHandle, plan, extInputs);
   300	                INDArray actual = testResults.get(outputName);
   301	                assertNotNull(actual, testName + ": null at iter " + iter);
   302	
   303	                double maxDiff = refOutput.sub(actual).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   304	                log.info("{}: iter={} maxDiff={} refSum={} actSum={}", testName, iter, maxDiff,
   305	                        refOutput.sumNumber(), actual.sumNumber());
   306	
   307	                assertTrue(maxDiff < tolerance,
   308	                        testName + ": maxDiff=" + maxDiff + " at iter " + iter);
   309	            }
   310	        } finally {
   311	            nativeOps.freeDynamicShapePlan(refPlanHandle);
   312	            nativeOps.freeDynamicShapePlan(testPlanHandle);
   313	        }
   314	    }

   329	        SDVariable h2 = h1.mul("mul1", sd.constant("w1", Nd4j.ones(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 32).mul(2)));

codex
**Critical**
- Real PDF validation is effectively missing. [`TestCudaGraphReplayHang.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestCudaGraphReplayHang.java:221) claims to test `pathfinder-mythic.pdf` page 10, but `loadPdfPage()` is a synthetic placeholder at `:417-424`, so the “real workload” path never executes.
- The main decode-quality oracle is both short and self-referential. [`TestDspValidation.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/TestDspValidation.java:254) validates only `5` tokens in `testOutputAccuracy()` and `10` in `testDecodeStepValidation()` (`:287-349`, `:369-430`), and both compare back to current `REF_SLOT_BY_SLOT` rather than a known-good historical output.
- Most end-to-end VLM tests accept heuristics that will miss subtle semantic drift. [`TestSmolDoclingOptimizedPipeline.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestSmolDoclingOptimizedPipeline.java:1271) uses `generated>0`, tag presence, diversity, and throughput only (`:1271-1333`); [`TestVLMGenerationPipeline.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestVLMGenerationPipeline.java:478) checks only basic result fields (`:478-489`).
- The ONNX “reference” test is non-enforcing. [`TestVLMOnnxReference.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestVLMOnnxReference.java:535) logs `maxAbsDiff/meanAbsDiff/L2` in `compareOutputs()` (`:535-557`) but never asserts tolerances, so it cannot fail on drift.

**Important**
- Triton coverage is broad but mostly synthetic single-graph replay. [`TritonFusionReplayAccuracyTest.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/TritonFusionReplayAccuracyTest.java:72) runs `REPLAY_ITERS=6` and compares compiled replay against slot-by-slot (`:190-314`), but this is not an autoregressive decode loop with evolving KV.
- The strongest end-to-end Triton/CUDA-graph checks only pin a short prefix. [`TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.java:526) checks `CUDA_GRAPHS` against a manual prefix of only `REPLAY_PREFIX_TOKENS`, and the “best Triton” path does the same before falling back to tag heuristics (`:526-539`, `:549-588`, `:1253-1269`).
- Real decode memory is covered better than real decode quality. [`TestDecodeLoopMemory.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/TestDecodeLoopMemory.java:80) runs a real 50-token SLOT_BY_SLOT decode and only asserts `<50MB/token` (`:80-98`); [`TestDspValidation.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/TestDspValidation.java:883) adds multiple memory probes, but none of them validate semantics.
- Several tests are named like strong behavioral checks but only log or weakly assert. Examples: [`TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.java:252) `testStepByStepDivergence()` logs divergence without failing; [`TestVLMDecodeQuality.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestVLMDecodeQuality.java:184) `testPrefillFirstToken()` never checks the token identity.

**Minor**
- PDF-based tests frequently fall back to synthetic data when the file is absent, so coverage depends on local setup rather than the test contract: [`TestVLMGenerationPipeline.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestVLMGenerationPipeline.java:344) `:344-364`, [`TestSmolDoclingOptimizedPipeline.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestSmolDoclingOptimizedPipeline.java:1850) `:1850-1871`.
- There is substantial overlap in synthetic decode-input/mask/bias/KV-scatter isolation coverage across `StaticKvDecodeRegressionTest`, `DecoderPipelineRegressionTest`, `DecodeFeatureInteractionRegressionTest`, `DecodeComponentInteractionGapTest`, and `DecodeLoopStateTransitionTest`.

**Positive**
- Low-level decode regressions are well covered: KV scatter, attention-mask accumulation, position-id progression, stale-input detection, and output-direct transitions all have targeted tests.
- Recent Triton work materially improved backend confidence: `TritonFusionReplayAccuracyTest` adds 83 replay cases, and `TritonGraphBackendTest` includes SmolDocling-shaped GQA/KV attention scenarios.
- Memory leak/stability coverage after the DSP refactor is strong, especially around frozen replay and decode-loop allocation behavior.

**Redundancy**
- `StaticKvDecodeRegressionTest`, `DecoderPipelineRegressionTest`, and `DecodeFeatureInteractionRegressionTest` all test mask/bias/position/KV-update edge cases at the Java input-map layer; one focused “decode inputs regression” suite would cover most of this.
- `DecodeLoopStateTransitionTest` and `DecodeComponentInteractionGapTest` overlap on step-1/step-2 path switching, placeholder overrides, reusable buffer lifecycle, and cleanup policy.
- `TestBaselineVsHeadDecode`, `TestStaticKvVsManualDecode`, `TestVLMDecodeQuality`, and `TestCudaGraphReplayRegression` all use “unique token count/diversity” as the main decode-quality signal; they should be collapsed behind one stronger oracle.
- `TestGenerationPipeline` and `TestVLMGenerationPipeline` are both high-level VLM smoke tests with only basic result assertions.

**Recommended Test Plan**
- `P0`: Extend `TestSmolDoclingOptimizedPipeline` with a mandatory `pathfinder-mythic.pdf` page-10 golden test. Assert 50-100 exact token IDs, first divergence step, and normalized text match. This is the fastest way to catch real token-quality drift.
- `P0`: Upgrade `TestDspValidation` from `REF_SLOT_BY_SLOT` to a stored historical oracle. Keep the mode matrix, but compare `S/O/T/CG` against a known-good trace, not the current implementation.
- `P1`: Extend `TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.testBestTritonConfig()` and `testCudaGraphsReplayMatchesManualBaselinePrefix()` from a 4-token prefix to at least 32-50 steps, with per-step token and top-k agreement. Reuse existing harnesses.
- `P1`: Make `TestVLMOnnxReference.compareOutputs()` assert tolerances for embed/vision/decoder prefill outputs. Even single-step enforced references are better than log-only diagnostics.
- `P2`: Consolidate the synthetic decode-input regression suites and keep one strong unit suite plus one real-model semantic suite. That reduces redundancy and keeps failures easier to interpret.

**Critical**
- Real PDF validation is effectively missing. [`TestCudaGraphReplayHang.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestCudaGraphReplayHang.java:221) claims to test `pathfinder-mythic.pdf` page 10, but `loadPdfPage()` is a synthetic placeholder at `:417-424`, so the “real workload” path never executes.
- The main decode-quality oracle is both short and self-referential. [`TestDspValidation.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/TestDspValidation.java:254) validates only `5` tokens in `testOutputAccuracy()` and `10` in `testDecodeStepValidation()` (`:287-349`, `:369-430`), and both compare back to current `REF_SLOT_BY_SLOT` rather than a known-good historical output.
- Most end-to-end VLM tests accept heuristics that will miss subtle semantic drift. [`TestSmolDoclingOptimizedPipeline.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestSmolDoclingOptimizedPipeline.java:1271) uses `generated>0`, tag presence, diversity, and throughput only (`:1271-1333`); [`TestVLMGenerationPipeline.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestVLMGenerationPipeline.java:478) checks only basic result fields (`:478-489`).
- The ONNX “reference” test is non-enforcing. [`TestVLMOnnxReference.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestVLMOnnxReference.java:535) logs `maxAbsDiff/meanAbsDiff/L2` in `compareOutputs()` (`:535-557`) but never asserts tolerances, so it cannot fail on drift.

**Important**
- Triton coverage is broad but mostly synthetic single-graph replay. [`TritonFusionReplayAccuracyTest.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/TritonFusionReplayAccuracyTest.java:72) runs `REPLAY_ITERS=6` and compares compiled replay against slot-by-slot (`:190-314`), but this is not an autoregressive decode loop with evolving KV.
- The strongest end-to-end Triton/CUDA-graph checks only pin a short prefix. [`TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.java:526) checks `CUDA_GRAPHS` against a manual prefix of only `REPLAY_PREFIX_TOKENS`, and the “best Triton” path does the same before falling back to tag heuristics (`:526-539`, `:549-588`, `:1253-1269`).
- Real decode memory is covered better than real decode quality. [`TestDecodeLoopMemory.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/TestDecodeLoopMemory.java:80) runs a real 50-token SLOT_BY_SLOT decode and only asserts `<50MB/token` (`:80-98`); [`TestDspValidation.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/TestDspValidation.java:883) adds multiple memory probes, but none of them validate semantics.
- Several tests are named like strong behavioral checks but only log or weakly assert. Examples: [`TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.java:252) `testStepByStepDivergence()` logs divergence without failing; [`TestVLMDecodeQuality.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestVLMDecodeQuality.java:184) `testPrefillFirstToken()` never checks the token identity.

**Minor**
- PDF-based tests frequently fall back to synthetic data when the file is absent, so coverage depends on local setup rather than the test contract: [`TestVLMGenerationPipeline.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestVLMGenerationPipeline.java:344) `:344-364`, [`TestSmolDoclingOptimizedPipeline.java`](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestSmolDoclingOptimizedPipeline.java:1850) `:1850-1871`.
- There is substantial overlap in synthetic decode-input/mask/bias/KV-scatter isolation coverage across `StaticKvDecodeRegressionTest`, `DecoderPipelineRegressionTest`, `DecodeFeatureInteractionRegressionTest`, `DecodeComponentInteractionGapTest`, and `DecodeLoopStateTransitionTest`.

**Positive**
- Low-level decode regressions are well covered: KV scatter, attention-mask accumulation, position-id progression, stale-input detection, and output-direct transitions all have targeted tests.
- Recent Triton work materially improved backend confidence: `TritonFusionReplayAccuracyTest` adds 83 replay cases, and `TritonGraphBackendTest` includes SmolDocling-shaped GQA/KV attention scenarios.
- Memory leak/stability coverage after the DSP refactor is strong, especially around frozen replay and decode-loop allocation behavior.

**Redundancy**
- `StaticKvDecodeRegressionTest`, `DecoderPipelineRegressionTest`, and `DecodeFeatureInteractionRegressionTest` all test mask/bias/position/KV-update edge cases at the Java input-map layer; one focused “decode inputs regression” suite would cover most of this.
- `DecodeLoopStateTransitionTest` and `DecodeComponentInteractionGapTest` overlap on step-1/step-2 path switching, placeholder overrides, reusable buffer lifecycle, and cleanup policy.
- `TestBaselineVsHeadDecode`, `TestStaticKvVsManualDecode`, `TestVLMDecodeQuality`, and `TestCudaGraphReplayRegression` all use “unique token count/diversity” as the main decode-quality signal; they should be collapsed behind one stronger oracle.
- `TestGenerationPipeline` and `TestVLMGenerationPipeline` are both high-level VLM smoke tests with only basic result assertions.

**Recommended Test Plan**
- `P0`: Extend `TestSmolDoclingOptimizedPipeline` with a mandatory `pathfinder-mythic.pdf` page-10 golden test. Assert 50-100 exact token IDs, first divergence step, and normalized text match. This is the fastest way to catch real token-quality drift.
- `P0`: Upgrade `TestDspValidation` from `REF_SLOT_BY_SLOT` to a stored historical oracle. Keep the mode matrix, but compare `S/O/T/CG` against a known-good trace, not the current implementation.
- `P1`: Extend `TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.testBestTritonConfig()` and `testCudaGraphsReplayMatchesManualBaselinePrefix()` from a 4-token prefix to at least 32-50 steps, with per-step token and top-k agreement. Reuse existing harnesses.
- `P1`: Make `TestVLMOnnxReference.compareOutputs()` assert tolerances for embed/vision/decoder prefill outputs. Even single-step enforced references are better than log-only diagnostics.
- `P2`: Consolidate the synthetic decode-input regression suites and keep one strong unit suite plus one real-model semantic suite. That reduces redundancy and keeps failures easier to interpret.

Static source audit only; I did not run the suite.
